children.text: अश्वमेधयज्ञ श्रीरामचन्द्रजीकी ॥
children.translated_text: The <s>Aśvamedha</s> sacrifice of Lord <s>Rāmacandra</s>.

children.text: सोरठा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Sorathā</s> (meter) //

children.text: बन्दौं चरण पुनीत गुण प्रतिपालन गजवदन ।
children.translated_text: I bow to the holy feet of the elephant-faced one (<s>Gaṇeśa</s>), the upholder of virtues,

children.text: जे पूजत करि प्रीत होत परम कल्याणमय ॥
children.translated_text: worshipping whom with love brings supreme blessedness.

children.text: बन्दौं गुरु पदरेनु मन रञ्जन अञ्जन दृगन ।
children.translated_text: I bow to the dust of the guru's feet, the collyrium that delights the mind and anoints the eyes,

children.text: मुद मंगल सुख दनु सूझिपरै रघुबर चरित ॥
children.translated_text: granting joy, auspiciousness, and happiness — through which the deeds of <s>Raghubara</s> (best of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty) become visible.

children.text: बन्दौं तनयसमीर ज्ञानखान रघुनाथ प्रिय ।
children.translated_text: I bow to the son of the Wind (<s>Hanumān</s>), the treasury of knowledge, beloved of <s>Raghunātha</s>,

children.text: जासु हृदय रघुबीर बसहिं सदा शरचापधर ॥
children.translated_text: in whose heart <s>Raghubīra</s> (the hero of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty) ever resides, bearing bow and arrow.

children.text: बन्दौं अज सनकादि सनक सनातन जय विजय ।
children.translated_text: I bow to the unborn (<s>Brahmā</s>), <s>Sanaka</s> and the others — <s>Sanaka</s>, <s>Sanātana</s>, <s>Jaya</s>, <s>Vijaya</s>,

children.text: ऋषि परमारथवादि जे नित गावहिं राम यश ॥
children.translated_text: the sages who speak of the supreme truth, who ever sing the glory of <s>Rāma</s>.

children.text: बन्दौं सिन्धुसुजान शैलसुता षटमुख सहित ।
children.translated_text: I bow to the wise one of the ocean (<s>Gaṇeśa</s>/<s>Śiva</s>), together with the daughter of the mountain (<s>Pārvatī</s>) and <s>Ṣaṇmukha</s> (<s>Kārttikeya</s>),

children.text: सकल सुमंगलखान नन्दीपति गिरिजारमण ॥
children.translated_text: the mine of all auspiciousness, the lord of <s>Nandī</s>, the beloved of <s>Girijā</s> (<s>Pārvatī</s>).

children.text: बन्दौं रघुबर पद जलजाता । आरतिहरण परमसुखदाता ॥
children.translated_text: I bow to the lotus feet of <s>Raghubara</s>, the remover of distress and giver of supreme happiness.

children.text: पुनि लक्ष्मण युगचरण नमामी । बीर धुरीण राम अनुगामी ॥
children.translated_text: I also bow to the two feet of <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, the foremost hero, the follower of <s>Rāma</s>.

children.text: बन्दौं चरण भरत द्वउ भाई । शील सनेह ज्ञान अधिकाई ॥
children.translated_text: I bow to the feet of <s>Bharata</s> and the two brothers, [endowed with] supreme virtue, affection, and wisdom.

children.text: बन्दौं तीरथराज प्रयागा । मज्जनते कोटिन अघभागा ॥
children.translated_text: I bow to <s>Prayāga</s>, the king of sacred fords, by bathing in which millions of sins are destroyed.

children.text: बन्दौं साधु सन्त जग जेते । करौं प्रणाम नाय शिर तेते ॥
children.translated_text: I bow to all the saints and sages in the world; I make obeisance, bowing my head to all of them.

children.text: गिरामूक शारद श्रुति शेशा । सुर मुनि नारद सप्त ऋषेशा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Sarasvatī</s> is mute of speech, the <s>Vedas</s> and <s>Śeṣa</s> [are insufficient],

children.text: महि पाताल अकाश समेता । भूधर विटप पयोनिधि सेता ॥
children.translated_text: gods, sages, <s>Nārada</s>, and the seven great sages [cannot describe it]. The earth, the underworld, and the sky together,

children.text: बन्दौं करजोरे सब काहू । दनुजमण्डली रवि शशिराहू ॥
children.translated_text: mountains, trees, and oceans — I bow to all with joined palms,

children.text: यह बर देउ धरौं पद माथा । बरणों यश निर्मल रघुनाथा ॥
children.translated_text: the host of demons, the sun, moon, and <s>Rāhu</s>. Grant me this boon: I place my head at your feet — that I may describe the spotless glory of <s>Raghunātha</s>.

children.text: दो० श्रोता बक्ता युगों युग जे प्रवीण गुणखान ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s> // May both listeners and speakers, who are skilled and mines of virtues in every age,

children.text: कृपाकरहु सेवक समुझि तजि इरषा अभिमान ॥
children.translated_text: be gracious, regarding me as a servant, abandoning envy and pride.

children.text: आगर जेते जीव जहाना । बरणों सबहिं जोरियुगपाना ॥
children.translated_text: All the living beings there are in the world — I salute them all with joined palms.

children.text: रघुबर चरित चहूंदिशि पावन । सुखदभवनशुभमोरसुहावन ॥
children.translated_text: The deeds of <s>Raghubara</s>, purifying in all four directions, giving joy, auspicious, delightful to me —

children.text: स्वइ रघुबीर अनूपम गाथा । कहिहौं गुरुपदरजधरिमाथा ॥
children.translated_text: I shall tell the incomparable story of <s>Raghubīra</s> myself, placing the dust of the guru's feet upon my head.

children.text: जोशिवमुदितउमासनभाषी । सुनतकथारुचिअतिअभिलाषी ॥
children.translated_text: [<s>Śiva</s>] who, delighted, spoke to <s>Umā</s> in the presence of the assembly, listening to the story with great relish and longing,

children.text: बोलीं सरल सुधा सम बानी । पारबती गिरिराज भवानी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Pārvatī</s>, the daughter of the mountain-king, <s>Bhavānī</s>, spoke words as simple and sweet as nectar:

children.text: लव कुश जन्म यथा श्रुतिगाई । नाथ कृपाकरि कहौ बुझाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'O Lord, kindly tell and explain the birth of <s>Lava</s> and <s>Kuśa</s>, as the scriptures sing.'

children.text: सुनत बचन गिरिजा त्रिपुरारी । प्रभुपदप्रीतिजानिअधिकारी ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the words of <s>Girijā</s>, the destroyer of <s>Tripura</s> (<s>Śiva</s>), knowing her devotion to the Lord's feet and her worthiness,

children.text: धन्य धन्य हिमवन्त कुमारी । तुससमनहिंक्वउजगहितकारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Blessed, blessed is the daughter of <s>Himavān</s>! There is no one in the world who does good like you.'

children.text: जगहित प्रश्न तुम्हार भवानी । कहौंसुनहुनिश्चचयजियआनी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Your question, O <s>Bhavānī</s>, is for the welfare of the world. I shall tell — listen, knowing it with certainty in your heart.'

children.text: दो० सुखसागर पावन परम रघुबर चरित अनूप ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s> // The supremely holy deeds of <s>Raghubara</s>, an ocean of bliss, incomparable —

children.text: चरण सरस्वति नायशिरबरणोंमतिअनुरूप ॥
children.translated_text: bowing my head to <s>Sarasvatī</s>'s feet, I describe them according to my understanding.

children.text: करौंललितशुभचरित अरम्भा । ज्यहिसुनिमिटैमोहमददम्भा ॥
children.translated_text: I begin these lovely, auspicious deeds, hearing which, delusion, pride, and hypocrisy are destroyed.

children.text: एक समय शंकर अविनाशी । सुखमासदन ज्ञानगुणराशी ॥
children.translated_text: Once, <s>Śaṅkara</s>, the imperishable, the abode of happiness, the treasure-house of knowledge and virtues,

children.text: योगासन रवि कामद सोहै । देखिस्वरूप चराचर मोहै ॥
children.translated_text: seated in the posture of <s>yoga</s>, radiant as the wish-fulfilling sun — seeing his form, all moving and immovable creation was enchanted.

children.text: जगजननी तहँ शैलकुमारी । छिनछिनपतिआयसुअनुसारी ॥
children.translated_text: The mother of the world, the daughter of the mountain, was there, constantly following her husband's commands, moment by moment.

children.text: जो अनुशासन शंकर पावैं । करतसोकाजअबार न लावैं ॥
children.translated_text: Whatever instruction <s>Śaṅkara</s> received, he carried out that task without delay.

children.text: नित नूतन हरिचरित अनूठे । प्रथमहिंशंभुबचनकह मीठे ॥
children.translated_text: The ever-new, marvelous deeds of <s>Hari</s> — first <s>Śambhu</s> spoke sweet words [about them].

children.text: गदगद कणठ होहिं बश प्रेमा । कृपानिधान शंभु दृढ़नेमा ॥
children.translated_text: His throat would become choked with emotion under the power of love — <s>Śambhu</s>, the treasury of mercy, firm in his vow.

children.text: दशाबिलोकि मुदित गिरिजाई । बाढ़ी प्रीति चरण रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing this state, <s>Girijā</s> was delighted; love for the feet of <s>Raghurāi</s> (Lord <s>Rāma</s>) increased.

children.text: प्रथमहिं ते सब चरितसुनावा । सियबनगमनसुनतदुखपावा ॥
children.translated_text: First, he narrated all the deeds; hearing of <s>Sītā</s>'s departure to the forest, she felt sorrow.

children.text: दो० नयन नीरभरबिकल तनु जक्त मात करजोरि ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s> // With eyes filled with tears, body distressed, the Mother joined her palms

children.text: बोलीं सन्मुख प्राणपति बचन अमीरस बोरि ॥
children.translated_text: and spoke, facing her Lord, words steeped in the nectar of compassion.

children.text: नाथ चरित प्रभु सिन्धु अपारा । को अस मूढ़ जु चाहै पारा ॥
children.translated_text: 'O Lord, the deeds of the Lord are an endless ocean; who is such a fool that would seek to cross it?

children.text: प्रथमजोकहसियविपिननिकारी । सुनि संदेह भयो उर भारी ॥
children.translated_text: First, when you told of <s>Sītā</s>'s banishment to the forest, hearing it, great doubt and distress arose in my heart.

children.text: क्यहि कारण प्रभु दीनसनेही । दीन्ह्यो बास विपिन बैदेही ॥
children.translated_text: For what reason did the Lord, who loves the lowly, give <s>Vaidehī</s> (<s>Sītā</s>) a dwelling in the forest?

children.text: का अपराध जानकी कीन्हा । कृपासिंधुजेहिलगिबनदीन्हा ॥
children.translated_text: What offense did <s>Jānakī</s> commit, for which the ocean of mercy sent her to the forest?

children.text: भयो शोच प्रभुशोच निबेरी । कहो बुझाय जानिम्वहिंचेरी ॥
children.translated_text: There arose grief — O Lord, resolver of grief, tell me and explain, considering me your maid-servant.

children.text: यावत नभ विधि विष्णुपुरारी । प्रथमलीकजगअवनिकुमारी ॥
children.translated_text: As long as the sky, <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Śiva</s> endure — first the false [accusation against] the daughter of the earth.

children.text: जासु दृष्टि उपजैं गुण खानी । कोटिन रमा उमा ब्रह्मानी ॥
children.translated_text: From whose glance are born mines of virtues, millions of <s>Ramās</s>, <s>Umās</s>, and <s>Brahmāṇīs</s>,

children.text: इन्द्रबधू सुर मुनि ऋषिनारी । सदा जासु रूखरहैं निहारी ।
children.translated_text: the wives of <s>Indra</s>, of gods, sages, and seers — who always remain gazing upon [<s>Sītā</s>'s form],

children.text: त्यागन विपिन योगनहिं सीता । महादेवकह विधि विपरीता ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Sītā</s>, who is not to be abandoned to the forest — O <s>Mahādeva</s>, fate has acted in a contrary way!'

children.text: दो० विपिन बास सुनि विकलभइँ गिरिनंदिनी खगेश ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s> // Hearing of the forest-exile, the daughter of the mountain (<s>Pārvatī</s>) became distressed, O king of birds.

children.text: प्रभु इतिहास अनूप तब कह्यो बुझाय महेश ॥
children.translated_text: Then <s>Maheśa</s> (<s>Śiva</s>) narrated and explained the incomparable history of the Lord.

children.text: असकछु दशाविलोकि भवानी । बोले हर प्रिय कोमलबानी ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing <s>Bhavānī</s>'s state, <s>Hara</s> (<s>Śiva</s>) spoke beloved, gentle words:

children.text: अतिअपारप्रियगतिजगदीशा । को जानै कह अस गौरीशा ॥
children.translated_text: 'The ways of the Lord of the world are exceedingly beyond comprehension,' said <s>Gaurīśa</s> (Lord of <s>Gaurī</s>). 'Who can know them?'

children.text: धरि उरधीर भरम सब खोई । सुनहुकथा तुम पूँछ्यो जोई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Hold courage in your heart, abandon all doubt, and listen to the story you asked about.'

children.text: पिता बचनसुनि रघुकुलकेतू । गवनेबन सिय अनुजसमेतू ॥
children.translated_text: 'The banner of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty, hearing his father's command, went to the forest, together with <s>Sītā</s> and his younger brother.'

children.text: मिलहिंबिपिनऋषिकुटीअनेका । सुन्दर बिमल एकते एका ॥
children.translated_text: 'In the forest they encountered many hermitages of sages, each one more beautiful and pure than the last.'

children.text: करत मुनिन मग दंडप्रणामा । जाहिंचलेप्रभुछबिअभिरामा ॥
children.translated_text: 'Prostrating before the sages on the way, the Lord went on, his beauty enchanting.'

children.text: देखिप्रीति ऋषि मुनिवर नारी । प्रेमबिबशभइँ जनककुमारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Seeing the love [between <s>Rāma</s> and <s>Sītā</s>], the wives of the sages — the daughter of <s>Janaka</s> became overcome with love.'

children.text: असअभिलाष सियाउरआनी । ऋषिनबधूसन बोलीं बानी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Such a longing <s>Sītā</s> brought to her heart; she spoke to the wives of the sages:'

children.text: करिपूरण पितु बचन प्रमाना । आवहिंकुशलअवधभगवान ॥
children.translated_text: 'When the Lord returns to <s>Ayodhyā</s> safely, having fulfilled the mandate of our father's word,'

children.text: दो० तब मैं आउब अवधसे पुजिहौं सबके पांय ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s> // 'then I shall come from <s>Ayodhyā</s> and worship at all your feet,

children.text: पहिरावों भूषण बसन भोजनविविध कराय ॥
children.translated_text: adorning you with ornaments and garments, and serving you various meals.'

children.text: अस लालसा सिया मनमाहीं । प्रभुसनकहत मुनीशलजाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: 'Such was the longing in <s>Sītā</s>'s heart; she felt shy to speak it before the Lord in the presence of the great sages.'

children.text: प्रभु सिय हृदय मनोरथ जाना । बोलेबिहँसि राम भगवाना ।
children.translated_text: 'The Lord knew the desire in <s>Sītā</s>'s heart; Lord <s>Rāma</s> spoke with a smile:'

children.text: जो रुचिप्रिय तुम्हरे उर होई । मांगहु बेगि देउँ बर सोई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Whatever desire is in your heart, O beloved, ask it quickly — I shall grant that boon.'

children.text: मो मनकी रुचिजानहु स्वामी । घटघटके तुम अन्तरयामी ॥
children.translated_text: 'You know the desire of my heart, O Lord; you are the indweller of every heart.'

children.text: तदपि नाथ ऐसो बर पावों । बहुरि नाथ यहिकाननआवों ॥
children.translated_text: 'Nevertheless, O Lord, may I receive this boon — that I may come to this forest again, O Lord.'

children.text: एवमस्तु कह रघुकुलराया । दीन्ह सुभगबरसियमनभाया ॥
children.translated_text: 'So be it,' said the king of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty, and gave that beautiful boon, which pleased <s>Sītā</s>'s heart.

children.text: अवधचलबजबअवधिसिराई । तुम्हैं विपिनसँग लषणपठाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'When the time of exile is completed and we return to <s>Ayodhyā</s>, I shall send you to the forest with <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>.'

children.text: विधिवत पूज्यो सुरमुनि पाऊ । रहै न फिर कछुमन पछिताऊ ॥
children.translated_text: 'Worship duly the feet of the gods and sages; let there remain no regret in your mind thereafter.'

children.text: जबलग साध कस्यो बनबासू । ह्वैहै सबविधि तुम्हैं सुपासू ॥
children.translated_text: 'As long as we remain in this forest exile, you shall have every comfort in every way.'

children.text: दो० सुनिप्रभु वचन विनीतअति जनकसुताखागनाथ ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s> // Hearing the Lord's most humble words, the daughter of <s>Janaka</s>, O king of birds,

children.text: चरण सरोरुह नाथ निज मुदित नवायो माथ ।।
children.translated_text: joyfully bowed her head at her Lord's lotus feet.

children.text: असकहि विपिनचले रधुबीरा । सीता सहित अनुज रणधीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Saying this, <s>Raghubīra</s> went to the forest, together with <s>Sītā</s> and his younger brother, brave in battle.

children.text: बनबसि चरित कीन्ह भगवाना । सो खगेश नहिं जायबखाना ।।
children.translated_text: The Lord performed his deeds dwelling in the forest — that, O king of birds, cannot be described.

children.text: सोकिसकैं अब कहि बागीशा । शारद कोटिन कोटि अहीशा ।।
children.translated_text: Who can now tell it — the lord of speech? Millions of <s>Śāradās</s> (Sarasvatīs), millions of <s>Śeṣas</s>!

children.text: कौन लेख तहँ चेरे दासू । प्रभुपदप्रीति न दृढ़ बिश्वासू ।।
children.translated_text: What account can a servant give? There is no firm devotion or trust in the Lord's feet [in me].

children.text: बीते अवधि अवध प्रभुआये । सुनहु उमा सो चरित सुहाये ।।
children.translated_text: When the period of exile was over, the Lord returned to <s>Ayodhyā</s> — hear, O <s>Umā</s>, those delightful deeds.

children.text: आयसु पाय केकयी माता । बैठे राज्य राम सुरत्राता ।।
children.translated_text: Receiving the command of mother <s>Kaikeyī</s>, <s>Rāma</s>, the protector of the gods, sat on the throne.

children.text: पुरजन आय भेंट धरि आगे । बोले वचन प्रेम रस पागे ।।
children.translated_text: The citizens came and offered gifts before him, speaking words steeped in the essence of love.

children.text: नाथ आज बड़ि भाग्य हमारी । चरणकमलरजनयन निहारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'O Lord, today our fortune is great — our eyes behold the dust of your lotus feet.'

children.text: सुरनर असुर नाग मुनिदेवा ।
children.translated_text: Gods, men, demons, <s>Nāgas</s>, sages, and celestials

children.text: मिलिमिलिगयेन जान्योभेवा ॥
children.translated_text: all came together — no one recognized the secret.

children.text: छन्द ।।
children.translated_text: <s>Chanda</s> (meter) //

children.text: नहिं भेवकोऊ जान मिलि प्रभु देव मुनि हरषित चले ।
children.translated_text: No one recognized the secret; the gods and sages, having met the Lord, departed joyfully.

children.text: तब आय ब्रह्मा कीन अस्तुति जोरि युगबानी भले ॥
children.translated_text: Then <s>Brahmā</s> came and offered praise, joining his hands and speaking well:

children.text: अब नाथ चलिये लोक निज बहुभांति नर लीलाकरी ।
children.translated_text: 'Now, O Lord, return to Your own realm — You have performed the human play in many ways.'

children.text: मुनि देवतनकी बन्दि छोरी भार सब बसुधा हरी ॥
children.translated_text: 'You have liberated the gods and sages from bondage, and removed all the burden of the earth.'

children.text: सो० सुनि चतुरानन बैन प्रेम लपेटे रसभरे ।
children.translated_text: <s>Sorathā</s> // Hearing the words of the four-faced one (<s>Brahmā</s>), wrapped in love, filled with devotion,

children.text: विहँसे राजिवनैन उतर दीन्ह क्वउ जाननहिं ।।
children.translated_text: the lotus-eyed one (<s>Rāma</s>) smiled — the reply he gave, no one knows.

children.text: दो० रहे उमा हमहूं वहां देखा सकल समाज ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s> // O <s>Umā</s>, we too were there and saw the entire assembly;

children.text: प्रजासुखी अघलेश नहिं रामचन्द्रके राज ॥
children.translated_text: the people were happy, there was not the slightest sin — in the reign of <s>Rāmacandra</s>.

children.text: दूत चारि प्रभुलीन बुलाई । बोले वचन मधुर जलशाई ।।
children.translated_text: The Lord summoned four spies and spoke sweet words, [he] who reclines on the waters (<s>Viṣṇu</s>):

children.text: देशकोश पुर कुशल भुलाई । निशिदिनमोहिं सुनावहुआई ।।
children.translated_text: 'Go and bring me news of the welfare of the country, the treasury, and the city, day and night.'

children.text: आयसु पाय दूत हरषाने । निज निज कारजगये सयाने ।।
children.translated_text: Receiving the command, the spies were delighted; the wise ones went about their respective tasks.

children.text: दिनप्रति खबरि अवधपहुँचावैं । रामचरण पंकज शिरनावैं ।।
children.translated_text: Daily they brought news to <s>Ayodhyā</s>, bowing their heads at the lotus feet of <s>Rāma</s>.

children.text: बीते दिवस कछू यहि भांती । परमअनन्दअवध दिनराती ॥
children.translated_text: Days passed in this manner; supreme bliss prevailed in <s>Ayodhyā</s> day and night.

children.text: एक समय दशरथ कुलनायक । सुन्दरबदनश्यामसुखदायक ॥
children.translated_text: One day, the leader of the <s>Daśaratha</s> dynasty, beautiful-faced, dark-complexioned, giver of happiness,

children.text: राज सभा शोभित रघुराजा । अनुजसहितपुरलोगसमाजा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Raghurāja</s> was adorned in the royal court, together with his brothers and the assemblage of the city's people.

children.text: राजनीति मुनिराज सुनावें । सुनिप्रभुअनुजसहितसुखपावें ।।
children.translated_text: The king of sages (<s>Vasiṣṭha</s>) was expounding statecraft; the Lord, together with his brothers, listened with delight.

children.text: और विविध इतिहास पुराना । कहैं वशिष्ठ सुनैं भगवाना ।।
children.translated_text: And <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> narrated various histories and <s>Purāṇas</s>; the Lord listened.

children.text: दो० त्यहिअवसर यकदूत तहँ खबरि सुनायो आय ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s> // At that moment, a spy came there and brought news.

children.text: कछू प्रकट कछु राखिउर देखि सभा सकुचाय ॥
children.translated_text: Some he spoke openly, some he kept in his heart, seeing the assembly and feeling shy.

children.text: दूत दशा चक्रित प्रभु जाना । किम्पतगातअधरकुम्हिलाना ॥
children.translated_text: The Lord knew the spy's perplexed state — why his body was trembling and his lips had withered.

children.text: पूंछा निकट बुलाय सप्रीती । कहहु यथारथ नीतिअनीती ॥
children.translated_text: He summoned him near with affection and asked, 'Tell the truth, whether right or wrong.'

children.text: लाग्यो कहन दूत शिरनाई । सकल चरित रघुबरहिसुनाई ।।
children.translated_text: The spy began to speak with bowed head, narrating all the events to <s>Raghubara</s>.

children.text: नाथ एक रजगुन रिसिआई । पति गृहतजि कहुँरैनिगवाँई ।।
children.translated_text: 'O Lord, a washerman's wife, angered by some jealousy, left her husband's house and spent the night elsewhere.'

children.text: भोरभये प्रातहि उठि आई । देखत क्रोध रजक उर छाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'At dawn, in the morning, she returned; seeing her, the washerman's heart was filled with anger.'

children.text: मास्यो बहुविधि कहि कटुबानी । रेत्रिय निलज कलहकी खानी ॥
children.translated_text: 'He scolded her in many ways, speaking harsh words: Shameless one of the night! Mine of quarrel!'

children.text: राम समान मोहिं तैं जाने । रावणहरी नारिगृह आने ।।
children.translated_text: 'Do you think me to be like <s>Rāma</s>? Who brought home the woman taken by <s>Rāvaṇa</s>?'

children.text: उन सम मैं नहिं सुनु अपकारी । जो राखों त्वहिं बिना बिचारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'I am not like him — listen, you wretch — who kept you without consideration.'

children.text: वे समरथ कोशलपुर राऊ । भयवशकहतनअवधसमाऊ ॥
children.translated_text: 'He is the mighty king of <s>Kośala</s>; the people of <s>Ayodhyā</s> dare not speak out of fear.'

children.text: दो० बिने सब भाइनके कहे जो राखों तोहिं ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s> // 'Without the consent of all the brothers, if I keep you,

children.text: तुरत उठावें जाति ते जाति कबीला मोहिं ॥
children.translated_text: my caste and community will immediately expel me.'

children.text: दूतवचनअटपट सुनिकाना । सकलसभासुनिअतिदुखमाना ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the spy's confused words, all the assembly listened with great sorrow.

children.text: नीचजाति नहिं कीन बिचारा । जो असअनुचितबैनउचारा ॥
children.translated_text: 'The low-caste [man] did not reflect — that he uttered such improper words.'

children.text: भयउ शोचबश अवधसमाजू । विधिअबकीन्हचहतकाआजू ॥
children.translated_text: The assembly of <s>Ayodhyā</s> became grief-stricken — 'What has fate wrought today?'

children.text: जाना राम सभा भय पाई । बोले मधुर वचन हरषाई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Rāma</s> knew the assembly was afraid; he spoke sweet and cheerful words:

children.text: बीती निशा याम युगभाई । शयनकरहु निजनिजगृहजाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'The night has passed, two watches, O brothers; go to your respective homes and rest.'

children.text: आयसु पाय चरण शिरनाई । गये भवन सब करत बड़ाई ॥
children.translated_text: Receiving the command, bowing their heads at his feet, all went to their homes, singing his praises.

children.text: गुरु पद रेणु शीशधरि रामा । भाइनसहित गये निजधामा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Rāma</s>, placing the dust of the guru's feet on his head, went to his own abode with his brothers.

children.text: अनुजसमेत कीन्ह ज्यवनारा । पग धारे मन्दिर स्ववनारा ॥
children.translated_text: Together with his brothers, he performed the evening rites; he set foot in his own sleeping-chamber.

children.text: ज्यहि मन्दिर सोवहिं स्घुराई । रचना तासु बरणिनहिं जाई ॥
children.translated_text: The sleeping chamber where the Lord rested — its beauty cannot be described.

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Chanda</s> (meter) //

children.text: नहिं बनै बरणत धाम शोभा चहूं दिशि सुबरण मई ।
children.translated_text: The splendor of the abode cannot be described — on all four sides, made of fine gold.

children.text: बागीश शारद खोजि उपमा थकित ह्वौ बौरी भई ॥
children.translated_text: The lord of speech (<s>Bṛhaspati</s>) and <s>Śāradā</s> (<s>Sarasvatī</s>), searching for similes, became exhausted and bewildered.

children.text: मणिहेम मुकतालसित बहुविधि जगमगत देखतबनी ।
children.translated_text: Adorned in many ways with gems, gold, and pearls — dazzling, beautiful to behold.

children.text: मत शेष निगम पुराण सकुचत कौन विधि चेरेभनी ॥
children.translated_text: Even <s>Śeṣa</s>, the <s>Vedas</s>, and the <s>Purāṇas</s> hesitate — how then can a servant describe it?

children.text: दो० ज्यहिमन्दिर स्ववनार प्रमु विविध विचित्र वितान ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s> // In the sleeping chamber, with various wonderful canopies,

children.text: लखि रचना विधि चारमुख हृदय बहुत सकुचान ॥
children.translated_text: seeing the arrangement, even four-faced <s>Brahmā</s> felt greatly abashed in his heart.

children.text: पुानिसबभाइनआज्ञादीन्हा । निजनिजमहलशयन सबकीन्हा ॥
children.translated_text: The Lord gave leave to all the brothers; each went to their own palace and rested.

children.text: सोय राम परयङ्क सुहाई । पौढ़ीं सिया रजायसु पाई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Rāma</s> lay on the beautiful bed; <s>Sītā</s> reclined, having received his permission.

children.text: अति सियदेखि प्रसन्न कृपाला । बोलीं मञ्जुल गिरा रसाला ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing <s>Sītā</s>, the gracious Lord was exceedingly pleased; she spoke charming, delightful words:

children.text: नाथ विपिन महँ जोबर दीन्हा । अवशि नाथ सो चाहौं कीन्हा ॥
children.translated_text: 'O Lord, the boon that you gave in the forest — I certainly wish to fulfill it, O Lord.'

children.text: आयसुहोय जाउँ बन स्वामी । सुनहु बिनयममअन्तर्य्यामी ॥
children.translated_text: 'If you command, I shall go to the forest, O Master. Hear my prayer, O knower of my innermost heart.'

children.text: सुनि प्रभुसीता बचनमनोहर । सजहुसाजहँसिकह्योविहगबर ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing <s>Sītā</s>'s beautiful words, the Lord smiled and said, O best of birds, 'Make ready, prepare!'

children.text: भोर होतप्रिय करहु पयाना । जायहु विपिनवचनपरमाना ॥
children.translated_text: 'At dawn, beloved, set forth on the journey; go to the forest — that is the proof of my word.'

children.text: बोलत हँसत नयन अलसाने । सोवन हेतु पीतपट ताने ॥
children.translated_text: Speaking and smiling, his eyes grew drowsy; he drew the yellow cloth over himself for sleep.

children.text: राम सियासोवत यक साथा । लखिशोभारतिकामलजाता ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Rāma</s> and <s>Sītā</s> sleeping together — seeing the beauty, <s>Rati</s> and <s>Kāma</s> were born anew.

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Chanda</s> (meter) //

children.text: रतिकाम होहिं सनाथ शोभा देखि सीता रामकी ।
children.translated_text: <s>Rati</s> and <s>Kāma</s> became fulfilled seeing the beauty of <s>Sītā</s> and <s>Rāma</s>,

children.text: बरणत परस्पर छबिसुहावन राम सुखमा धामकी ॥
children.translated_text: describing to each other the charming beauty of <s>Rāma</s>, the abode of grace.

children.text: भये भोरप्रथम विदेहतनया सखी सँग महलनगई ।
children.translated_text: At dawn, first the daughter of <s>Videha</s> went to the palace with her companions,

children.text: गहि चरण कौशल्या सुमित्रा केकयी आशिषलई ॥
children.translated_text: clasped the feet of <s>Kauśalyā</s>, <s>Sumitrā</s>, and <s>Kaikeyī</s>, and received their blessings.

children.text: बहुभांति सासुन दीन्ह आशिष चूमि बदन निहारहीं ।
children.translated_text: The mothers-in-law gave blessings in many ways, kissing her face and gazing upon her;

children.text: चेरे सकल रनिवास दशरथ हेम मणिगण वारहीं ॥
children.translated_text: all the servants, the entire royal household — <s>Daśaratha</s>'s queens — waved gold and jewels [in blessing].

children.text: दो० होत प्रात रघुकुल तिलक करि सरयू अस्नान ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s> // At dawn, the tilaka of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty, having bathed in the <s>Sarayū</s>,

children.text: तबहिं नहाय वशिष्ठ पहँ आये कृपानिधान ॥
children.translated_text: the treasury of mercy came, having bathed, to [the presence of] <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>.

children.text: गुरु पूजाकरि विविध प्रकारा । आये गृह अवधेश कुमारा ॥
children.translated_text: Having worshipped the guru in various ways, the prince of <s>Ayodhyā</s> returned home.

children.text: सब मातन पदनायो माथा । आशिष पाय हरषिरघुनाथा ॥
children.translated_text: He bowed his head at the feet of all the mothers; receiving blessings, <s>Raghunātha</s> was gladdened.

children.text: भरत लषण रिपुसूदन बीरा । आये जहँ राजित रघुबीरा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Bharata</s>, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, and <s>Ripusūdana</s> (<s>Śatrughna</s>), the heroes, came to where <s>Raghubīra</s> sat resplendent.

children.text: कीन्ह प्रणाम जोरि युग पानी । दीन अशीष राम सुखमानी ॥
children.translated_text: They made obeisance with joined palms; <s>Rāma</s>, pleased, gave blessings.

children.text: बहुरि जाय मातन शिर नावा । आशिषपाय परम सुखपावा ॥
children.translated_text: Then they went and bowed their heads to the mothers; receiving blessings, they attained supreme happiness.

children.text: पुनि सीता पद नायोशीशा । लह्योपरमसुख पाय अशीशा ॥
children.translated_text: Then they bowed their heads at <s>Sītā</s>'s feet; receiving her blessing, they attained supreme bliss.

children.text: भोजन कीन्ह संग सब भाई । बैठे प्रभु सिंहासन जाई ॥
children.translated_text: They ate together, all the brothers; the Lord sat on the throne.

children.text: पुरबासी सब आय जुहारी । आदर सहित राम बैठारी ॥
children.translated_text: All the citizens came and saluted; <s>Rāma</s> seated them with respect.

children.text: आये तब बशिष्ठ मुनिज्ञानी । करिदण्डवत मुनिहिंसनमानी ॥
children.translated_text: Then came the wise sage <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>; prostrating before the sage, they honored him.

children.text: दो० लगेकहन मुनिराजतब राजनीति कुल रीति ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s> // The king of sages then began to speak of statecraft and family tradition;

children.text: सुनहिंरामभाइनसहित अतिआनन्दसप्रीति ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Rāma</s> and his brothers listened with great joy and delight.

children.text: सन्ध्या जानि उठे भगवाना । सरयू जाय कीन्ह अस्नाना ॥
children.translated_text: Knowing it was evening, the Lord rose, went to the <s>Sarayū</s>, and bathed.

children.text: करिनित कर्म्म भवनप्रभुआये । भारतको तब बोलि पठाये ॥
children.translated_text: Performing the daily rites, the Lord came home; then he sent for <s>Bharata</s>.

children.text: आय भरत प्रभुपद शिरनाई । बैठे राम रजायसु पाई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Bharata</s> came and bowed his head at the Lord's feet; he sat down, having received <s>Rāma</s>'s permission.

children.text: बोले रामचन्द्र युग पावन । सुधासुरस मृदुवचनसुहावन ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Rāmacandra</s>, purifier of both worlds, spoke soft, sweet, nectarean words:

children.text: तात कहौं तुमसन यह बानी । सियबनगमन प्रात मैं ठानी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Dear brother, I tell you this matter: I have resolved upon <s>Sītā</s>'s departure to the forest at dawn.'

children.text: सकहु तो तात पठैबनआवहु । भेदन यहतुमसियहिसुनावहु ॥
children.translated_text: 'If you can, dear brother, send her to the forest; and convey this decision to <s>Sītā</s>.'

children.text: दूत वचन सुनिकै निजकाना । ताते असप्रण अब मैं ठाना ॥
children.translated_text: 'Having heard the spy's words with my own ears, therefore I have now made this resolve.'

children.text: सुनि प्रभुवचन भरत रणधीरा । भयो विकल लोचनबहनीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the Lord's words, <s>Bharata</s>, brave in battle, became distraught, his eyes streaming with tears.

children.text: हृदयशोच मुख आव न बानी । समय देखि कछु कह्यो भवानी ॥
children.translated_text: Grief was in his heart, no words came to his mouth; seeing the occasion, he said something, O <s>Bhavānī</s> [said <s>Śiva</s>].

children.text: दो० धरिधीरज बोले भरत सुनहु भानुकुलचन्द ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s> // Gathering courage, <s>Bharata</s> spoke: 'Hear me, O moon of the solar dynasty;

children.text: प्रति उत्तर नहिं दैसकों बिनयकरों रघुनन्द ॥
children.translated_text: I cannot give a reply — I make a humble request, O <s>Raghunandana</s>.'

children.text: सियको कहा दोष प्रभुलाई । जो असप्रणकरिमोहिंसुनाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'What fault, O Lord, have you ascribed to <s>Sītā</s>, that you tell me of such a resolve?'

children.text: आयसु नाथकरों शिर राखी । फिरनअवधआवोंअसभाखी ॥
children.translated_text: 'I place the Lord's command upon my head; I shall carry it out — but I declare that I shall not return to <s>Ayodhyā</s>.'

children.text: कह करजोरि शपथ प्रभुतोरी । मैं नहिं आउब अवधबहोरी ॥
children.translated_text: 'I say with joined hands, swearing by you, O Lord: I shall not come back to <s>Ayodhyā</s> again.'

children.text: सुनि लघुभ्रात वचन रघुराई । सियपद प्रीति बहुतदृढ़पाई ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the words of his younger brother, the lord of the <s>Raghus</s> — his love for <s>Sītā</s>'s feet being very firm —

children.text: कहिबहुचरितअनुज समुझाई । बहुरि राम रिपुदवनबुलाई ॥
children.translated_text: spoke many tales to instruct his younger brother, then called <s>Ripudavana</s> (the destroyer of enemies, <s>Śatrughna</s>).

children.text: आय शत्रुहन बैठि निहोरी । दण्डप्रणाम कीन्ह करजोरी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śatrughna</s> came, sat humbly, made prostrations, and stood with palms joined.

children.text: आशिष दीन्ह निकट बैठावा । अति सुन्दरमृदुबचनसुनावा ॥
children.translated_text: [<s>Rāma</s>] blessed him, seated him near, and spoke very beautiful, gentle words.

children.text: सुनु शत्रुहन कीन्ह प्रण येही । आवहु छोड़ विपिन वैदेही ॥
children.translated_text: 'Listen, <s>Śatrughna</s> — I have made this vow: bring <s>Vaidehī</s> (<s>Sītā</s>) from the forest.'

children.text: इतना करहु तात हरषाई । साजिबिमान सियहि लैजाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Do this much, dear father [brother] — joyfully prepare the chariot and take <s>Sītā</s> away.'

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Verse:

children.text: रथसाजि सियहि चढ़ाय प्रातहिकाल बन लैजाइये ।
children.translated_text: 'Ready the chariot, seat <s>Sītā</s>, and take her to the forest at dawn;

children.text: जहँ सघनबन तहँरारिव सीतहि तात फिर पुरआइये ॥
children.translated_text: where the forest is dense, there leave <s>Sītā</s>, O brother, and return to the city.'

children.text: यहि भांति कह करुणाअयन रिपुदवनसुनि ठगिसे रहे ।
children.translated_text: Thus spoke the ocean of compassion; hearing this, <s>Ripudavana</s> (the destroyer of enemies) stood dazed.

children.text: कहि दासचेरे प्रेमवश गहि चरण मृदु बानी कहे ॥
children.translated_text: The servant [<s>Śatrughna</s>] said — overcome by love, holding [<s>Rāma</s>'s] feet, he spoke gentle words:

children.text: असकवनचूक विचारि प्रभु जो जानकी को परिहरी ।
children.translated_text: 'Considering such a fault, O lord, if <s>Jānakī</s> is abandoned —

children.text: यह समय नहिं सिय बसहिंबन इतनो कहो मेरोकरी ॥
children.translated_text: this is not the time for <s>Sītā</s> to dwell in the forest; please say this much for my sake.'

children.text: बरसहिं जो बालक अवधमें तब नाथआयसुशिरधरों ।
children.translated_text: 'If children are born in <s>Ayodhyā</s>, then, O lord, I shall bear your command upon my head;

children.text: कछु कालबीते उचित अस रघुबंशमणि बिनतीकरों ॥
children.translated_text: after some time passes, this would be fitting — I make this humble request, O jewel of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty.'

children.text: सो० यदपिकही अति नीति रिपुसूदन भारत अनुज ।
children.translated_text: Although <s>Ripusūdana</s> (destroyer of foes), younger brother of <s>Bharata</s>, spoke with great propriety,

children.text: बोले वचन सप्रीति विहँसि रामरघुकुल तिलक ।
children.translated_text: <s>Rāma</s>, the tilaka-mark of the <s>Raghu</s> lineage, smiling, spoke words of affection:

children.text: नहिं त्यागों जो जनक कुमारी । लेहुं अयश शिरपातकभारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Even if I do not abandon the daughter of <s>Janaka</s>, I shall bear great infamy and the burden of sin upon my head.'

children.text: होय पाप भलकहै न कोई । करहु उपाय तात अब सोई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Sin will ensue; no one will speak well [of it]. Therefore, brother, now adopt that very course

children.text: जेहि न होय पाछे पछितावा । अस विचार मोरे मन आवा ॥
children.translated_text: by which there would be no regret afterwards — such is the thought that has come to my mind.'

children.text: रघुबंशिन के कुल चलि आई । प्राणजाय बरु वचन न जाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'In the lineage of the <s>Raghus</s>, a tradition has endured: let life depart, but let one's word not fail.'

children.text: भोर होत सिय संग लिवाई । त्यागि विपिनमा आवोभाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'At dawn, taking <s>Sītā</s> along with you, abandoning [her] in the forest, return, O brother.'

children.text: प्रभुरुखलखि शोचे रिपुदमनू । जानासत्यविपिन सियगमनू ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the lord's face, <s>Ripudamana</s> (the enemy-tamer) grieved; he realized that <s>Sītā</s>'s going to the forest was certain.

children.text: अतिव्याकुलतनकीसुधिनाहीं । परेतुरित मूर्च्छितक्षितिमाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: Extremely agitated, with no awareness of his own body, he fell to the ground in haste, unconscious.

children.text: देखि अनुज गति श्रीरघुराई । सियबिछोहदुखउरअधिकाई ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing his younger brother's state, the glorious lord of the <s>Raghus</s> — the sorrow of separation from <s>Sītā</s> further increasing his grief —

children.text: कह प्रिय वचन रामरणधीरा । समुझायो रिपुसूदन बीरा ॥
children.translated_text: spoke dear words; <s>Rāma</s>, steadfast in battle, consoled the valiant <s>Ripusūdana</s>.

children.text: दो० आयसु दीन्ही जाहु गृह चले चरण शिरनाय ।
children.translated_text: He gave the command: 'Go home.' [<s>Śatrughna</s>] departed, bowing his head at [<s>Rāma</s>'s] feet.

children.text: षठय दूत लिये बोलि तब लक्ष्मणकहँ रघुराय ॥
children.translated_text: Then the lord of the <s>Raghus</s> summoned <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, having called the six messengers.

children.text: लक्ष्मण आय चरण शिरनाई । दीन्ह अशीष मुदितरघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> came and bowed his head at [<s>Rāma</s>'s] feet; the delighted lord of the <s>Raghus</s> gave his blessing.

children.text: अति विनीत बोले मृदुबानी । प्रभुआगे अब सुनहुभवानी ॥
children.translated_text: Very humbly, he spoke in gentle words — now listen, O <s>Bhavānī</s> — before the lord:

children.text: आयसु होय नाथ सो करहूँ । बार बार पद पङ्कज धरहूं ॥
children.translated_text: 'Whatever command the lord gives, I shall carry it out; again and again I hold your lotus-feet.'

children.text: कौनसोकाज जाहिलगिस्वामी । कीन शोच उर अन्तर्य्यामी ॥
children.translated_text: 'What is that task, for which my master — the inner-controller — has worried in his heart?'

children.text: जो सेवकहि रजायसु होई । पद शिरनाय करी प्रभू सोई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Whatever command the servant receives — bowing head at your feet, the lord carries out that very thing.'

children.text: जो न करों आयसु रघुनाथा । तौ न धरों धनुशायक हाथा ॥
children.translated_text: 'If I do not carry out the command of the lord of the <s>Raghus</s>, then I shall not bear bow and arrow in my hands.'

children.text: जबलग जीव रहै तनस्वामी । तबलगमोहिंजान्योअनुगामी ॥
children.translated_text: 'As long as life remains in this body, O master, know me as your follower for that long.'

children.text: सेवक धर्म्म स्वामि सेवकाई । करियसदातनमन चितलाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'The dharma of a servant is the service of the master; one should always do it with body, mind, and heart.'

children.text: जो प्रभुकहों कपट छल राखी । ईश सजाय देहिंशिव साखी ॥
children.translated_text: 'If the lord speaks with deceit and guile — let <s>Śiva</s> be witness — let God punish me.'

children.text: दो० अनुज वचन सुन्दर सलिल विगत मोहमदमान ।
children.translated_text: Hearing the younger brother's beautiful words — like pure water, free of delusion, pride, and arrogance —

children.text: सुनि हरषे रघुकुल कमल बोले वचन प्रमान ॥
children.translated_text: the lotus of the <s>Raghu</s> lineage was gladdened and spoke measured words:

children.text: तुम सब लायक शीलनिधाना । बीर धुरीण तात मैं जाना ॥
children.translated_text: 'You are fit in all ways, O treasury of good conduct, O foremost of heroes — this, brother, I know.'

children.text: कस न नीति राखो तुम भाई । दीन सबै बिधि ईश बड़ाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'How should you not keep propriety, brother? God has bestowed greatness in every way.'

children.text: अस प्रण कीन्ह सुनो मैं ताता । गवनहिंबनसिय होतप्रभाता ॥
children.translated_text: 'I have made this vow — listen, brother: <s>Sītā</s> must go to the forest at dawn.'

children.text: विपिनत्यागि मिथिलेशकुमारी । आवहु तात जाउँ बलिहारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Abandon the daughter of the lord of <s>Mithilā</s> in the forest and return, brother — I am at your mercy.'

children.text: सुनत वचन रघुवंश खरारी । लक्ष्मणउर असमञ्जसभारी ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the words of the <s>Raghu</s> prince, the slayer of <s>Khara</s>, a great confusion weighed upon <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>'s heart.

children.text: भई दशा लक्ष्मणकी कैसी । पङ्ख बिहीन बिहँगतिजैसी ॥
children.translated_text: What became of <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>'s state! — like a bird without wings.

children.text: जो सियको आवों बन त्यागी । मोहिंसमानकोअधमअभागी ॥
children.translated_text: 'If I abandon <s>Sītā</s> and bring her from the forest, who is as wretched and ill-fated as I?'

children.text: जो न राम आयसु अनुसरहूँ । कोटिनजन्मअयश शिरधरहूँ ॥
children.translated_text: 'If I do not follow <s>Rāma</s>'s command, I shall bear infamy upon my head for ten million births.'

children.text: दोउभांति दारुणदुख ब्यापा । बरणैको उर लषण कलापा ॥
children.translated_text: On both sides, terrible suffering pervaded; who can describe the constellation of sorrows in <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>'s heart?

children.text: दो० पुनि धरिधीरज लक्ष्मण हाथजोरि शिरनाय ।
children.translated_text: Then, gathering courage, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, with joined palms, bowed his head

children.text: बोले सन्मुख अवधपति गिरा विनीतसुहाय ॥
children.translated_text: and spoke before the lord of <s>Ayodhyā</s>, in words humble and pleasing:

children.text: यदपिनाथअनुचितमहा त्यागनजनककुमारि ।
children.translated_text: 'Although, O lord, the abandonment of the daughter of <s>Janaka</s> is a great impropriety,

children.text: तदपि नाथ आयसुकरब सेवकधर्म विचारि ॥
children.translated_text: even so, O lord, I shall carry out the command, considering the dharma of a servant.'

children.text: उठेत्वरित तजिसकल गलाना । कह्यो सारथी साज विमाना ॥
children.translated_text: He rose quickly, casting off all hesitation, and told the charioteer to prepare the vehicle.

children.text: सियपहँ गये विकलअति भारी । दोउकरजोरिविनयअनुसारी ॥
children.translated_text: He went to <s>Sītā</s>, extremely distressed, with palms joined, following the path of humility.

children.text: मातु विपिनकर साजहु साजा । आयसुमोहिं दीन्हरघुराजा ॥
children.translated_text: 'Mother, make preparations for the forest. The lord of the <s>Raghus</s> has given me this command.'

children.text: चलहु विपिन आवहुँ पहुँचाई । सेवक उचितस्वामिसेवकाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Come to the forest; I shall escort you and return. The service of the master is the proper duty of a servant.'

children.text: सिय समुझ्यो नहिं देवरबानी । सुनतवचनअतिशयहरषानी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Sītā</s> did not understand her brother-in-law's words; hearing them, she was exceedingly delighted.

children.text: बहु भोजन पकवान मिठाई । भूषण वसन गिनाय न जाई ॥
children.translated_text: Many foods, delicacies, and sweets, ornaments and garments — beyond counting —

children.text: होत प्रात सिय रथ बैठाई । लक्ष्मणचले राम शिरनाई ॥
children.translated_text: at dawn, <s>Sītā</s> was seated in the chariot; <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> departed, bowing to <s>Rāma</s>.

children.text: चलतसियाअशकुनभये भारी । तदपिलख्योनहिंजनककुमारी ॥
children.translated_text: As <s>Sītā</s> departed, there were great ill omens; yet the daughter of <s>Janaka</s> did not notice them.

children.text: हांक्यो रथ लक्ष्मण बलवाना । पवनथकितअतिवेगउड़ाना ॥
children.translated_text: The mighty <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> drove the chariot; the wind, wearied, could not match its speed.

children.text: दो० उतरि नदि तमसात्वरित दीख गोमती आय ।
children.translated_text: Quickly crossing the <s>Tamasā</s> river, the <s>Gomatī</s> came into view.

children.text: नित्यक्रियाकरि सियसहित पहुंचेसुरसरिजाय ॥
children.translated_text: Performing the daily rites along with <s>Sītā</s>, they reached the divine river [the <s>Gaṅgā</s>].

children.text: रथते उतरि कीन्ह परणामा । सियसमेत लक्ष्मणबलधामा ॥
children.translated_text: Descending from the chariot, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, the abode of strength, along with <s>Sītā</s>, made obeisance.

children.text: भोर होत उतरे सुरसरी । सघन बिपिनकी मारगधरी ॥
children.translated_text: At dawn, they crossed the divine river and took the path through the dense forest.

children.text: देखिबिपिनघनअतिआँधियारी । केहरिनाद करैं जहँ भारी ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the forest, dense and extremely dark, where terrible lion-roars resounded —

children.text: देखि बिटप बट छांह घनेरो । सियलक्ष्मणतहँलीन्ह बसेरो ॥
children.translated_text: seeing the dense shade of the banyan tree, <s>Sītā</s> and <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> rested there.

children.text: बिन भोजन सो बासर खोई । बटतर दोउमूरति रहे साई ॥
children.translated_text: That day passed without food; the two figures remained at the foot of the banyan.

children.text: निशाबिगत सोवत सियजागी । देखिबिषमबनअतिभयलागी ॥
children.translated_text: The night ended; <s>Sītā</s> woke while sleeping — seeing the terrible forest, great fear seized her.

children.text: सहम सहितलक्ष्मणसों बोली । पीपर पात सरिस तन डोली ॥
children.translated_text: With trembling, she spoke to <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, her body shaking like a pipal leaf:

children.text: यह बननहिं जहँ मुनितपकरहीं । खगमृगमुदितबैरतजिफिरहीं ॥
children.translated_text: 'This is not a forest where sages perform austerities, where birds and beasts roam happily, having abandoned enmity.'

children.text: यह बन तात भयंकर भारी । डरपतउर बनघनहिं निहारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'This forest, brother, is frightful and terrible; my heart trembles just gazing upon the dense woods.'

children.text: दो० मैं जान्यों रघुनाथ मोहिं परम पातकी जान ।
children.translated_text: 'I understand: the lord of the <s>Raghus</s> considers me a great sinner;

children.text: गवहिं निकास्यो देशते दशरथ कुलके भान ॥
children.translated_text: the sun of <s>Daśaratha</s>'s lineage has expelled me from the land.'

children.text: ताते यह बन नाथ पठई । जहँमोहिंबाघ सिंहधरिखाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Therefore, the lord has sent me to this forest, where tigers and lions may seize and devour me.'

children.text: तुमाहिं न दोष तात कछुलागी । मैं पापिनि सब भांतिअभागी ॥
children.translated_text: 'No fault attaches to you, brother; I am a sinful woman, ill-fated in every way.'

children.text: असकहिपुनिबिलापकरिसीता । देखिविपिनभइअधिकसभीता ॥
children.translated_text: Having said this, <s>Sītā</s> lamented again; seeing the forest, she became even more terrified.

children.text: हा रधुनाथ कीन नहिं नीका । तज्योमोहिं दशरथकुलटीका ॥
children.translated_text: 'Alas, the lord of the <s>Raghus</s> has not done right — the tilaka-mark of <s>Daśaratha</s>'s lineage has abandoned me!'

children.text: नाथ समुझिदेखो मनमाहीं । तुमबिन प्राण रहैं घटनाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: 'O lord, reflect and see within your heart — without you, my life-breath cannot remain in this body.'

children.text: तुम सब लायक त्रिभुवनईशा । काहविचारितज्यो जगदीशा ॥
children.translated_text: 'You are worthy of all — lord of the three worlds! Whom did you consult before abandoning me, O lord of the universe?'

children.text: देखिसियागति लक्ष्मणयोधा । विधिगतिबामसमुझिपरबोधा ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing <s>Sītā</s>'s state, the warrior <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, understanding fate's adverse course, consoled her.

children.text: धरो धीर कह लषण सुबानी । पोंछ्यो नेत्रनयन निजपानी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Take courage,' said <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> in gentle words, wiping the tears from his own eyes.

children.text: तलफतबहुत विकल बिनुबारी । सूख्यो कण्ठ विदेहकुमारी ॥
children.translated_text: Greatly distressed, yearning without water, the daughter of <s>Videha</s>'s throat had dried up.

children.text: लाय हाथमुख सियजलमांगी । देखिलषण उर दायालागी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Sītā</s> asked for water, bringing her hand to her mouth; seeing this, compassion arose in <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>'s heart.

children.text: धरो धीर जल लावों माता । असकहिबचनचलेसुरज्ञाता ॥
children.translated_text: 'Take courage — I shall bring water, mother.' Saying these words, the knower of the gods departed.

children.text: दो० देखी लक्ष्ममण सियागति बिनजल त्यागतप्राण ।
children.translated_text: Seeing <s>Sītā</s>'s state — abandoning her life without water —

children.text: चलेलेन जल विकल अति योजन एक प्रमाण ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, greatly distressed, went to fetch water, a distance of about one <s>yojana</s> (eight miles).

children.text: करुणा करत विविध बैदेही । सो दुखबरणिजाय अबकेही ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Vaidehī</s> (<s>Sītā</s>) made various lamentations — that suffering, who can describe it now?

children.text: परीमुरछि व्याकुल क्षितिमाहीं । देखिदशा बनचर अकुलाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: She fell unconscious, distraught upon the ground; seeing her state, the forest creatures were agitated.

children.text: रघुबरबिरह शूल उर व्यापी । दारुणबिपतिअधिकतनकांपी ॥
children.translated_text: The lance of separation from the lord of the <s>Raghus</s> pierced her heart; from the terrible calamity, her body trembled greatly.

children.text: दुखितश्रमितगइसोयभवानी । लक्ष्मणतबजलघटभरिआनी ॥
children.translated_text: Grieved and exhausted, O <s>Bhavānī</s>, she fell asleep; then <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> brought a pot filled with water.

children.text: लखिमुर्च्छितक्षितिअवनिकुमारी । भेलक्ष्मणदुखकेअधिकारी ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the daughter of the earth lying unconscious on the ground, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> became the master of even greater sorrow.

children.text: भसम होन हित रच्यो उपाई । नभबानी त्यहि समय सुनाई ॥
children.translated_text: He devised a plan to offer [last rites]; at that very moment, a voice from the sky was heard:

children.text: गवनहु लषण अवधकीघाहीं । जियै बाल कछुसंशय नाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: 'Go, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, to the road to <s>Ayodhyā</s>; the child will live — there is no doubt.'

children.text: सुनि नभगिरा लषणबलधारी । चढ़ि बटडार बांधिघटबारी ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the sky-voice, the mighty <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> climbed a banyan branch and tied the water-pot [for her].

children.text: धरि धीरज उर अनुज खरारी । जोततुरितरथ अवधसिधारी ॥
children.translated_text: Holding courage in his heart, the younger brother, the slayer of <s>Khara</s>, yoked the chariot swiftly and set off for <s>Ayodhyā</s>.

children.text: दो० मनहींमन पद बन्दि सिय बहुविधि कीन्ह निहोर ।
children.translated_text: In his heart, he bowed at <s>Sītā</s>'s feet and entreated her in many ways.

children.text: मन मलीन तन क्षीण अति हांक्यो रथ पुरओर ॥
children.translated_text: With mind heavy and body extremely emaciated, he drove the chariot toward the city.

children.text: त्यागि सिया बन सघन अनेरी । लक्ष्मण अवधचले रथफेरी ॥
children.translated_text: Abandoning <s>Sītā</s> in the dark, dense forest, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> turned the chariot back toward <s>Ayodhyā</s>.

children.text: सिया विरह अति दीन दुखारी । भयसभीत प्रियबन्धु खरारी ॥
children.translated_text: Extremely wretched and sorrowful from separation from <s>Sītā</s>, fearful — the dear brother, the slayer of <s>Khara</s>.

children.text: चौथे दिवस अवध में आई । रघुनायक पद शीश नवाई ॥
children.translated_text: On the fourth day, he arrived in <s>Ayodhyā</s>; he bowed his head at the feet of the lord of the <s>Raghus</s>.

children.text: पूछा रामसिया कुशलाई । तजिक्यहिबनसियआयहुभाई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Rāma</s> asked about <s>Sītā</s>'s well-being: 'Where have you abandoned <s>Sītā</s> in the forest, and returned, brother?'

children.text: ब्रह्मावर्त्त सघन बन भारी । आयों त्यागि विदेह कुमारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'In <s>Brahmāvarta</s>, in the great dense forest, I have abandoned the daughter of <s>Videha</s>.'

children.text: नाथ विरह गइ मुरि भवानी । तबमैं चल्यों प्रभुशारँगपानी ॥
children.translated_text: 'O lord, <s>Bhavānī</s> fainted from the separation; then I departed, O lord <s>Śārṅgapāṇi</s> (bow-bearing <s>Rāma</s>).'

children.text: सुनि रघुबीर हृदय दुख पावा । पुनिनिजराज्यकाजचितलावा ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing this, the hero of the <s>Raghus</s> felt sorrow in his heart; then he turned his mind to the affairs of his kingdom.

children.text: सुनियहचरितसकलपुरबासी । शोच प्रबशहरिलेत उसासी ॥
children.translated_text: All the residents of the city heard this account; overcome by grief, they drew sighs.

children.text: एककहैंनहिं विधिभलकीन्हा । जोअसबिपतिजानकिहिदीन्हा ॥
children.translated_text: Some said: 'Fate has not done well — that such a calamity was given to <s>Jānakī</s>.'

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Verse:

children.text: असबिपतिदीनजोजानकी बिनकाजरघुबरपरिहरी ।
children.translated_text: 'Such a calamity was given to <s>Jānakī</s> — the lord of the <s>Raghus</s> abandoned her without cause;

children.text: जगसकल अपयशमोटबांधिबनायशिर अपनेधरी ॥
children.translated_text: he bound upon his own head the whole world's great infamy.'

children.text: असकहैंपुर नरनारिमिलि दशपांच उरशोचहिंसही ।
children.translated_text: Thus spoke the men and women of the city, gathering in groups of ten or five, mourning in their hearts.

children.text: गुरूसचिवकिोउनबुझाय रामहिं उचितकीबातेंकही ॥
children.translated_text: No guru or minister could make <s>Rāma</s> understand; they spoke appropriate words [but in vain].

children.text: सो० विधि असकरतब कीन्ह हस्यो बुद्धि पुरलोग सब ।
children.translated_text: When fate acts thus, the wisdom of all the city's people is mocked.

children.text: कोउ न मंत्र असदीन्ह समय नहीं सिय बसहिं बन ॥
children.translated_text: No one gave such counsel: 'This is not the time for <s>Sītā</s> to dwell in the forest.'

children.text: चेरे पुर नर नारि शोचहिं व्याकुल जहँ सुनहिं ।
children.translated_text: The men and women of the city grieved, distressed wherever they heard [the news],

children.text: यथा मीन बिन बारि तलफैं दोष लगाय विधि ॥
children.translated_text: like fish floundering without water, blaming fate.

children.text: कौशल्यादि मातु उर शोचू । किमिकहिसकौंकहैंविधिपोचू ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Kausalyā</s> and the other mothers grieved in their hearts: 'How can one describe the cruelty of fate!'

children.text: भयो देश पुर शोक निवासू । कहैं दीन प्रभुसिय बनबासु ॥
children.translated_text: The country and city became an abode of sorrow; they lamented: 'Our lord has sent <s>Sītā</s> to the forest.'

children.text: यह इतिहास अनूपम गाई । आगे कहों सुनो खगराई ॥
children.translated_text: I have sung this incomparable history; listen further, O king of birds.

children.text: जब लक्ष्मण आये पहुंचाई । सभयविपिनप्रभुआयसुपाई ॥
children.translated_text: When <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> came after escorting her — fearful, in the forest, having received the lord's command —

children.text: पस्यो बुन्द जल घट मुखमाहीं । जागी सिय कहुं कोऊ नाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: a few drops of water fell into her mouth from the pot; <s>Sītā</s> woke — no one was there.

children.text: अतिब्याकुलकरि रोदनभारी । हा लक्ष्मणतुमसमहितकारी ॥
children.translated_text: Extremely agitated, crying loudly: 'Alas, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>! You have done such a thing to me!'

children.text: क्यहि अपराध मोहिंतुमत्यागे । गयोअवध लखिसोवतभागे ॥
children.translated_text: 'For what offense have you abandoned me? You have gone to <s>Ayodhyā</s>, fleeing while I slept!'

children.text: तुमहिं देखि कछुधीरजरह्यऊ । तुमबिनअधिकमोहिंदुखभयऊ ॥
children.translated_text: 'Seeing you, I had some courage; without you, my suffering and fear have greatly increased.'

children.text: अब क्यहिभांतिधरों उरधीरा । देखिविपिनअतिगहनगँभीरा ॥
children.translated_text: 'Now how shall I hold courage in my heart, seeing this forest so dense and deep?'

children.text: दो० यहिप्रकार अबजानकी शीशधुनहि बिलखाय ।
children.translated_text: In this manner, <s>Jānakī</s> shook her head and wept.

children.text: समय बिषाद न जातकहि काहूते खगराय ॥
children.translated_text: The grief of that time cannot be told by anyone, O king of birds.

children.text: गमनविपिनतबसुनिखगपाला । बायससों बोले त्यहिकाला ॥
children.translated_text: Then, hearing of [her] going to the forest, O protector of birds, the crow spoke at that time:

children.text: पूछों नाथ चरण शिरनाई । यह कौतुक प्रभु मोहिंसुनाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'I ask, O lord, bowing head at your feet — tell me this marvel, O lord.'

children.text: माया कृत अवतार भवानी । नेतिनेति कहिनिगमबखानी ॥
children.translated_text: '<s>Bhavānī</s> is an incarnation created by <s>Māyā</s> — the <s>Vedas</s> describe her as "not this, not this" (<s>neti neti</s>).'

children.text: जासु दृष्टि जग यावत माया । होहिं नाथ परिपूरण काया ॥
children.translated_text: 'By whose glance the world and all <s>Māyā</s> exist, O lord — complete embodied forms —'

children.text: शारद शेष देव मुनि वृन्दा । सेवहिं चरणत्यागिछलछन्दा ॥
children.translated_text: '<s>Śārada</s>, <s>Śeṣa</s>, hosts of gods and sages serve her feet, abandoning deceit and guile.'

children.text: सोकि विदेह सुता बन योगू । सुनिकौतुकबिस्मितभयेलोगू ॥
children.translated_text: 'Is it fitting that the daughter of <s>Videha</s> should dwell in the forest? The people were amazed and bewildered hearing this marvel.'

children.text: कहहु बुझाय सो बायसनाथा । कससियत्यागकीन्हरघुनाथा ॥
children.translated_text: 'Tell me, explain it, O lord of crows — why did the lord of the <s>Raghus</s> abandon <s>Sītā</s>?'

children.text: सुनि खगेश के बचन अनूपा । साधुसाधु कह बायस भूपा ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the incomparable words of the king of birds, the crow-king said: 'Well said, well said!'

children.text: प्रश्न तुम्हार नाथ म्वहिं भाई । चाहहु सुनन रामप्रभुताई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Your question, O lord, pleases me; you wish to hear the glory of Lord <s>Rāma</s>.'

children.text: सो० कहा वचन असकाग खग आगे करजोरिकर ।
children.translated_text: The crow said these words to the king of birds, with palms joined:

children.text: चरितसुनावनलागज्यहिकारणप्रभुत्यागिसिय ॥
children.translated_text: 'I shall narrate the story — the reason why the lord abandoned <s>Sītā</s>.'

children.text: सियहि जोत्यागकीन्हरघुबीरा । सुनहुसो भेवगरु ड़मतिधीरा ॥
children.translated_text: 'The reason why the hero of the <s>Raghus</s> abandoned <s>Sītā</s> — listen, O <s>Garuḍa</s> of steady mind, to that secret.'

children.text: जबप्रभुजीति समरदशशीशा । अवधचलनचाह्योजगदीशा ॥
children.translated_text: 'When the lord defeated the ten-headed [<s>Rāvaṇa</s>] in battle, the lord of the universe wished to go to <s>Ayodhyā</s>.'

children.text: देव सबै तेहि अवसर आई । विनयविनयजकोकसिधाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'All the gods came at that time, humbly offering salutations to the king.'

children.text: ताहि समय दशेरथ नृप आये । रामहिं देखि नयन जल छाये ॥
children.translated_text: 'At that time, King <s>Daśaratha</s> came; seeing <s>Rāma</s>, his eyes filled with tears.'

children.text: पितहि प्रणाम कीन्ह रघुराई । सीता अनुजसहितखगराई ॥
children.translated_text: 'The lord of the <s>Raghus</s> made prostrations to his father, along with <s>Sītā</s> and his younger brother, O king of birds.'

children.text: अस अभिलाष नरेश खगेशा । मोहिंलै चलैं अवधअवधेशा ॥
children.translated_text: 'Such was the king's desire, O king of birds: "Let the lord of <s>Ayodhyā</s> take me [to heaven]."'

children.text: पितहि प्रेमवशलख्यो कृपाला । समुझायो कहिबचनरसाला ॥
children.translated_text: 'Seeing his father overcome by love, the compassionate one consoled him, speaking delightful words.'

children.text: वर्ष सहस्र राव प्रभुताई । रह्यो सो भोग करबमैं जाई ॥
children.translated_text: '"You have ruled for a thousand years, O lord; that enjoyment I shall go and receive [in your stead]."'

children.text: असकहि रामपितहि शिरनावा । दीन्हज्ञान निजधाम पठावा ॥
children.translated_text: Thus saying, <s>Rāma</s> bowed to his father, gave him knowledge, and sent him to his own abode [heaven].

children.text: दो० सुनि असबचनबिनीतबहु भयोज्ञानखगराय ।
children.translated_text: Hearing such many humble words, knowledge arose, O king of birds.

children.text: प्रभु मूरति उर राखिनृप गेसुरपुर हरषाय ॥
children.translated_text: Keeping the lord's form in his heart, the king went joyfully to the city of the gods.

children.text: पिता राज्यके भोगहित असकौतुक प्रभुकीन ।
children.translated_text: For the sake of the father's kingdom and its enjoyments, the lord performed such a marvel;

children.text: रहैं सिया कछुदिनअनतत्यहिकारणबनदीन ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Sītā</s> was given to the forest for some days for that reason.

children.text: सो० गयो शोच खगनाथ सुनिप्रभुचरितभुशुण्डिमुख ।
children.translated_text: The grief of the king of birds departed upon hearing the lord's deeds from <s>Bhuśuṇḍi</s>'s mouth.

children.text: परसि चरणपरमाथ अति नाथकृतारथ कीन्ह मोहिं ॥
children.translated_text: Touching the supreme feet, [he said:] 'O lord, you have fulfilled me.'

children.text: दो० पाछिलकथापुनीत अति सुनहु खगेशसुजान ।
children.translated_text: Listen now, O wise king of birds, to the latter sacred tale:

children.text: ज्यहि प्रकार रोदनकरैं सीता जगतभवान ॥
children.translated_text: the manner in which <s>Sītā</s>, the mother of the world, weeps.

children.text: महा बिलाप करति बैदेही । शोकबिकलतनुसुधिनहिंतेही ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Vaidehī</s> (<s>Sītā</s>) was making great lamentation; overcome by grief, she had no awareness of her body.

children.text: भे खग मृग बन जीव दुखारी । देखिजानकी चकित निहारी ॥
children.translated_text: The birds, beasts, and living creatures of the forest became sorrowful; seeing <s>Jānakī</s>, they gazed in amazement.

children.text: सक्तनयन जलदुखअधिकारी । बोले वचन समय अनुहारी ॥
children.translated_text: With eyes streaming tears, in great suffering, they spoke words befitting the moment:

children.text: तजहु शोच सुनु राजकुमारी । विधिके अङ्क सकै को टारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Abandon sorrow, listen, O princess — who can avert what is written in the scroll of fate?'

children.text: बन देवत धरि धरि मुनि नारी । समुझावें मृदु बैन उचारी ॥
children.translated_text: Forest deities, having assumed the forms of sages' wives, consoled her, uttering gentle words.

children.text: अवधते सरिस जानु बन माता । होइहैं सब विधि मंगलदाता ॥
children.translated_text: 'Consider this forest the same as <s>Ayodhyā</s>, O mother; all auspiciousness will come to be.'

children.text: काहू दोष न लाइय रानी । जग जननी तुममातुभवानी ।
children.translated_text: 'Do not blame anyone, O queen — you are the mother of the world, you are Mother <s>Bhavānī</s>.'

children.text: करि प्रबोध मुख धोय सयानी । कन्दमूल लाईं मधुजानी ।
children.translated_text: Having consoled [her], wisely they washed her face and brought roots, tubers, and wild honey.

children.text: धरि आगेसिय पुन समुझाई । हाथ जोरि करि विनयखबाई ॥
children.translated_text: Placing [the food] before <s>Sītā</s>, they consoled her again; with joined palms, humbly, they delivered the message.

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Verse:

children.text: करजोरि विनय खवाय सीतहि बिदाह्वै गृह को गईं ।
children.translated_text: With joined palms, humbly having fed <s>Sītā</s> and taken leave, they went to their homes.

children.text: लखि विषम बन भारी भयंकर जानकी विस्मित भंई ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the terrible, frightful, dense forest, <s>Jānakī</s> was struck with wonder.

children.text: त्यहि समय मुनिवर बालमीकि समेत चेलन बनगये ।
children.translated_text: At that time, the great sage <s>Vālmīki</s>, together with his disciples, went into the forest.

children.text: सुनिरुदनअबलासघनबन शिषसहिततहँआवतभये ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the weeping of a woman in the dense forest, he came there with his disciples.

children.text: सो० देखा निपट मलीन बैठी तहँ रोदन करै ।
children.translated_text: He saw [her] extremely disheveled, sitting there, weeping;

children.text: मुनिवर परम प्रवीन निकटजाय. पूंछी कथा ॥
children.translated_text: the supremely wise sage approached her and inquired about her story.

children.text: देखि ऋषय बोलीं तब सीता । बानी मञ्जुल मधुर पुनीता ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the sage, <s>Sītā</s> then spoke — in words sweet, melodious, and sacred:

children.text: श्वशुर चक्कवे दशरथ राऊ । जनकपिताजगविदितप्रभाऊ ॥
children.translated_text: 'My father-in-law was King <s>Daśaratha</s>, the <s>cakravartin</s> (universal emperor); my father <s>Janaka</s> — his glory is known to the world.'

children.text: पति रघुनाथ लोकतिहुँस्वामी । कहों कहांलग अन्तर्य्यामी ॥
children.translated_text: 'My husband is the lord of the <s>Raghus</s>, master of the three worlds — where shall I begin to describe the inner-controller?'

children.text: ऋषिपँचबटि पुरलोकविचारी । तज्योमोहिं रघुनाथ खरारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Considering the gossip of the city-folk regarding <s>Pañcavaṭī</s>, the lord of the <s>Raghus</s>, the slayer of <s>Khara</s>, has abandoned me.'

children.text: लक्ष्मण बन पहुंचाय बहोरी । गये अवधकहँजनककिशोरी ॥
children.translated_text: Having taken [Sītā] to the forest, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> returned; [Sītā,] <s>Janaka</s>'s daughter, went to Ayodhyā [in her thoughts].

children.text: बालमीकि सियको पहिचानी । धीरज दीन पुराण बखानी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Vālmīki</s> recognized <s>Sītā</s>; he gave her courage and recounted the <s>Purāṇas</s>.

children.text: पुत्री धीर धरो उर माहीं । भयोबामविधिकछु न बसाही ॥
children.translated_text: 'Daughter, hold steadfast courage in your heart; what has happened was fated by <s>Brahmā</s> — nothing can be done.'

children.text: करि प्रबोध बहु कथा सुनाई । चले संग आसनहि लिवाई ॥
children.translated_text: Having consoled her and told many stories, he took her along to his hermitage.

children.text: सुन्दर सदनबासलै दीन्ही । सेवा बहु प्रकार मुनिकीन्ही ॥
children.translated_text: He gave her a beautiful dwelling to stay in; the sage served her in many ways.

children.text: दो० यहि मिसि बीते कालबहु विपति विषाद बिहाय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: In this manner, much time passed, leaving behind misfortune and sorrow;

children.text: युगल तनय तब प्रकटभे सुदिन सुऔसर पाय ॥
children.translated_text: then twin sons were born, having found an auspicious day and occasion.

children.text: बालमीकि मुनि गन्त बिचारी । शुभ नक्षत्र लखिभये सुखारी ॥
children.translated_text: The sage <s>Vālmīki</s>, having considered the natal star, seeing the auspicious constellations, became delighted.

children.text: बोल लई महिसुर हरषाई । दीन दान सम्मान बड़ाई ॥
children.translated_text: He joyfully summoned the <s>brāhmaṇas</s>; he gave gifts, respect, and honors.

children.text: सिय उर हर्ष भयो ज्यहिभांती । शारदहूते नहिं कहिजाती ॥
children.translated_text: The joy that arose in <s>Sītā</s>'s heart — even <s>Śāradā</s> (<s>Sarasvatī</s>) could not describe it.

children.text: जस दुखसही लहीसुखभारी । बदनसुभगदोउसुवननिहारी ॥
children.translated_text: Such suffering she had endured, [and now] she obtained great happiness; gazing at the beautiful faces of both fine sons.

children.text: त्यहि अवसर मुनिकुटी सुहाई । ऋद्धिसिद्धिसुख सम्पतिछाई ॥
children.translated_text: At that time, the sage's hermitage was beautiful; it was covered with prosperity, powers, happiness, and wealth.

children.text: जो ज्यहिभावदीन्ह तेहिसोई । उत्सव परम जान जिनजोई ॥
children.translated_text: Whatever anyone desired, that very thing was given; let those who witnessed know the supreme festivity.

children.text: कीन्हवेद लौकिक सब रीती । बालमीकिमुनिवर अतिप्रीती ॥
children.translated_text: All rites — Vedic and customary — were performed; the great sage <s>Vālmīki</s> [did so] with great love.

children.text: नामकरण उत्पत्ति उछाहू । कीन्हमुदितबिधि वेद निबाहू ॥
children.translated_text: The naming ceremony (<s>nāmakaraṇa</s>) and the birth celebration — were performed joyfully, according to Vedic custom.

children.text: दो० भे सयान विद्यासकल बालमीकिमुनि दीन्ह ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: When they grew up, the sage <s>Vālmīki</s> gave them all the sciences;

children.text: चार वेद षट शास्त्रको कौतुकही पढ़ि लीन्ह ॥
children.translated_text: they mastered the four <s>Vedas</s> and six <s>Śāstras</s> as if in play.

children.text: बाल चरित सुन्दर दोउभ्रातू । हरषि निरखि सुख पावैमातू ॥
children.translated_text: The beautiful childhood activities of both brothers — the mother was delighted, gazing at them with happiness.

children.text: विद्या धनुषबाणमुनि दीन्ही । दोऊअनुजमुदितसिखिलीन्ही ॥
children.translated_text: The sage gave them the science of archery, bow, and arrow; both younger ones joyfully received the teaching.

children.text: बीते जबै वर्ष दश चारी । भयेकुमार युगल बलधारी ॥
children.translated_text: When fourteen years had passed, the twin princes became mighty in strength.

children.text: मुनिबालकसँग खेलतफिरहीं । निपटअशंक न कालहुडरहीं ॥
children.translated_text: They roamed about playing with the sage's boys; utterly fearless, they feared not even Death.

children.text: फिरहिंबिपिन करिबीरशृंगारा । बधैंमृगा दोउ राजकुमारा ॥
children.translated_text: They wandered in the forest, adorning themselves as warriors; both princes hunted deer.

children.text: अतुलितबलप्रताप दोउभाई । सुठिसुकुमार बरणिनहिंजाई ॥
children.translated_text: Of incomparable strength and prowess, both brothers — supremely beautiful and tender beyond description.

children.text: दिनप्रति करहिं अहेरबराहू । फिरहिंबिपिनलखिडरहिंनकाहू ॥
children.translated_text: Daily they hunted wild boar; they roamed the forest, and none dared look upon them [with challenge].

children.text: निशिदिनसुखदमातुउरमाहीं । सपनेहुअवधसुरतित्यहिनाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: Day and night they were a delight in their mother's heart; even in dreams she had no longing for Ayodhyā.

children.text: होत प्रात नित दोऊ भइया । करहिंप्रणाममुदितमनमइया ॥
children.translated_text: Each morning, both brothers would joyfully bow and pay respects to their mother.

children.text: दो० मुदितअशीषहि मातुतब जोरीसुभग निहारि ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The delighted mother would then bless them, gazing at the beautiful pair;

children.text: बार बार चँबूति बदन जाय जाय बलिहारि ॥
children.translated_text: again and again she would kiss their faces, saying 'Blessed! Blessed! I sacrifice myself for you!'

children.text: लवकुशजन्म उछाह भवानी । कह्यों यथामति वेदबखानी ॥
children.translated_text: O <s>Bhavānī</s>, the celebration of the birth of <s>Lava</s> and <s>Kusha</s> I have told as best I could, as the <s>Vedas</s> describe.

children.text: अब जो कहों सुनो मन लाई । राम चरित सुन्दर सुखदाई ॥
children.translated_text: Now listen attentively to what I say — the beautiful and blissful story of <s>Rāma</s>.

children.text: जबतेप्रभु सिय विपिन निकारी । तबतेनिशिदिनरहतदुखारी ॥
children.translated_text: Ever since the Lord exiled <s>Sītā</s> to the forest, since then He remained sorrowful day and night.

children.text: एकबार सोवत रघुबीरा । देखा स्वप्न राम रणधीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Once the Hero of the <s>Raghus</s> was sleeping; <s>Rāma</s> the battle-steadfast saw a dream:

children.text: लङ्खापति सजि निज कटकाई । घेस्यो अवध निशानबजाई ॥
children.translated_text: the lord of <s>Laṅkā</s>, marshalling his army, besieged Ayodhyā with drums beating.

children.text: कीन महारण प्रभुके साथा । ह्वै व्याकुल जागे रघुनाथा ॥
children.translated_text: A great battle was fought with the Lord; becoming disturbed, the Lord of the <s>Raghus</s> awoke.

children.text: कछु न दीख तहँ कृपानिधाना । कीन जाय सरयू अस्नाना ॥
children.translated_text: The Treasure of Mercy saw nothing there; he went and bathed in the <s>Sarayū</s> river.

children.text: नित्यक्रिया करि गुरु पहँ आई । गहिपद अम्बुजस्वप्नसुनाई ॥
children.translated_text: Having performed his daily rites, he came to the guru; grasping his lotus feet, he narrated the dream.

children.text: स्वप्रभेव जस मोहिं सुनाई । करो उपाय बेगि मुनिराई ॥
children.translated_text: 'The dream that has come to me — as I have told you — devise a remedy quickly, O king of sages!'

children.text: दो० कह्योबिचारि मुनीश तब बचन मधुर त्यहिकाल ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Then the lord of sages, having deliberated, spoke these sweet words at that time:

children.text: ब्रह्मबीज राकस भयो बसिभुजा दशभाल ॥
children.translated_text: 'A <s>Rākṣasa</s> has been born from the seed of <s>Brahmā</s>, the ten-headed one dwelling in his arms.'

children.text: करहु यज्ञ अशुमेध सुहावन । सदा युगों युग पावन पावन ॥
children.translated_text: 'Perform the beautiful <s>Aśvamedha</s> (horse sacrifice) — eternally purifying through all ages.'

children.text: जानिशिरोमणि मख अतिभारी । करहिं अवशनृपप्रभुदनुजारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Know it as the foremost and mightiest of sacrifices; kings must perform it — O Lord, enemy of demons.'

children.text: बिन कीन्हे मख दीनदयाला । होय न क्षमितअसुरदशभाला ॥
children.translated_text: 'Without performing the sacrifice, O Merciful One, the ten-headed demon will not be absolved.'

children.text: तब प्रभुकहा सुनिय मुनिनायक । करिय अरम्भयज्ञ सुखदायक ॥
children.translated_text: Then the Lord said, 'Listen, O leader of sages; let the bliss-giving sacrifice be commenced.'

children.text: तब मुनिनाथ कह्यो समुझाई । श्यामकरणहय अमर मँगाई ॥
children.translated_text: Then the lord of sages explained: 'Summon a dark-eared horse from the gods.'

children.text: राजनीति हम पत्र लिखाई । बाँधि शीशपर बाजि फिराई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Having royal decrees written on a letter, bind it on the horse's head and send the horse forth.'

children.text: चार क्षोहिणी दल सँगदीजे । सैनापति रिपुसूदन कीजे ॥
children.translated_text: 'Give four <s>akṣauhiṇī</s> divisions of army as escort; make <s>Ripusūdana</s> (<s>Śatrughna</s>) the commander.'

children.text: जो नृप बांधे अश्व तुम्हारा । करहिं युद्ध त्यहि सङ्ग अपारा ॥
children.translated_text: 'Whatever king binds your horse — wage endless war against him.'

children.text: ताहि जीतिमख बाजि मँगाई । चहूँदिशा यहिभांति फिराई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Defeating him and retrieving the sacrificial horse — thus have it paraded in all four directions.'

children.text: दो० सब भूपनमदमानमहि कुशल सो यह वरबाज ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'Safe shall be this excellent horse upon all the kings' earth of pride and honor;'

children.text: रिपुसूदन आवहिं अवध यज्ञसिद्ध रघुराज ॥
children.translated_text: '<s>Ripusūdana</s> shall return to Ayodhyā; the sacrifice will be accomplished, O <s>Raghu</s>-king.'

children.text: सुनि मुनीश के वचन सप्रेमा । मखहित राम कीन्ह दृढ़नेमा ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the loving words of the lord of sages, <s>Rāma</s> made a firm vow for the sacrifice.

children.text: बेगि तुरँग सुरनाथ मँगाई । पूजा कीन्ह वेद यश गाई ॥
children.translated_text: Quickly summoning a horse from the lord of the gods, he performed worship and sang Vedic praises.

children.text: हेमपत्र बांध्यो हय शीशा । बांचतज्यहि कोपैं अवनीशा ॥
children.translated_text: A golden letter was bound on the horse's head; reading it, any king would be enraged.

children.text: यूथप रिपुसूदन को कीन्हा । कहिप्रभुपूनिअसआयसुदीन्हा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Ripusūdana</s> (<s>Śatrughna</s>) was made the commander; the Lord then gave him specific instructions.

children.text: तात तुरंग करब रखवारी । सजगरहब धनुबाण सुधारी ।
children.translated_text: 'Brother, you shall guard the horse; remain vigilant with bow and arrow prepared.'

children.text: गे भूपति तजि इरषा मोहा । मिलै आयत्यहि कीन्हो छोहा ॥
children.translated_text: 'Kings who have abandoned jealousy and delusion — who come [in peace] — show them affection.'

children.text: अभयकरबत्यहिसभय निहारी । करब बचन परमान हमारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Grant fearlessness to those who look upon [you] with fear; carry out our word as supreme authority.'

children.text: जे नृप हठ बश बांध तुरंगा । प्रबलयुद्ध कीन्ह्यो तेहिसंगा ॥
children.translated_text: 'Whatever kings stubbornly bind the horse — wage powerful war against them.'

children.text: समरभूमि रणसेज सुवाई । तुरग छुड़ाय चलब हरषाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'On the battlefield, a fine bed of war — free the horse and proceed joyfully.'

children.text: दो० ताहि जीति मखबाजिलै सजगकरब सबकाज ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'Defeating him and taking the sacrificial horse, vigilantly accomplish all tasks;'

children.text: फिस्योअवधकहँप्राणप्रिय असकहिकोशलराज ॥
children.translated_text: 'Return to Ayodhyā, O dearer-than-life' — thus spoke the King of <s>Kośala</s>.

children.text: सुनि आयसु साहब सियरौनू । पद शिरनाय चले रिपुदौनू
children.translated_text: Hearing the command of his lord, the consort of <s>Sītā</s> — bowing his head to His feet, <s>Ripusūdana</s> departed.

children.text: करि आगे मखहय मुनिनाथा । भोरे सुभट कीन्ह त्यहिसाथा ॥
children.translated_text: Having placed the sacrificial horse ahead, the lord of sages sent great warriors along with him.

children.text: मुनिपद बन्दि चले रणधीरा । कर कमलन सोहत धनुतीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Bowing at the sage's feet, the battle-steadfast one departed; bow and arrow adorned his lotus hands.

children.text: शत्रुदवन पुर बाहर जाई । बेगि सारथी बोलि पठाई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śatrughna</s> (<s>Ripudavana</s>) went outside the city; quickly he summoned and sent for the charioteer.

children.text: तुरित सारथी स्यन्दन आना । चढ़्यो बिमान बीर बलवाना ॥
children.translated_text: Swiftly the charioteer brought the chariot; the powerful, valiant hero mounted the vehicle.

children.text: बीर धुरीण भरत लघुभाई । सुमिरि गजानन सैनचलाई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Bharata</s>'s younger brother, the foremost of heroes, remembering <s>Gaṇeśa</s>, set the army in motion.

children.text: सैन अमितको गनै मुनीशा । सकुचैं शारद गिरा फणीशा ॥
children.translated_text: The army was so vast — who could count it, O lord of sages? Even <s>Śāradā</s> and the Serpent-lord would hesitate.

children.text: चार क्षौहिणी सैन भवानी । बड़े बड़े योधा अभिमानी ॥
children.translated_text: Four <s>akṣauhiṇī</s> divisions of army, O <s>Bhavānī</s>; great warriors, proud [in battle].

children.text: आगे चञ्चल चपल तुरंगू । पाछे सुभट जाहिं त्यहिसंगू ॥
children.translated_text: Ahead [went] the restless, swift horse; behind, warriors marched along with it.

children.text: दो० त्यहि पाछे सेना सुभट भरत अनुज रणधीर ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Behind them the army of warriors; <s>Bharata</s>'s younger brother, battle-steadfast,

children.text: धर बीरासन जात मग सुमिरत सियरघुबीर ॥
children.translated_text: sitting in a heroic posture on the road, remembering <s>Sītā</s> and the Hero of the <s>Raghus</s>.

children.text: सांझ समय सब बीरभट साजिसाजि सीपाह ।
children.translated_text: At evening time, all the warrior-heroes arranged their camps;

children.text: निजनिज बारी देखिहय चलैं भोर उठि राह ॥
children.translated_text: each in their own turn watching the horse, they would set out on the road at dawn.

children.text: गिरामूक फण तब सकुचाई । जो अब कहै प्रताप बड़ाई ॥
children.translated_text: The serpent-tongue then hesitated — what to say now of [his] prowess and greatness?

children.text: फूटे मेरु खेह ह्वै जाहीं । टूटे बिटप परे महि माहीं ॥
children.translated_text: Mountains were split and reduced to dust; trees were broken and fell to the ground.

children.text: रजसों पूरिगये नद नारे । कूप तड़ाग झूर भय सारे ॥
children.translated_text: Rivers and streams were filled with dust; wells and ponds all dried up in fear.

children.text: जहँ जहँ जाय यज्ञबर बाजू । मिलहिंभूपतहँ सहितसमाजू ॥
children.translated_text: Wherever the excellent sacrificial horse went, kings would come to meet [them] with their retinues.

children.text: जहँ जे भूपति कीन्ह लड़ाई । मास्यो ताहि भरत लघुभाई ॥
children.translated_text: Whatever kings fought — <s>Bharata</s>'s younger brother defeated them.

children.text: ताहि सँहारि वाजि अगुआई । उत्सव कहिं कछु शर्म न पाई ॥
children.translated_text: Having subdued them and leading the horse forward — in the festival, he found no rest.

children.text: करहिं युद्ध नहिं कालहु डरहीं । नृपमानी जीतत रण फिरहीं ॥
