children.translated_text: They waged war, fearing not even Death; proud kings returned victorious from battle.

children.text: कहौं कहांलग तेज बखाना । रिपुसूदन रिपुसूदन जाना ॥
children.translated_text: How far shall I describe the glory? '<s>Ripusūdana</s>' — only <s>Ripusūdana</s> can know!

children.text: उदयअस्त महि मंडलमाहीं । । रिपुसूदन समान भट नाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: Between sunrise and sunset, in the whole circle of the earth, there is no warrior equal to <s>Ripusūdana</s>.

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Chanda (verse):

children.text: रिपुदवनसम जगकोउ न भट जोआयअब सन्मुख लड़े ।
children.translated_text: There is no warrior in the world equal to <s>Ripudavana</s>, who now came face-to-face in battle.

children.text: सुर असुर जेते नाग नर भय मान पद नहिं रण खड़े ॥
children.translated_text: All the gods, demons, serpents, and men — out of fear and pride, none stood in battle before him.

children.text: चहुँ ओर अश्व फिराय सैन समेत रिपुसूदन बली ।
children.translated_text: Having paraded the horse in all four directions with the army, the mighty <s>Ripusūdana</s>,

children.text: यमुना उतरि सुरसरीमज्यो पार उतर सैना चली ॥
children.translated_text: crossed the <s>Yamunā</s>, bathed in the divine <s>Gaṅgā</s>; the army crossed over to the other side.

children.text: सो० चल्योतुरंग त्यहिकाल बालमीकि आश्रमगयो ।
children.translated_text: Soraṭhā: The horse went forth at that time; it came to the hermitage of <s>Vālmīki</s>.

children.text: लखि बन बागरसाल हरितदूब लाग्यो चरन ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the green garden-forest with verdant grass, it began to graze.

children.text: दो० रहेतहां रखवार लव देखि अश्व प्रिय लाग ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: <s>Lava</s> was there keeping watch; seeing the horse, he was delighted.

children.text: उठ अकेल बांध्यो तुरंग जानि चरत मुनिबाग ॥
children.translated_text: Rising alone, he tied the horse, thinking it was grazing in the sage's garden.

children.text: बांधि तुरङ्ग पत्रलव बांचा । करोंयुद्ध नृपसों मन रांचा ॥
children.translated_text: Having tied the horse, <s>Lava</s> read the letter; 'I shall fight with the king!' — his mind was resolved.

children.text: जबलग जीवरहौ तनु माहीं । तबलग अश्व देब नृप नाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: 'As long as I live in this body, I shall not give up the horse, O king!'

children.text: त्यहि अवसर भटभीर समूहा । आये हय हेरत बहु जूहा ॥
children.translated_text: At that time, a host of warriors, a multitude of fighters, came searching for the horse in many groups.

children.text: देखि अश्व सकुचे मनमाहीं । बालक बधब उचित कछुनाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the horse [tied], they hesitated within: 'It is not proper to slay a child.'

children.text: डाटि कुवँर हयलेहु छुड़ाई । रिपुसूदन पहँ गवनो भाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Boy, let the horse be freed with a scolding!' — [saying this, the warriors] went to <s>Ripusūdana</s>.

children.text: सुनि अस बचन हँसे लवबीरा । कर कमलन फेरत धनुतीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing these words, the valiant <s>Lava</s> smiled, twirling bow and arrow in his lotus hands.

children.text: सुभट जवै हय छोरनलागे । लखि लव तुरत बीर रसपागे ॥
children.translated_text: When the warriors began to untie the horse, seeing this, <s>Lava</s> was immediately seized by the warrior spirit.

children.text: बोले बचन क्रोध नहिं थोरी । हटो सुभटकोउ तुरग न छोरी ॥
children.translated_text: He spoke words of no small anger: 'Stand back, warriors! No one shall free the horse!'

children.text: जो हठबश हय छोरन जाई । मारौं ताहि मुनीश दुहाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Whoever stubbornly goes to free the horse — I shall slay him, I swear by the lord of sages!'

children.text: दो० जो छोरै यहि काल हय बधौं ताहि त्यहिकाल ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'Whoever frees this horse now — I shall kill him at that very moment;'

children.text: तजौं न हय कोटिन करौ बिना युद्ध महिपाल ॥
children.translated_text: 'I shall not relinquish the horse, even if millions wage war without end, O king!'

children.text: सुनिल#यबचन# सुभटसब माखे । क्रोधसँभारि बचनअसभाखे ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing <s>Lava</s>'s words, all the warriors were enraged; restraining their anger, they spoke thus:

children.text: बालक समुझि न कीन्हलड़ाई । इनतो बातन बहुत खिझाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Considering him a child, we did not fight; but he has greatly provoked us with his words.'

children.text: अब नहिं दोष लड़ाई कीजै । तुरग समेत जीति रणलीजै ॥
children.translated_text: 'Now there is no blame — let battle be joined; let us defeat him and take the horse in combat!'

children.text: अस कहि धेरि लियो लवबीरा । मोरैं अस्त्र शस्त्र पर तीरा ॥
children.translated_text: So saying, they surrounded the valiant <s>Lava</s>; they rained weapons, arms, and arrows upon him.

children.text: लव बिलोकि योधा नियराने । धनुष चढ़ाय बाण सन्धाने ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the warriors approach, <s>Lava</s> strung his bow and fitted arrows.

children.text: एक निमिष महँ सब भटमारे । बचेते भागे जाय पुकारे ॥
children.translated_text: In a single moment, he slew all the warriors; those who survived fled, crying out.

children.text: नाथ एक बालक मुनि बैखा । बीर श्रँगार किये तनु देखा ॥
children.translated_text: 'Lord, a single boy of sage-like appearance; adorned with warrior's adornment, we saw his body —'

children.text: वय किशोर करणी कठिनाई । अतिसुन्दरनखशिखसुघराई ॥
children.translated_text: 'of adolescent age but formidable in action; exceedingly beautiful, refined from nail to crest.'

children.text: तिन बांध्यो हयको अतिगाढ़ा । काल समान आप तहँ ठाढ़ा ॥
children.translated_text: 'He has bound the horse most tightly; he himself stands there like Death personified.'

children.text: दो० तिनबांध्यो यह यज्ञहय बहुउपाय हम कीन्ह ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'He has bound this sacrificial horse; we tried many stratagems;'

children.text: युद्ध कीन मारे सुभट हठ बश अश्व न दीन्ह ॥
children.translated_text: 'he fought and slew the warriors; stubbornly he would not give up the horse.'

children.text: जे भट रहे अश्व रखवारे । तिनहिं तुरित रणखेत सँहारे ॥
children.translated_text: 'The warriors who were guarding the horse — he dispatched them on the battlefield at once.'

children.text: अस पौरुष अबहीं ते पाई । समय युवाभटजियत न जाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Such prowess even now at this age — in youth, no warrior can survive [against him].'

children.text: अति सुकुमार महारणधीरा । फिरत अकेलहाथ धनु तीरा ॥
children.translated_text: 'Exceedingly tender, yet supremely battle-steadfast; he roams alone, bow and arrow in hand.'

children.text: सुनि रिपुदवनअचम्भव माना । चलेतहां जहँलव बलवाना ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing this, <s>Ripudavana</s> was amazed; he went to where the powerful <s>Lava</s> was.

children.text: सैने सङ्ग घेस्यो बन बागू । बढ़े आप कीन्हे रथ आगू ॥
children.translated_text: Surrounding the garden-forest with the army, he advanced himself and placed the chariot ahead.

children.text: देखा जाय बाग मुनिराई । बोले सरुख भरत लघुभाई ॥
children.translated_text: Going and seeing the sage's garden, <s>Bharata</s>'s younger brother spoke with irritation:

children.text: का अनीति हय कीन्ह तुम्हारा । राख्यो बांधि मुनीशकुमारा ॥
children.translated_text: 'What wrong has the horse committed? You have bound it, O sage's boy!'

children.text: तुमहिं त्रासनहिं बांधत लाग्यो । कसपितुमातुअबहिंतेत्याग्यो ॥
children.translated_text: 'Threatening people, you began to tie [horses]; as if your father and mother abandoned you just now!'

children.text: सोहत तुमहिं न असकठिनाई । वयकिशोर मृदुगात सुहाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Such harshness does not suit you — of adolescent age, with soft and lovely limbs.'

children.text: दो० मुनिबर वेष अनूप अति धरे बाण धनुहाथ ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'In a sage's excellent garb, with bow and arrow in hand —'

children.text: करतअनीतिफिरौ विपिन खेलत बालनसाथ ॥
children.translated_text: 'you commit injustice, roaming the forest, playing with [other] boys.'

children.text: तुमहिं न असिहठसोहल भइया । तजिहयजाहुजहांपितुमइया ॥
children.translated_text: 'Such stubbornness does not suit you, brother; leave the horse and go where your father and mother are.'

children.text: निजकुल पुनि कुठारजनिहोहू ।देखि स्वरूप शोचअतिमोहू ॥
children.translated_text: 'You will be a blemish to your own family — seeing your behavior, I grieve with great bewilderment.'

children.text: सुनिलव रिपुसूदन मृदुबानी । दीनउतर हँसि सुनहुभवानी ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing <s>Ripusūdana</s>'s gentle speech, <s>Lava</s> gave this reply — listen with a smile, O <s>Bhavānī</s>:

children.text: हमरे कुल युग युग चलिआई । हठन जाय बरुसरबसजाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'In our family, through every age, this [resolve] has come down: stubbornness does not depart — rather, one may lose everything.'

children.text: जो भयमान तुरग नृप देहीं । अपने जियतअयशशिरलेहीं ॥
children.translated_text: 'Those kings who, out of fear and pride, give up the horse — they take dishonor upon their heads while still alive.'

children.text: हमहिं सौंपि मुनिवर यह बागा । आपगयेकहुँऋषिमनियागा ॥
children.translated_text: 'The great sage entrusted this garden to me; he himself has gone somewhere on a sage's sacred quest.'

children.text: खग मृग जे बनचर हैं नागू । मोसन चरन न पावैं बागू ॥
children.translated_text: 'The birds, deer, and forest-dwelling serpents — without my [permission], none may set foot in the garden.'

children.text: सकुचत पवन निरखि अमराई । सुरनरअसुर कौन प्रभुताई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Even the wind hesitates seeing this grove; among gods, men, and demons — who has such authority?'

children.text: सो तुम्हार हय निज बरिआई । कीन्ह निपात बाग मुनिराई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Yet your horse, by its own strength, trampled the sage's garden.'

children.text: सो० बांचि पत्र हयभाल बाग विध्वंसत देखिशठ ।
children.translated_text: Soraṭhā: 'Having read the letter on the horse's forehead, and seeing the fool trampling the garden,'

children.text: निजपौरुष महिपाल बांध्यों तुरग न देउँअब ॥
children.translated_text: 'by my own prowess, O king, I have bound the horse — I shall not give it up now!'

children.text: सुनि रिपुसूदन निरभय बानी । जान्यो हृदय महाअभिमानी ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing <s>Lava</s>'s fearless speech, [<s>Ripusūdana</s>] recognized him in his heart as exceedingly proud.

children.text: बिन संग्राम अश्व नहिं देई । करिसंग्राम अयश को लेई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Without battle, he will not give up the horse; if I fight, who bears the disgrace?'

children.text: जो मोरै म्वहिं निपट हँसाई । मैं मारौं तौ कौन बड़ाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'If I kill him outright — what glory is there in that?'

children.text: यहि मारे भल कहे न कोई । होय पाप नहिं सिंधुरसमोई ॥
children.translated_text: 'No one will speak well of killing him; there will be sin beyond the ocean's measure.'

children.text: जो तजि हय कोशलपुर जाऊं । कौन बदन रघुबरहि दिखाऊं ॥
children.translated_text: 'If I leave the horse and go to <s>Kośalapura</s>, with what face shall I show myself to the Lord of the <s>Raghus</s>?'

children.text: जो सकोप खोलौं बर बाजू । सन्मुख मेरै समरकर आजू ॥
children.translated_text: 'If in anger I unleash the excellent forces — who faces me in battle today?'

children.text: करत विचार शत्रुहन योधा । कौनिउभांति न होयप्रबोधा ॥
children.translated_text: As <s>Śatrughna</s> deliberated, the warrior could find no peace of mind in any way.

children.text: बिकल विलोकि रामलघुभाई । गगनगिरात्यहिसमय सुहाई ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing <s>Rāma</s>'s younger brother perplexed, at that auspicious moment a celestial voice rang from the sky:

children.text: ये न तनयमुनि ऋषयढुलारे । महाबली रण टरैं न टोर ॥
children.translated_text: 'These are not the pampered sons of a sage; they are supremely powerful and will not retreat from battle.'

children.text: दो० जनिभरमों रिपुदवनतुम ये न तनयमुनिराज ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'Do not be deluded, O <s>Ripudavana</s> — these are not sons of the king of sages;'

children.text: क्षत्रियकुल बाणी सुभट सब राजन के राज ॥
children.translated_text: 'they are of the <s>Kṣatriya</s> lineage, true warriors, princes among all kings.'

children.text: यतनहजार कोटि विधि करहू । रण सन्मुख लोहाकिनधरहू ॥
children.translated_text: 'Try a thousand, ten million stratagems; engage in face-to-face combat of iron!'

children.text: मिलै न हय किन करहु उपाधी । असकहिगगनगिराचुपसाधी ॥
children.translated_text: 'You shall not obtain the horse — why resort to trickery?' — thus spoke the celestial voice, then fell silent.

children.text: सुनत भरत सानुज नभ बानी । चकितरह्योनहिं जातबखानी ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the celestial voice, <s>Bharata</s>'s younger brother stood amazed — it cannot be described.

children.text: करि निश्चय तब उठे रिसाई । सब योधनसों कह्यो सुनाई ॥
children.translated_text: Having made up his mind, he rose in anger; he announced to all the warriors:

children.text: हम अपनीदिशि बहुत बचाई । मान न कुँवर काल नियराई ॥
children.translated_text: 'I have tried many conciliations from our side; the prince does not yield — his death approaches.'

children.text: अब न दोष निगमागम गाई । जो जसकरै सो तसफलपाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Now there is no blame, as the scriptures declare: whatever one does, one receives that fruit.'

children.text: धरो जियत बहु देहु कलेशू । अब न छोटबड़करो अँदेशू ॥
children.translated_text: 'Seize him alive and cause him much distress; now make no distinction of small or great.'

children.text: जो न हाथ लागै रिपु भारी । समर कठिन करि डारौमारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'If the mighty enemy does not come to hand — through fierce battle, I shall kill him.'

children.text: असकहि निजधनुबाण उठाई । लव सन्मुख बोले मुसकाई ॥
children.translated_text: So saying, he took up his own bow and arrow; facing <s>Lava</s>, he spoke with a smile:

children.text: दो० मैं अपनीदिशि बिनयकिय तुममानी नहिं एक ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'I have made every entreaty from my side; you have not heeded a single one;'

children.text: पावहुआज सजाय भल जस कीन्हे हठ टेक ॥
children.translated_text: 'today you shall receive a fitting punishment for the stubbornness and resolve you have shown.'

children.text: चाप चढ़ाय श्रवण लगिताना । छांड़यो अतिकराल बदुबाना ॥
children.translated_text: Stringing his bow, drawing the string to his ear, he released a terrifyingly fierce arrow.

children.text: ज्वइ शररिपु लव सन्मुख आई । स्वइ लवपास नरेश पठाई ॥
children.translated_text: The burning arrow came toward <s>Lava</s>; <s>Lava</s> himself sent arrows back toward the king.

children.text: निफलगये रिपुसूदन बाना । देखि प्रताप शोचउरआना ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Ripusūdana</s>'s arrows went to naught; seeing [<s>Lava</s>'s] prowess, he felt remorse in his heart.

children.text: तब लवललकास्यो रिपु बीरा । युद्धकरहु जनि होहुअधीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Then <s>Lava</s> challenged the enemy-hero: 'Fight! Do not become faint-hearted!'

children.text: राग चढ़ाय नाग सन्धाना । छांड़योशरबहु उरगसमाना ॥
children.translated_text: Charging with fervor, he fitted serpent-arrows; he released many arrows like serpents.

children.text: अर्द्ध निमिष लव बाण प्रहारी । दुइक्षौहिणीअनी रिपु मारी ॥
children.translated_text: In half a moment, <s>Lava</s>'s arrow-strikes slew two <s>akṣauhiṇī</s> divisions of the enemy army.

children.text: पुनि लव रिपुसूदन पहँ जाई । बोले कोपि बचन मुनिराई ॥
children.translated_text: Then <s>Lava</s> went to <s>Ripusūdana</s> and spoke angry words, O lord of sages:

children.text: सजग होहु यहिसमय भुवाला । असकहि छांड़योबाणकराला ॥
children.translated_text: 'Be alert at this moment, O king!' — so saying, he released a terrible arrow.

children.text: रिपुसूदन लव भट रणधीरा । लड़ै परस्पर दोउ बर बीरा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Ripusūdana</s> and <s>Lava</s>, both warriors steadfast in battle — both excellent heroes fought against each other.

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Chanda (verse):

children.text: द्वउबीरलड़ैं प्रचारि अतुलित विविधविधिललकारहीं ।
children.translated_text: Both heroes fought, raging with incomparable, manifold challenges;

children.text: बहु तीर अस्त्र कृपाण शूल सकोप ऊपर डारहीं ॥
children.translated_text: many arrows, divine weapons, swords, and tridents — in fury they hurled upon each other.

children.text: रणगूढ़ लखिभारत अनुज ह्वै विकल लव सन्मुखगही ।
children.translated_text: Seeing <s>Bharata</s>'s younger brother bewildered in the fierce battle, <s>Lava</s> faced him [directly].

children.text: अब सजगहोहु सँभारशर रणआजु त्वहिं मारौंसही ॥
children.translated_text: Now be alert and gather your arrows; today in battle I shall surely slay you!

children.text: सो० कहाबचन असकोपि रिपुसूदन रणधीर भट ।
children.translated_text: Sorattha: Speaking such words, the wrathful <s>Ripusūdana</s>, that steadfast warrior in battle,

children.text: लीन्हशरनतेतोपि महिसुवायदीन्ह्यों लवहि ॥
children.translated_text: took up arrows and struck, and the son of the earth (<s>Lava</s>) fell down, wounded.

children.text: रिपुसूदन अतिशय जबकोपे । मारिशरन नखशिखते तोपे ॥
children.translated_text: When <s>Ripusūdana</s> became exceedingly wrathful, he struck with arrows and battered him from head to toe.

children.text: अति सुकुमार न योग लड़ाई । पस्यो बीर रण में मुरछाई ॥
children.translated_text: Most delicate, unfit for battle — the warrior was seen fallen unconscious on the battlefield.

children.text: यथा बारिबिन मीन विशोकी । तथाविकलरणलवहिबिलोकी ॥
children.translated_text: As a fish is distressed without water, so was <s>Lava</s> seen wretched and anguished on the battlefield.

children.text: परमविकल शोचत मनमाहीं । रिपुसूदन आये लव पाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: Utterly distressed, grieving within his heart, <s>Ripusūdana</s> came to where <s>Lava</s> lay.

children.text: देखा निपट कुसाज कुमारा । शोभाअमित न जाय निहारा ॥
children.translated_text: He saw the prince in a most pitiable state, of boundless beauty that could not be beheld unmoved.

children.text: भरत अनुज पुनि सैनसँभारी । बाजिचढ़ाय अवध पगधारी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Bharata</s>'s younger brother then rallied his army, mounted his horse, and set forth toward <s>Ayodhyā</s>.

children.text: रहे जे लव सँग तनयमुनीशा । धाये ग्राम धुनत सबशीशा ॥
children.translated_text: The sons of the sages who had been with <s>Lava</s> ran to the hermitage, all shaking their heads in dismay.

children.text: सियसन कह्योसकल उतपातू । भेज्यहि विधिलवप्राणनिपातू ।
children.translated_text: They told <s>Sītā</s> of all the calamity: "Fate has sent one who would take <s>Lava</s>'s very life!"

children.text: रथ चढ़ाय लव को युवराजू । गवन्यहुभवनसहितमखबाजू ॥
children.translated_text: They placed <s>Lava</s> upon a chariot, and the young prince was brought home along with the sacrificial horse.

children.text: सो० सुनत शिशुन के बैन ब्याकुल भूतल में परी ।
children.translated_text: Sorattha: Hearing the words of the children, she fell distraught upon the ground,

children.text: भरे नीरदोउनैन शीशधुनहि करुणा करहि ॥
children.translated_text: both eyes filled with tears, shaking her head, making piteous lamentation.

children.text: त्यहि अवसर कुशबनते आये । मातुचरण सादर शिरनाये ॥
children.translated_text: At that very moment, <s>Kuśa</s> came from the forest and reverently bowed his head at his mother's feet.

children.text: देखा निपट विकल महतारी । यथा मीन व्याकुल बिनबारी ॥
children.translated_text: He saw his mother utterly distressed, like a fish writhing without water.

children.text: जस मणिहीन भुजगअकुलाई । तुसगतिजनकसुतागिरिजाई ॥
children.translated_text: As a serpent bereft of its jewel writhes in agony — such was the state of <s>Janaka</s>'s daughter, <s>Girijā</s>'s equal.

children.text: दशादेखि जननी दुखपावा । बोले वाणी सरल स्वभावा ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing his mother's condition, he was pained, and spoke words of simple, gentle nature:

children.text: क्यहिकारण यहगति महतारी । बेगिकहौ त्वंहिआनिहमारी ॥
children.translated_text: "For what reason are you in this state, O mother? Tell me quickly, O our protectress!"

children.text: सुनिसुतवचन कछुकधरिधीरा । लागी कहन नैन बह नीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing her son's words, she gathered some courage; she began to speak, tears flowing from her eyes.

children.text: आदि अन्त सब कथा सुनाई । भूतल परी बहुत मुरझाई ॥
children.translated_text: She told the whole story from beginning to end, then fell to the ground, deeply distraught.

children.text: सुनतभयो रिस कुशउर भारी । कसिनिषङ्ग धनुबाणसिधारी ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing this, immense fury arose in <s>Kuśa</s>'s breast; he fastened his quiver and set forth with bow and arrows.

children.text: जो बिनबधे अनुज को द्रोही । आवों भवन सप्तमोहिंतोही ॥
children.translated_text: "If I return home without slaying my brother's tormentor, I curse myself sevenfold!"

children.text: दो० मातु सप्तकरि तुरित कुश सङ्गलीन मुनिबाल ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: His mother gave sevenfold blessing, and <s>Kuśa</s>, accompanied by the young ascetics,

children.text: चले कोप कीन्हें महा जहां भीर महिपाल ॥
children.translated_text: set out in great wrath toward where the host of the king was gathered.

children.text: मुनिवर बाग गये कुशबीरा । देख्यो जात भूप रणधीरा ॥
children.translated_text: The valiant <s>Kuśa</s> went to the sage's garden and saw the mighty king departing, that steadfast warrior.

children.text: आगे जाय सैन सब घेस्यो । कहि कटुबचन नरेशहिफेस्यो ॥
children.translated_text: Going ahead, he surrounded the entire army, and addressing the king with sharp words, he challenged him:

children.text: को तुम कौन देश के राजा । साजिसैन आयेक्यहिकाजा ॥
children.translated_text: "Who are you? Of what country are you king? Having assembled an army, for what purpose have you come?"

children.text: सुठि सुकुमार मोर लघु भाई । करिमुरछितत्यहिचल्योपराई ॥
children.translated_text: "My younger brother, so very delicate — you rendered him unconscious and then fled like a coward!"

children.text: तुमहिं न त्रास प्राण निज केरी । भीरसङ्ग बन फिरौ अहेरी ॥
children.translated_text: "Have you no fear for your own life? You roam the forest hunting with a great host!"

children.text: जस कीन्ह्यो तस पैहौ आजू । जायहुकुशलसहितमखबाजू ॥
children.translated_text: "As you have done, so shall you receive today! Go in safety with your sacrificial horse — if you can!"

children.text: अस सुनि रिपुसूदन रथफेस्यो । कुशसन्सुखत्यहिअवसरहेस्यो ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing this, <s>Ripusūdana</s> turned his chariot; he wished to reason with <s>Kuśa</s> at that moment.

children.text: लवसों सुरस देखि सुघराई । बोले भरत अनुज मुसकाई ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing in <s>Lava</s>'s manner a noble bearing, <s>Bharata</s>'s younger brother spoke with a smile:

children.text: छोट बदन कीन्ह्यों रिस भारी । क्षमा करहु अपराध हमारी ॥
children.translated_text: "Little one, you speak with great fury from a small mouth; forgive us our offense."

children.text: दो० तुम्हरेअनुजहिबिबिधबिधि उचितसिखावनदीन ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: "Your younger brother, in many ways, was given fitting instruction;

children.text: काल बिबशतमक्योसुभट बचनश्रवणनहिंकीन ॥
children.translated_text: but overpowered by fate, that warrior, stubborn, would not heed our words."

children.text: चाप चढ़ाय विशिख शर मारे । दुइ क्षौहिणी कटक संहारे ॥
children.translated_text: "He strung his bow and shot piercing arrows; he destroyed two <s>akṣauhiṇī</s> divisions of the army."

children.text: मोसन आय युद्ध पुनिकीन्ह्यो । यदपिसिखावन मैं बहुदीन्ह्यो ॥
children.translated_text: "He came and fought with me, even though I gave him much counsel."

children.text: कुल अनुहरत भयो रिसमोरे । सत्यकहौं लिखि कागदकोरे ॥
children.translated_text: "Following his lineage, my anger rose — I speak the truth, as if inscribed upon a blank page."

children.text: ज्यहि रिसजाय तुम्हारीआजू । करहु न बिलम सँवारहुकाजू ॥
children.translated_text: "However your anger may go today, do not delay — attend to your affair."

children.text: सुनि कुश रिपुसूदनकी बाता । अनुजबिलोकि जरे सबगाता ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing <s>Ripusūdana</s>'s words and seeing his younger brother's state, <s>Kuśa</s>'s whole body burned with rage.

children.text: बन्धुशोक त्यहि समय बिसारी । कीन्ह्यो सिंहनाद अतिभारी ॥
children.translated_text: Setting aside his grief for his brother at that moment, he let out a tremendous lion's roar.

children.text: बोले अति सकोप कुश जबहीं । डगमगभयो लोकतिहुँतबहीं ॥
children.translated_text: When <s>Kuśa</s> spoke in utmost fury, all the three worlds trembled and shook.

children.text: सुनत दशौ दिगपाल सकाने । क्षुभ्योसिन्धुजलचरअकुलाने ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing it, the guardians of the ten directions quaked; the ocean was agitated and its creatures were thrown into panic.

children.text: उठ्यो धराकुर्म्म कांप्यो ब्यालू । भयो शोर डरप्यो सुरपालू ॥
children.translated_text: The tortoise that upholds the earth stirred, the cosmic serpent trembled; a great tumult arose and <s>Indra</s> himself was frightened.

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Chanda:

children.text: सुरपाल कम्पे कौन विधि त्यहि विष्णु शिवशङ्काभई ।
children.translated_text: The lord of the gods trembled — in what manner could even <s>Viṣṇu</s> and <s>Śiva</s> be without apprehension?

children.text: असकौनबीर सकोप अति धनुबाण करकमलनलई ॥
children.translated_text: Who is this warrior, so wrathful, who has taken up bow and arrows in his lotus hands?

children.text: रणअजर अनुपम चापकुश बलधाम जबफेरनलगे ।
children.translated_text: When <s>Kuśa</s>, that abode of strength, unwearied in battle, began to draw his matchless bow,

children.text: सुर असुर किन्नरनाग नर डरमानत्यहि अवसरभगे ॥
children.translated_text: gods, demons, <s>Kinnara</s>s, <s>Nāga</s>s, and men — all fled in terror at that moment.

children.text: सो० सुरन धस्यो नहिं धीर क्रोधकृतान्त निहारिकुश ।
children.translated_text: Sorattha: The gods could not hold their courage; seeing <s>Kuśa</s> wrathful as Death himself,

children.text: भागे सब भट भीर रहे एक रिपुदवन रथ ॥
children.translated_text: all the warriors of the host fled; only <s>Ripudavana</s> (<s>Ripusūdana</s>) remained upon his chariot.

children.text: दो० कौन बड़ाई कुशहि यह मातु सिया पितु राम ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: What wonder is this valor of <s>Kuśa</s>? His mother is <s>Sītā</s>, his father is <s>Rāma</s> —

children.text: को अस समरथ बीर जग जीति सकै संग्राम ॥
children.translated_text: who in this world is a warrior mighty enough to defeat him in battle?

children.text: कुश रिपुदवन समरगिरिजाई । महाअगमनहिं वरणिसिराई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Kuśa</s> and <s>Ripudavana</s> clashed on the battlefield — a great and indescribable encounter beyond all telling.

children.text: कोटिन बाण शत्रुहन मारे । कुश बरबण्डकाटि महिडारे ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śatrughna</s> shot millions of arrows; <s>Kuśa</s> cut down the barbed shafts and cast them to the ground.

children.text: भे बाणन ते हीन निषङ्गा । टूटे चाप अमित बहु रङ्गा ॥
children.translated_text: His quivers were emptied of arrows; his bows of many colors were shattered beyond count.

children.text: मींजत हाथ अधर रदचाबू । बिसस्यो बीर अवध को जाबू ॥
children.translated_text: Wringing his hands, biting his lower lip with his teeth, the warrior bound for <s>Ayodhyā</s> was confounded.

children.text: रहे सुभट जहँलग रणखेतू । मास्यो त्यहि रिपुदवन समेतू ॥
children.translated_text: Whatever champions remained on the battlefield, <s>Ripudavana</s> and all of them were crushed.

children.text: बहुरि बाजि बांध्यो तरु जाई । ब्याकुल गयो जहां लघुभाई ॥
children.translated_text: Then he tied the horse to a tree and, distressed, went to where his younger brother lay.

children.text: लीन उठाय गोद बैठाई । देखि दशा दारुण दुखपाई ॥
children.translated_text: He lifted him and seated him in his lap; seeing his dreadful condition, he was overcome with grief.

children.text: रोदन करत मोह उरब्यापा । बरणै को जस हृदय कलापा ॥
children.translated_text: Weeping, delusion pervaded his heart — who could describe the anguish within?

children.text: समुझिसमुझिसानुजकीकरणी । अबलाइव मारत शिरधरणी ॥
children.translated_text: Remembering again and again his brother's deeds, like a helpless soul he beat his head upon the ground.

children.text: दो० क्षण क्षण ब्याकुल देखि गति बरणत शीलसकोच ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Moment by moment, seeing his wretched state, describing his virtues with modesty and sorrow,

children.text: महि लोटत करुणा करत कहत विधाता पोच ॥
children.translated_text: rolling on the earth, making piteous lamentation, cursing fate as wretched —

children.text: सिया सुवन रोदन सुनिभारी । बनबासी सब भये दुखारी ॥
children.translated_text: hearing the loud weeping of <s>Sītā</s>'s sons, all the forest-dwellers were filled with grief.

children.text: प्रकट्यो देव सघन बन आई । कहिइतिहासकुशहिसमुझाई ॥
children.translated_text: A forest deity manifested, coming through the dense woods, and narrating the divine history, consoled <s>Kuśa</s>:

children.text: धरो धीर दुख अनुज बिसारी । जियै बन्धु आशीष हमारी ॥
children.translated_text: "Take courage, set aside the grief for your brother; your brother shall live — this is our blessing."

children.text: सुनत देखि बन गिरा सुहाई । उठिबैठे तब लव गिरिजाई ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the beautiful voice in the forest and seeing the deity, <s>Lava</s> then sat up.

children.text: मिले परस्पर दोऊ भैया । हर्षित चल्यो जहां रहिमैया ॥
children.translated_text: The two brothers met one another; joyful, they went to where their mother was.

children.text: हाथ सों हाथजोरि दोउ भाई । गयेभवन आनँद अधिकाई ॥
children.translated_text: Hand joined with hand, both brothers went home, their joy overflowing.

children.text: देखत मातु त्वरित उठि धाई । लीन सुवन दोउ कंठलगाई ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing them, their mother quickly rose and ran; she embraced both sons, clasping them to her breast.

children.text: मिलि द्वउ कुँवर गोदमें लीन्हीं । याचकबोलि निछावरिकीन्हीं ॥
children.translated_text: Meeting both princes, she took them into her lap; calling beggars, she made auspicious offerings.

children.text: शुचि भोजन पकवान मिठाई । हर्षसहित दोउतनय जिमाई ॥
children.translated_text: She fed both sons pure food, delicacies and sweets, with great joy.

children.text: दो० ह्वै प्रसन्न मन हर्षि अति देखि सुरस ज्यवनार ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Being gladdened and exceedingly joyful, seeing the delightful feast,

children.text: लागे भोजन करन तब प्रमुदित दोउसुकुमार ॥
children.translated_text: the two tender princes then began to eat, their hearts content.

children.text: कहिसिय तव बलि जाउँ मैं हे सुत शोभा गेह ।
children.translated_text: <s>Sītā</s> said: "I sacrifice myself for you, O sons, ornaments of our home!

children.text: भयो उपद्रव बाग मुनि मोमन अतिसन्देह ॥
children.translated_text: There has been a great disturbance in the sage's garden, and my mind is full of doubt."

children.text: मम सन्देह निवारहु ताता । कहोभयोज्यहिविधिउतपाता ॥
children.translated_text: "Dispel my doubt, O dear ones; tell me how this calamity came about."

children.text: मातुवचनसुनि लवअतिपावन । प्रथमहिंते सबलगे सुनावन ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing their mother's words, the most pure <s>Lava</s> began to narrate everything from the very beginning.

children.text: ज्यहि विधिआयसुभट कटकाई । घेस्यो बिपिनचहूँदिशि आई ॥
children.translated_text: "A great army of warriors came and surrounded the forest on all four sides.

children.text: एक तुरंग तेहि संग पराई । आय चस्यो मुनिवर अमराई ॥
children.translated_text: A horse came running with them and entered the sage's orchard to graze.

children.text: हेमपत्र हय शीश बिलोकी । बांचिताहि रिसगयो न रोकी ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing a golden plate upon the horse's head, I read it — and my anger could not be restrained.

children.text: बांध्यों तुरग मातु बरिआई । तासुखोज सैना बहु आई ॥
children.translated_text: I tied up the horse, O mother, by force; a great army came searching for it.

children.text: तासों कीन युद्ध अति भारी । करिसंग्राम सुभट सब मारी ॥
children.translated_text: I fought a tremendous battle with them; engaging in combat, I slew all those warriors.

children.text: त्यहि पाछे सैनापति आयो । म्वहिंलघुदेखिबहुतसमुझायो ॥
children.translated_text: After that, the commander came; seeing me small, he counseled me greatly.

children.text: कीन्ह्यो कठिन परन महिपाला । मुरछितकियोमोहिंत्यहिकाला ॥
children.translated_text: The king fought fiercely; at that time he rendered me unconscious."

children.text: दो० असकहि पुनि चुपसाधि लव चरण कमलशिरनाय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Having spoken thus, <s>Lava</s> fell silent, bowed his head at her lotus feet,

children.text: शयन कीन पर्य्यंक पर बोले कुश मुनिराय ॥
children.translated_text: and lay down to rest upon the bed; then <s>Kuśa</s>, that prince among sages, spoke:

children.text: त्यहि अवसर मैं बनते आयों । तवगति देखिबहुत दुखपायों ॥
children.translated_text: "At that very time, I came from the forest; seeing your condition, I was greatly grieved.

children.text: तुमसों पूँछिसक्यों नहिं माता । मुनिबालकन कही सबबाता ॥
children.translated_text: I could not ask you, mother; the young ascetics told me the whole story.

children.text: त्वरित लीन धनुबाण उठाई । गयोंबाग जहँ भट समुदाई ॥
children.translated_text: Swiftly I took up bow and arrows and went to the garden where the warriors were assembled.

children.text: नहिं तहँ सुभट न दीख नरेशू । नहिंलवसानुज भयो अँदेशू ॥
children.translated_text: There were no warriors there, nor could I see the king; nor was my younger brother <s>Lava</s> there — I grew anxious.

children.text: गयोंदूरि कछु बिपिन मँझाई । देख्यों चलीजात कटकाई ॥
children.translated_text: I went some distance into the midst of the forest and saw the army marching away.

children.text: फेस्यों कहि कटुवचन सरोखा । सुनतवचनआयेअतिचोखा ॥
children.translated_text: I turned them back, speaking sharp words in anger; hearing my words, they came at me with great ferocity.

children.text: रथशोभित स्वइ राजकुमारा । करिसंग्रामअनुजजिनमारा ॥
children.translated_text: Resplendent upon his chariot was the prince himself, who had defeated my brother in combat.

children.text: देखि मोहिं लवके अनुहारी । रह्यो चकित बहुबार निहारी ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing me, who resembles <s>Lava</s>, he stood astonished, gazing at me again and again.

children.text: पुनि लवको रथ ऊपर देखी । भयो नरेशहि शोच विशेखी ॥
children.translated_text: Then, seeing <s>Lava</s> upon the chariot, the king was seized with special sorrow.

children.text: दो० करि प्रतीत तब हृदय निज जानि मोहिंलवभ्रात ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Then, trusting in his heart, recognizing me as <s>Lava</s>'s brother,

children.text: रथहांक्यो आयो निकट कह्यो वचन अस मात ॥
children.translated_text: he drove his chariot near and spoke these words, O mother:

children.text: रेबालक त्वहिं त्रास न आई । जो अब म्वहिं कटुबैन सुनाई ॥
children.translated_text: "Boy, have you no fear, that you now hurl sharp words at me?"

children.text: बैकिशोर सुन्दर तनु गोरा । कहसिबचनजनु माहुरघोरा ॥
children.translated_text: "You are but a youth, fair and delicate of body, yet you speak words like deadly poison!"

children.text: लघु बिचारें मैं बहुत सँभारी । सह्योंकुवँर कटुबैन तुम्हारी ॥
children.translated_text: "Considering you young, I have shown great forbearance; I have endured your harsh words, O prince."

children.text: जस तुव बन्धु प्राणहठ दीन्ही । तसतोहूँ खल चाहसकीन्ही ॥
children.translated_text: "Just as your brother stubbornly gave battle for his life, so you too, wretch, wish to do the same!"

children.text: ह्वै हौ क्षणमहँ काल हवाले । अबलग पस्यो न काहूपाले ॥
children.translated_text: "In a moment I shall consign you to Death; never before have I seen anyone so reckless."

children.text: जाहुकुशल तजि मोह तरंगा । हठबश होहु न दीप पतंगा ॥
children.translated_text: "Go safely, abandon these waves of delusion; do not, through stubbornness, become a moth to the flame."

children.text: आयसु दीन न मैं कटकाई । लागि दया बालक सुघराई ॥
children.translated_text: "I did not bring my army here, for I took pity on you, a fair young boy."

children.text: सो तुम बहुत प्रचास्यो मोहीं । मोरपराक्रमविदित न तोहीं ॥
children.translated_text: "But you have provoked me greatly; my prowess is unknown to you."

children.text: सवँरहु जो कोइ होय सहाई । कहौं स्वभाव न करौं बड़ाई ॥
children.translated_text: "Summon whatever ally you may have; I speak my nature plainly, without boasting."

children.text: दो० सुनि नरेशके वचन मृदु मातु हँस्यों त्यहिकाल ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Hearing the king's gentle words, O mother, I laughed at that moment;

children.text: हँसत विलोक्यो मोहिं जब बोल्यो वचनकराल ॥
children.translated_text: when he saw me laughing, he spoke words most terrible:

children.text: यह लड़का वशकाल निदाना । मारो घेरि न पावै जाना ॥
children.translated_text: "This boy is in the grip of his own doom; surround him and slay him — let him find no escape!"

children.text: सुनि आयसु महिपालसकोही । मारनलगे सुभट सबमोही ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the king's command, the enraged warriors began to attack me from all sides.

children.text: मैं अकेल सेना नृप भारी । विकलभयोंत्यहिक्षणमहतारी ॥
children.translated_text: I was alone, O mother, and the king's army was vast; I was overwhelmed for a moment.

children.text: बाणनमारि छेदि तन दीन्ही । चहुँ दिशिआयघेरिम्वहिंलीन्ही ॥
children.translated_text: They struck me with arrows, piercing my body; they came from all four directions and surrounded me.

children.text: मैं देख्यों तब नयन उघारी । लीन्ह्यो घेरि सुभटबलधारी ॥
children.translated_text: Then I opened my eyes and saw that the mighty warriors had encircled me.

children.text: धरि धीरजमुनि सुमिरिप्रतापू । छाँड़यों बाण खैंचि तबचापू ॥
children.translated_text: Summoning courage and remembering the sage's glory, I drew my bow and released arrows.

children.text: मास्यों नृपहि सहित कटकाई । बहुरिबाजिबान्ध्योंतरु जाई ॥
children.translated_text: I crushed the king along with his entire army; then I tied the horse to a tree.

children.text: बाजि बांधि सानुज पहँ आयों । देखि दशा दारुणदुखपायों ॥
children.translated_text: Having tied the horse, I came to where my younger brother was; seeing his dreadful condition, I was deeply grieved.

children.text: सोवत महि शरसेज निहारी । शिरधुनि रोदन कीन पुकारी ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing him lying on the ground upon a bed of arrows, I beat my head and wept aloud.

children.text: दो० त्यहि अवसर बनदेवता मम बिलाप सुनि कान ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: At that time, a forest deity, hearing my lamentation,

children.text: आये धीरज दीन म्वहिं कथा अनेक बखान ॥
children.translated_text: came and gave me courage, narrating many a tale.

children.text: धरो धीर सुनि बचन हमारी । जाहु बेगि जहँ मातुतुम्हारी ।
children.translated_text: "Take heart, hear our words; go quickly to where your mother is."

children.text: जियैबन्धु लघु मैं बरदीन्हा । असकहिगमनभवननिजकीन्हा ॥
children.translated_text: "Your younger brother shall live — I have given this boon." Having heard this, I made my way home."

children.text: सुनत गिरा बनदेवत माता । तजिमुरछा जाग्योलवभ्राता ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the voice of the forest deity, O mother, my brother <s>Lava</s> cast off his swoon and awoke.

children.text: मिलत प्रेम नहिं हृदय समाता । देखिअनुजभये शीतलगाता ॥
children.translated_text: When we met, the love in our hearts could not be contained; seeing my younger brother, my body was cooled with relief.

children.text: देखाजाय बहुरि रणखेतू । पस्योनलखि कोउ बीरसचेतू ॥
children.translated_text: Going again to view the battlefield, I saw no warrior remaining conscious there.

children.text: मुनिवर सुतनसों यहसमुझाई । रह्योसजग हय भागिनजाई ॥
children.translated_text: I instructed the sages' sons thus: 'Stay alert — the horse must not flee!'

children.text: बाग मुनीश तुरँग महिपाला । जुगवतरह्योसजगसबकाला ॥
children.translated_text: In the sage's garden, O mother, the king's horse has remained under guard at all times.

children.text: सकल अनुग्रह मातु तुम्हारी । आय कुशल पदकञ्जनिहारी ॥
children.translated_text: All this is by your grace, O mother; I have come safely and beheld your lotus feet."

children.text: सुनि सुतवचन अशीषतमाता । गई निशाबड़ि सोवहु ताता ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing her son's words, the mother blessed him: "The night has grown late; now sleep, dear ones."

children.text: दो० लागे सोवन मुदितमन आयसु जननी पाय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Receiving their mother's command, they lay down to sleep with contented hearts;

children.text: जागे होत प्रभात पुनि बन्दि चरण शिरनाय ॥
children.translated_text: they awoke again at dawn and bowed their heads, paying homage at her feet.

children.text: करि अस्नान गंग दोउ भाई । आय मुदितमातहि शिरनाई ॥
children.translated_text: Both brothers bathed in the <s>Gaṅgā</s> and came back joyfully to bow before their mother.

children.text: भोजन करहिं संग यकथारी । लै आज्ञा बनओर सिधारी ॥
children.translated_text: They ate their meal together at one sitting; then, taking her leave, they set off toward the forest.

children.text: बधैं पुनीत बराह कुरंगू । आवहिं भवन भ्रात द्वौ संगू ॥
children.translated_text: They hunted sacred boar and deer, and both brothers returned home together.

children.text: यह इतिहास अनूठ खगेशू । पारबतीसन कह्यो महेशु ॥
children.translated_text: This wondrous tale, O lord of birds, <s>Maheśa</s> (<s>Śiva</s>) told to <s>Pārvatī</s>.

children.text: सोइ जावालि पराग नहाई । भरद्वाज मुनिवर प्रतिगाई ॥
children.translated_text: The same was recounted by <s>Jāvāli</s> at <s>Prayāga</s> to the great sage <s>Bharadvāja</s>.

children.text: अति विचित्र महिमा भगवाना । आगमनिगम पुराणबखाना ॥
children.translated_text: Most marvelous is the glory of the Lord, celebrated in <s>Āgama</s>s, <s>Nigama</s>s, and <s>Purāṇa</s>s.

children.text: जब रिपुदवन सहित सबबीरा । परे मुरछि रणमहँ रणधीरा ॥
children.translated_text: When <s>Ripudavana</s> along with all his warriors, those steadfast champions, fell unconscious on the battlefield,

children.text: भागे सुभट कछुक बिनमारे । तें कौशलपुर जायपुकारे ॥
children.translated_text: some warriors who had fled without being slain went crying to <s>Kausalapura</s> (<s>Ayodhyā</s>).

children.text: दे० गयेसुभटते अवधपुर अतिब्याकुल तनछीन ।
children.translated_text: Dehī: Those warriors went to <s>Ayodhyā</s>, utterly distraught and weakened in body;

children.text: जायपुकारे मुनि प्रभू बचनसही ह्वै दीन ॥
children.translated_text: they went and cried out to the lord: "O master, the sage's words have proved true!" — speaking thus in wretched tones.

children.text: वहां रामउर शोच आपारा । नहिं आये प्रिय प्राणअधारा ॥
children.translated_text: There in <s>Rāma</s>'s heart arose boundless grief — his beloved, the support of his life, had not returned.

children.text: मखशाला
children.translated_text: In the sacrificial hall,

children.text: जहँ ऋषय समाजू । ऋषिनमध्य रघुबीर बिराजू ॥
children.translated_text: where the assembly of sages sat, <s>Raghuvīra</s> (<s>Rāma</s>) presided amidst the seers.

children.text: चारिउ षट दश आठ पुराना । मुनि वक्ता श्रोता भगवाना ॥
children.translated_text: All four, sixteen, and eighteen <s>Purāṇa</s>s — the sages were the speakers, and the Lord was the listener.

children.text: चहुंदिशि विप्र वेदध्वनिकरहीं । मागध सुयश बंशउच्चरहीं ॥
children.translated_text: On all four sides, <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>s chanted the <s>Veda</s>s; bards recited the glorious lineage.

children.text: बन्दीगण याचक गुणगायक । अस्तुतिकरत ठाढ़रघुनायक ॥
children.translated_text: Eulogists, supplicants, and singers of virtues stood offering praises to the Lord of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty.

children.text: चतुगनन पंचानन देवा । चले यान चढ़ि प्रभुकी सेवा ॥
children.translated_text: Four-faced <s>Brahmā</s> and five-faced <s>Śiva</s> came riding their celestial vehicles to serve the Lord.

children.text: इन्द्र समाज देव मुनिवृन्दा । आयेजुरि जहँ रधुकुलचन्दा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>'s host, gods, and assemblies of sages all came together where the moon of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty shone.

children.text: मुदित अशीष जोरिकर देहीं । बदन बिलोकि परमसुखलेहीं ॥
children.translated_text: Joyfully they blessed him with joined palms, gazing upon his face and taking supreme delight.

children.text: निज निज थल बैठे सबजाई । शक्तिसमेत महाछबि छाई ॥
children.translated_text: All went and sat in their appointed places with their consorts, radiating great splendor.

children.text: दो० भरतलषण दशरथसचिवअनुजनसुवन समेत ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: <s>Bharata</s>, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, the ministers of <s>Daśaratha</s>, together with their younger brothers and sons,

children.text: जोरिपाणि ठाढ़े सकल सन्मुख कृपानिकेत ॥
children.translated_text: all stood with folded hands before that abode of compassion.

children.text: प्रभुरुखनिरखिकाजअनुसरहीं । सन्मुखते भूल्योनहिं टरहीं ॥
children.translated_text: Gazing upon the Lord's face, they followed his every wish; they never strayed or erred from his presence.

children.text: तौनी समय सुमट तहँ जाई । रिपुसूदन की खबरि सुनाई ॥
children.translated_text: At that very moment, warriors arrived there and brought news of <s>Ripusūdana</s>.

children.text: सुनतकृपानिधिअचरजमाना । विधिगतिप्रबलहृदयअनुमाना ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing this, the ocean of compassion was astonished; he reflected in his heart: "The course of fate is mighty."

children.text: सुभट बुलाय अवधपति बूझे । कहु केहि देश शत्रुहन जूझे ॥
children.translated_text: The lord of <s>Ayodhyā</s> summoned warriors and asked: "Tell me — in which land was <s>Śatrughna</s> defeated?"

children.text: नाय शीश पद बचन बहोरी । लाग्यो कहन दोऊकरजोरी ॥
children.translated_text: Bowing their heads at his feet, they replied; with both hands joined, they began to tell:

children.text: देश देश सब तुरँग फिराई । कोउनभयो सन्मुख रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: "The horse was taken through every land; nowhere did any rival arise, O lord of the <s>Raghu</s>s.

children.text: आगे ह्वै पूजा हय करहीं । रिपुसूदन के सन्मुख धरहीं ॥
children.translated_text: Going ahead, all would worship the horse and present it before <s>Ripusūdana</s>.

children.text: करहिं अभय त्यहि अंगलगाई । साधु स्वभाव भरतलघजुभाई ॥
children.translated_text: He would grant them protection and embrace them — such was the noble nature of <s>Bharata</s>'s younger brother.

children.text: कोउन सुभट सन्मुखरणकीना । मिलेआय सब परमअधीना ॥
children.translated_text: No warrior anywhere stood to face him in battle; all came and submitted in complete obedience.

children.text: छन्द
children.translated_text: Chanda:

children.text: सब मिले परमअधीन जहँ जहँ बाजि रिपुसूदन गयो ।
children.translated_text: All submitted in total obedience wherever the horse of <s>Ripusūdana</s> went;

children.text: हियहारि काँप सैनलेखि करजोरि शिरनावत भयो ॥
children.translated_text: their hearts failing, trembling at the sight of his army, they bowed with folded hands.

children.text: यहि भांति अस्तुतिकरहिंपूजहिं अश्वभट रिपुदवनको ।
children.translated_text: In this manner they praised and worshipped the horse and its warrior <s>Ripudavana</s>;

children.text: राखैं सुबस्तु मँगाय आगे चलैं पद गहि भवन को ॥
children.translated_text: they brought fine offerings, placed them before him, and grasping his feet, returned to their homes.

children.text: सो० यहिप्रकार सब देश फिरिआयो रिपुदवनभट ।
children.translated_text: Sorattha: In this manner, having toured all lands, the warrior <s>Ripudavana</s> returned;

children.text: चले अवध अवधेश संग अनी चतुरंगिनी ॥
children.translated_text: he marched toward <s>Ayodhyā</s> with the lord of <s>Ayodhyā</s>'s army, a full four-fold host.

children.text: दो० फिस्यो तुरँग जबे अवध आयो गंगातीर ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The horse was turned back when it reached the bank of the <s>Gaṅgā</s> near <s>Ayodhyā</s>;

children.text: सुभट क्षोहिणी चारि दल त्यहि पाछे रघुबीर ॥
children.translated_text: four <s>akṣauhiṇī</s> divisions of warriors followed behind, with <s>Raghuvīra</s> (<s>Rāma</s>) behind them.

children.text: महा सघनबन तहँ रघुराई । दिवसहुजहँ मिसरातिसुहाई ॥
children.translated_text: There was a great dense forest where the lord of the <s>Raghus</s> [went]; even by day it was as pleasant as night.

children.text: गयो तुरँग त्यहि वन रघुराई । पहुंचो जहँ मुनिवर अमराई ॥
children.translated_text: The horse of the lord of the <s>Raghus</s> went into that forest; it reached where the great sage's grove was.

children.text: मुनिवर बाग चरै जब लागा । बांध्यो हय रखवारन बागा ॥
children.translated_text: When [the horse] began to graze in the great sage's garden, the horse-guards bound it in the garden.

children.text: सजग भये हय पाय अनेरा । घेरे ठाढ़ चहूंदिशि हेरा ॥
children.translated_text: The guards became alert, finding a strange horse; they stood surrounding it, looking in all four directions.

children.text: सुभट बिकल नहिं देख्योबाजू । कहैं सहमि बड़ भयो अकाजू ॥
children.translated_text: The warriors were distressed, not seeing [the horse's] hawk-sign; they said in dismay, 'A great calamity has occurred.'

children.text: खोजत फिरैं अन्त नहिं पावैं । हेरि हरि चहुंदिशि फिरिओंवै ॥
children.translated_text: They searched and roamed about but found no end; looking and calling, they wandered in all four directions.

children.text: धँसे महाबन तब अकुलाई । लख्यो अश्वमुनिवर फुलवाई ॥
children.translated_text: Then, anxiously plunging into the great forest, the great sage's [disciple] saw the horse in the flower garden.

children.text: जाय तहां हय छोरन लागे । रखवारे भट देखत भागे ॥
children.translated_text: Going there, they began to untie the horse; seeing the warriors, the guards fled.

children.text: तेहिमा एक कुवँर तन गोरा । रोंक्यो भट कहिबचनकठोरा ॥
children.translated_text: Among them, one prince of fair body stopped the warriors, speaking harsh words.

children.text: दो० बयकिशोर नखशिख सुघर सुखमा शील निधान ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Of adolescent age, beautiful from head to toe, a treasure of grace and good character,

children.text: हटके भट सब काल त्यहि करतल फेरत बान ॥
children.translated_text: He drove back all the warriors there, twirling an arrow in his palm.

children.text: शोभा मुख शतकोटि दिनेशा । काकपक्ष धारे मुनि वेशा ॥
children.translated_text: The beauty of his face [surpassed] a hundred crores of suns; he wore <s>kākapakṣa</s> (side-locks) and the garb of a sage.

children.text: सौ सौ कोटि काम रतिवारी । अङ्ग अङ्ग जैये बलिहारी ॥
children.translated_text: A hundred hundred crores of <s>Kāmadeva</s>s and <s>Rati</s>s fall short; every limb deserves praise.

children.text: मुनिवर वेष कुमार नरेशा । प्रभु अनुहारि विशेष सुरेशा ॥
children.translated_text: In the garb of a great sage, this prince-lord; resembling the Supreme Lord, especially the lord of gods.

children.text: सुनि भट बचन रमापति देवा । कहा सयन कोउलखैनभेवा ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the warriors' words, Lord <s>Rāmapati</s> (servant of Rāma) said cautiously: 'Let someone ascertain [his] identity.'

children.text: पुनि करजोरि कहन सो लागा । ठिठुकिरहे भट गये न बागा ॥
children.translated_text: Then, joining his hands, he began to speak; the warriors stood frozen and did not go to the garden.

children.text: माखे बचन सुनत सब बीरा । सजगभये गहिगहिधनुतीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the angry words, all the warriors became alert, seizing their bows and arrows.

children.text: कोउ कह मारहु लेहु छुड़ाई । कोउकहजियतधरहुयहिभाई ॥
children.translated_text: One said, 'Strike him and free [the horse]!'; another said, 'Capture him alive, brother!'

children.text: अस अभिलाष सुभट उरमाहीं । चरित राम खग बूझिनजाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: Such was the desire in the hearts of the brave warriors; the deeds of <s>Rāma</s>'s [sons] cannot be fathomed by birds.

children.text: रिसबश एक बाण तिन मारा । परे मुरछि रण सुभट अपारा ॥
children.translated_text: In anger, he shot one arrow; countless brave warriors fell unconscious on the battlefield.

children.text: दो० द्वितिय बाण छांड़यो जबै भागे भट रणधीर ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: When the second arrow was released, the brave warriors of the battlefield fled;

children.text: जाय पुकारे ते सभय जहँ रिपुसूदन बीर ॥
children.translated_text: They went crying in fear to where the hero <s>Ripusūdana</s> (destroyer of enemies) was.

children.text: पहुँचो रथ सन्मुख जब आई । देखि कुमार परम सुख पाई ॥
children.translated_text: When the chariot arrived and he came face to face, seeing the prince, he experienced supreme joy.

children.text: लखि शोभा रथ काम लजौनू । शिथिलगात मनभे रिपुदौनू ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the beauty of the chariot, <s>Kāma</s> (the god of love) felt ashamed; <s>Ripusūdana</s>'s body became slack, his mind [was captivated].

children.text: हृदय सराहत कुवँर लुनाई । बोले रिपुसूदन मुसकाई ॥
children.translated_text: Praising the prince's grace in his heart, <s>Ripusūdana</s> spoke with a smile:

children.text: की तुम वेष मुनीश ऋषेशा । की क्षत्री कुल तनय नरेशा ॥
children.translated_text: 'Are you a sage-lord or seer-chief in garb, or a prince of the warrior clan, son of a king?

children.text: बनमाला छापा शुचिटीका । देखिस्वरूपलाग अतिनीका ॥
children.translated_text: 'Seeing the forest-garland, tilaka, sacred mark, and your form — [you] appear exceedingly beautiful.

children.text: प्रेम फांस लीन्हे बन फिरहू । मोहत जिव भय शंक न करहू ॥
children.translated_text: 'Having been caught in the snare of love, you roam the forest; you captivate souls and feel no fear or doubt.

children.text: सो छलबल हमसों अब कीना । कीन बाजि अपने आधीना ॥
children.translated_text: 'You have now used deception and force against us; you have brought the horse under your control.

children.text: छांड़हु तुरँग छोड़ि लरिकाई । अबहीं ते नहिं सोह लड़ाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Release the horse, leave off this childishness; fighting does not suit you at this age.'

children.text: दो० सुनि रिपुसूदनके बचन तिन हँसि उत्तर दीन्ह ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Hearing <s>Ripusūdana</s>'s words, he laughed and gave this answer;

children.text: मृदुलमनोहरबयनकहि अश्वहि चाहहु लीन्ह ॥
children.translated_text: With soft, charming words: 'Do you wish to take the horse?

children.text: करहु कोटि हय हेतु उपाई । नहिं पावहु बिन कियेलड़ाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Try ten million stratagems for the horse; you will not obtain it without fighting.

children.text: छल तजिसकलकुटिलताकाजू । सन्मुख समर करहु जो राजू ॥
children.translated_text: 'Abandon deception, all crooked schemes; face us in battle if you are a king.

children.text: जाको अश्व देइ करतारा । लेइ सो आजु महीपकुमारा ॥
children.translated_text: 'He to whom the Creator gives the horse — that prince of the earth shall take it today.'

children.text: होत परस्पर बाद बिबादू । बढ़योअधिकदुहुँदिशिसम्बादू ॥
children.translated_text: There arose mutual argument and dispute; the altercation increased greatly on both sides.

children.text: तब रिपुघन बिचारि रघुराई । बिन संग्राम अश्व नहिं पाई ॥
children.translated_text: Then <s>Ripughna</s> (the enemy-slayer) reflected: 'The lord of the <s>Raghus</s>' horse cannot be obtained without battle.'

children.text: बोलिसुभट सब आज्ञा दीन्ही । आपन धनुषबाण करलीन्ही ॥
children.translated_text: He summoned all warriors and gave orders; he himself took up bow and arrows.

children.text: लाग्यो होन समर रघुनाथा । चलेबाण ह्वौदिशि यकसाथा ॥
children.translated_text: The battle began with the lord of the <s>Raghus</s>' [men]; arrows flew simultaneously in all directions.

children.text: देखि पराक्रम तासु अपारा । मन रिपुसूदन कीन्हबिचारा ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing his boundless valor, <s>Ripusūdana</s> pondered in his mind.

children.text: श्रवण प्रयन्त शरासन ताना । मास्यो कठिन तासु उरबाना ॥
children.translated_text: Drawing the bowstring to the ear, he struck a fierce arrow into [the prince's] chest.

children.text: दो० लागत शर मुरछितभयो उठ्यो सँभारि बहोरि ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Struck by the arrow, he fell unconscious; rising and composing himself again,

children.text: सैन सहित रिपुसूदनहिं बानन डास्योझोरि ॥
children.translated_text: He showered <s>Ripusūdana</s> along with his army with a storm of arrows.

children.text: मारिसुभट सब धरणि सुवाई । परे सकल शरसेज बिसाई ॥
children.translated_text: Striking all the warriors, he laid them on the ground; all fell on their beds of arrows.

children.text: जहँलग भट रिपुसूदन साथा । पल महँ सब मारे रघुनाथा ॥
children.translated_text: As many warriors as were with <s>Ripusūdana</s>, the lord of the <s>Raghus</s> struck them all in a moment.

children.text: कीन्हबिकलरिपुघनअति कोपे । शरन मारिलीन्ह्यो रथ तोपे ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Ripughna</s> became greatly enraged and distressed; striking with arrows, he shattered the chariot.

children.text: तब रिपुसूदन अतिशय करषे । धनुष चढ़ाय बाण बहु बरषे ॥
children.translated_text: Then <s>Ripusūdana</s> was exceedingly angered; stringing his bow, he rained many arrows.

children.text: मुरछितकीन्ह कठिन शरमारी । बाजिसहिततबअवधसिधारी ॥
children.translated_text: He rendered [the prince] unconscious with fierce arrow-strikes; with the horse, he then departed for <s>Ayodhyā</s>.

children.text: योजन एक निकसि रथआवा । पाछेकुवँर और यक धावा ॥
children.translated_text: After going about a <s>yojana</s>, the chariot came forth; behind, another prince rushed forward.

children.text: ललकास्यो तिन हाथ उठाई । फिरहु सुभट कहँ जाहु पराई ॥
children.translated_text: He challenged them with raised hand: 'Turn back, warriors! Where do you flee?'

children.text: सरुषबचन सुनिभट सकुचाने । फिरे त्वरित रिपुदवनरिसाने ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the angry words, the warriors hesitated; then <s>Ripudavana</s> (enemy-subduer), enraged, swiftly turned back.

children.text: कटक सहितआये अति चोखा । जहां बीर वह ठाढ़ सरोखा ॥
children.translated_text: He came with his entire force, very sharp; where that hero stood in anger.

children.text: दो० तानि शरासन कानलग त्वरित सिधारे बान ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Drawing the bowstring to the ear, the arrows flew swiftly;

children.text: भयो ने शङ्का तासुउर बीर धीर बलवान ॥
children.translated_text: No fear arose in the hero's heart — brave, steadfast, and mighty.

children.text: भयो परस्पर वचन सक्रोधा । दुहुँदिशितमकिउठे द्वौयोधा ॥
children.translated_text: Angry words were exchanged; from both sides, two warriors rose in fury.

children.text: इत उत चले उरग समबाना । समर होनलाग्यो भगवाना ॥
children.translated_text: Arrows flew this way and that, like serpents; the battle with the Lord began.

children.text: रिपुसूदन सुरपति सम बांके । कुसुमसमान लगैं शर ताके ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Ripusūdana</s>, handsome as the lord of gods, his arrows felt like flowers [to the prince].

children.text: बहु छलबल कर हास्यो बीरा । तबतिनहत्यो मांझउर तीरा ॥
children.translated_text: With many deceptions the hero was confounded; then [the prince] struck him in the middle of the chest with an arrow.

children.text: लागतशर मुरछित महिगिरेऊ । कहुँ निषंग कहुँशारँग परेऊ ॥
children.translated_text: Struck by the arrow, he fell unconscious to the ground; his quiver fell one way, his bow another.

children.text: गिने सुभट बाचे बिन मारे । आये भागिते अवधबिचारे ॥
children.translated_text: The remaining warriors who were not slain were counted; those wretched ones fled to <s>Ayodhyā</s>.

children.text: जस आयसु प्रभु राउर होई । करहिं वेगि रघुनायक सोई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Whatever command the Lord gives, the lord of the <s>Raghus</s> will swiftly carry it out.'

children.text: सही बचन सुनि सुभट सयाने । रघुकुलतिलक रामपछिताने ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the true words of the wise warriors, <s>Rāma</s>, the crown-jewel of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty, felt regret.

children.text: सब समाज मखके सुन बानी । बड़अचरजहिरदयअनुमानी ॥
children.translated_text: The entire assembly at the sacrifice heard the news; they inferred great wonder in their hearts.

children.text: दो० कृपासिन्धु बशशोचतब भरतहि तुरितबुलाय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The ocean of mercy, seeing [the distress], swiftly summoned <s>Bharata</s>:

children.text: तात जाव जहँ भयोरण देखहुअनुजहिजाय ॥
children.translated_text: 'Dear one, go where the battle occurred; go and see your younger brother.'

children.text: तुरँग समेत जीति रिपु आनो । इनाकहा तात तुम मानो ॥
children.translated_text: 'He conquered the enemy and brought him along with the horse; dear one, heed his words.'

children.text: को अस वीर कीन्ह रण भारी । मास्यो रिपुसूदनहिं प्रचारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Who is this hero who fought such a great battle, who struck down <s>Ripusūdana</s> the warrior?'

children.text: सुनत शोच उर भयो अपारा । कस वे जिन रिपुसूदनमारा ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing this, immense grief arose in his heart: 'How is it that someone struck down <s>Ripusūdana</s>?'

children.text: जो अधीन ह्वै देहिं तुरंगा । कियोनतासमर तिनसंगा ॥
children.translated_text: 'If they submit and return the horse, do not make war with them.

children.text: जो बलकरिपौरुष दिखरावहिं । सन्मुख ताततुम्हरे आवहिं ॥
children.translated_text: 'If they show strength and valor by force, they will come before you face to face.

children.text: करि संग्राम जीति रणमाहीं । हय समेतआनो म्वहिंपाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: 'Having fought and won in battle, bring [them] with the horse to me.'

children.text: सुनि मृदुगिरा भरत शिरनावा । तुरितसमरकरसाजमँगावा ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the gentle words, <s>Bharata</s> bowed his head; he swiftly had battle preparations brought.

children.text: गजरथ साजि सारथी लावा । ध्वजपताकबहुतुवन सुहावा ॥
children.translated_text: Elephants and chariots were prepared, charioteers brought; with flags, banners, and many fine quivers.

children.text: सो० नाय राम पद शीश भरत गमन कीन्हे तुरित ।
children.translated_text: Sohā: Bowing his head at <s>Rāma</s>'s feet, <s>Bharata</s> departed swiftly.

children.text: कह भुशुण्डि खगईश संग क्षोहिणी चारिदल ॥
children.translated_text: Said <s>Bhuśuṇḍi</s> to the bird-lord: 'Four <s>akṣauhiṇī</s> divisions accompanied him.'

children.text: भे सवार गजबदन मनाई । को कहिसकै भरत प्रभुताई ॥
children.translated_text: Mounted, having worshiped the elephant-faced one (<s>Gaṇeśa</s>), who can describe <s>Bharata</s>'s lordliness?

children.text: संग भूरि भट बरणि न जाई । देखत बनै सुनहु गिरिजाई ॥
children.translated_text: The warriors accompanying him cannot be described; one must see to believe, hear O <s>Girijā</s> (<s>Pārvatī</s>)!

children.text: पवन सरिस रथ बेगि चलाई । भयो जहां रण पहुँचे जाई ॥
children.translated_text: Driving the chariot swift as the wind, he reached where the battle had occurred.

children.text: देखा भट घायल रणखेतू । परे सकल रिपुदवन समेतू ॥
children.translated_text: He saw the warriors wounded on the battlefield; all had fallen along with <s>Ripudavana</s>.

children.text: अनुजबिलोकिबहुत दुखमाना । धरि धीरज बोले बलवाना ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing his younger brother, he was greatly pained; composing himself with courage, the mighty one spoke:

children.text: खोज करहु बैरी बनमाहीं । सुनतमोहिंकहुँ भाजिनजाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: 'Search for the enemy in the forest; let him not flee from hearing about me.'

children.text: भरतवचन सुनि सुभट समूहा । खोजनचले सिमिटिकरिहूहा ।
children.translated_text: Hearing <s>Bharata</s>'s words, the warriors gathered and set out searching in a group.

children.text: त्यहि औसर मुनिबालकवृन्दा । गयेदेखन मुनि बागअनन्दा ॥
children.translated_text: At that time, the boys of the sage's [hermitage] had gone to see the sage's garden joyfully.

children.text: तहँ अवलोकि प्रबल कटकाई । चले भागि टेरत दोउ भाई ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the powerful army there, they fled, calling out to the two brothers.

children.text: दो० जाय पुकारे सुवन सब रहे जहां दोउभ्रात ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: All the children went crying to where the two brothers were:

children.text: लीन्हेअति भट भूप कोउ घेरिलीन्हबनपात ॥
children.translated_text: 'Many warriors of a king have surrounded and seized the forest paths!'

children.text: सुनि कुश लव सेना सब आई । तुरित उठे दोअ भट हर्षाई ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing [this], <s>Kuśa</s> and <s>Lava</s>, along with their army, came; the two warriors arose with joy.

children.text: कसि पटपीत तुवन कटिलाई । लीन शरासन हाथ उठाई ॥
children.translated_text: Tying their yellow garments, fastening quivers at the waist, they took up bows with raised hands.

children.text: सियपद बन्दि सुमिरि मुनिराई । सिंह ठवनि गवने दोउ भाई ॥
children.translated_text: Bowing to <s>Sītā</s>'s feet, remembering the sage-king, the two brothers advanced with the gait of lions.

children.text: जिमि केहरि नग नाग समाजू । लवहिदेखिजिमिझपटैबाजू ॥
children.translated_text: Like a lion amidst elephants on the mountain, hawks swoop upon seeing <s>Lava</s>.

children.text: तस दोउबीर सुनत कटकाई । गयेबाग मन बिलम न लाई ॥
children.translated_text: Thus the two heroes, hearing of the army, went to the garden without delay.

children.text: देखा तुरँग बाग मुनिराऊ । ठाढ़ भये तहँ नहिं भयकाऊ ॥
children.translated_text: They saw the horse in the garden of the sage-king; they stood there fearlessly.

children.text: हेरत बिपिन सुभट तहँ आई । दीख तुरँग दोउ बीरसुहाई ॥
children.translated_text: Looking about the forest, warriors came there; they saw the horse and the two handsome heroes.

children.text: शोभा देखि सुभट अनुरागे । भरिभरिनयन निहारनलागे ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing their beauty, the warriors were captivated; they began gazing with eyes filled full.

children.text: करहिं परस्पर सकल बड़ाई । धनिविधिज्यहिंअसरूपबनाई ॥
children.translated_text: They praised one another: 'Blessed is fate, which has created such beauty.'

children.text: दो० असशोभा नहिं दीखकहुँ जहँलग विधिव्योहार ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'Such beauty has not been seen anywhere in the Creator's works;

children.text: सुन्दरता तिहुँलोक सब इन्हैं दीनि करतार ॥
children.translated_text: All the beauty of the three worlds the Creator has given to these two.'

children.text: रूप सराहि सराहि भवानी । बोले सुभट समय अनुमानी ॥
children.translated_text: Praising their beauty again and again, O <s>Bhavānī</s>, the warriors spoke, judging the moment:

children.text: तुम बालक मुनितपअधिकारी । यह अनुचित धनुबाणसवांरी ॥
children.translated_text: 'You are children worthy of a sage's penance; it is improper [for you] to prepare bows and arrows.'

children.text: सरबरि तुम राजनकर करहू । बश अज्ञान तो शरकरधरहू ॥
children.translated_text: 'Will you compete with kings? Out of ignorance you hold arrows.'

children.text: बाढ़यो गर्ब बांध धनुभाथा । फिरौनिशंक कुवँर दोउरसाथा ॥
children.translated_text: 'Pride has grown from stringing the bow and quiver; the two princes roam fearlessly with warriors.'

children.text: कहत बहुरि असनीतिबखानी । कीज बैर आप सम जानी ॥
children.translated_text: Again they spoke such advice: 'Enmity should be made with one's equals.'

children.text: कहँ वे अवधईश सुखरासी । कहँ तुम बालकमुनि बनबासी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Where are the supreme pleasures of the lord of <s>Ayodhyā</s>? Where are you — forest-dwelling sage-children?'

children.text: भल न कीन हयको अपनाई । जीत्यो समर भरत लघुभाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'You did not do well in claiming the horse; <s>Bharata</s>'s younger brother has been defeated in battle.'

children.text: त्यहि समान नहिं भारतजानो । बीर धुरीण सत्य कर मानो ॥
children.translated_text: 'There is none equal to him in all of <s>Bhārata</s>; believe it truly — he is the foremost of heroes.'

children.text: बिनश्रम तोहिं मारिछिनमाहीं । छोरि तुरंग अवध लै जाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: 'He will kill you without effort in a moment; release the horse and they will take it to <s>Ayodhyā</s>.'

children.text: दो० एक बीर पुनि भक्त दृढ़ शोभा शील नदीश ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'One is a hero and also a firm devotee, a lord of beauty and good conduct;

children.text: बहुरि अनुज रघुबंशमणि जिनमास्योदशशीश ॥
children.translated_text: 'Moreover, the younger brother is a jewel of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty — he who struck down the ten-headed one (<s>Rāvaṇa</s>).'

children.text: मानों जो सिख कुवँर हमारी । सुबिविधिहै तुम्हरीहितकारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'If you heed our advice, princes, it will be good for you in every way.'

children.text: तुरँग समेत चलो हरषाई । मिलोसो कहैं अनुज रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Come happily with the horse; meet him,' said the younger [brother] of the lord of the <s>Raghus</s>.

children.text: शारद कोटि कोटि अहिराई । महिमा भरतकहतसकुचाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'A hundred crores of <s>Śāradas</s> and <s>Śeṣas</s> hesitate to speak the greatness of <s>Bharata</s>.'

children.text: अति कोमलचित भरत नरेशू । करैंक्षमा लखिकुवँर ऋषेशू ॥
children.translated_text: '<s>Bharata</s> the king is of exceedingly tender heart; he will show mercy seeing the young sage-princes.'

children.text: रिपुसूदन को बैर बिसारी । फिरैं अवध लै बाजि सुखारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Forgetting the enmity of <s>Ripusūdana</s>, he will return happily to <s>Ayodhyā</s> with the horse.'

children.text: कीन्हे समर पार नहिं पाऊ । घर बैठे भावै सो गाऊ ॥
children.translated_text: 'The battle fought has no limit; sitting at home, sing whatever you please.'

children.text: भरत समान बीर जगमाहीं । नहिंदेखा कहुँ सुनियतनाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: 'A hero equal to <s>Bharata</s> in the world has not been seen nor heard of.'

children.text: सन्मुख जासु काल शिरनाई । ताहि समर जीतब तुम भाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Before whom even Death bows his head — you brothers would defeat him in battle?'

children.text: त्यागहु हठ इरषा अभिमाना । भरत धर्म्मधुरभटबलवाना ॥
children.translated_text: 'Abandon stubbornness, envy, and pride; <s>Bharata</s> is a hero of righteous valor and might.'

children.text: दो० तासों जीतब समर तुम सजि भूषण संग्राम ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'You would defeat him in battle, arraying yourselves for combat?

children.text: अबलग सूझ न दूध मुख बोलत बानी बाम ॥
children.translated_text: Until now, with milk still on your faces, you speak perverse words.'

children.text: और वचन तुम सुनो हमारे । सजगहोहु सुन ऋषैकुमारे ॥
children.translated_text: 'Hear our further words; become alert, listen, O sage-princes.'

children.text: हमहिं भरतआयसु असदीन्हा । खोजिचोरहयचाहियलीन्हा ॥
children.translated_text: '<s>Bharata</s> has given us this command: "Find the horse-thieves and bring them."'

children.text: जहां मिलैं धरि बांधौ आजू । यतन समेत सवाँरो काजू ॥
children.translated_text: 'Wherever they are found, seize and bind them today; accomplish the task with all effort.'

children.text: कीन चहैं निज ईश रजाई । खाई जासु तासु यश गाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'They who wish to fulfill their lord's command — having eaten his salt, they sing his praises.'

children.text: बयकिशोर मृदु मंजुल गाता । देखितुम्हैं नहिंकियउतपाता ॥
children.translated_text: 'Young adolescents with soft, beautiful bodies — seeing you, we have not caused harm.'

children.text: कीननकानजो हमसिख दीन्ही । अब पैहौ भलआपन कीन्ही ॥
children.translated_text: 'You have not heeded the advice we gave; now you will reap what you have sown.'

children.text: असकहि सुभट सरुषह्वैआये । लै कृपाण तब सन्मुख धाये ॥
children.translated_text: Saying this, the warriors came in anger; taking their swords, they charged forward.

children.text: कुशलवदेखि सुभट रिपुभारी । गदा शूल तोमर कर धारी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Kuśa</s> and <s>Lava</s>, seeing the great enemy warriors bearing maces, spears, and lances,

children.text: पाछे राखि लवहि खुशबीरा । चाप चढ़ाय संयुत करितीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Keeping <s>Lava</s> behind, the valiant <s>Kuśa</s> strung his bow and fitted his arrow.

children.text: छन्द
children.translated_text: Verse:

children.text: गहितीर संयुत चाप खींचि बिलोकि रिपुसेना महा ।
children.translated_text: Taking an arrow, stringing the bow, drawing it back, and beholding the great enemy army,

children.text: छोड़यो कठिन नाराचहँसि मानो प्रबल मारु त बहा ॥
children.translated_text: He laughingly released a fierce steel-tipped arrow — as if a powerful storm had blown.

children.text: लवनिमेष प्रमान मा सब बीर रण घायल भये ।
children.translated_text: In the blink of an eye, all the heroes on the battlefield were wounded;

children.text: दासचेरे बहुरि कुशलव बाग मुनिनायक गये ॥
children.translated_text: Then <s>Kuśa</s> and <s>Lava</s>, attended by servants, returned to the garden of the sage-chief.

children.text: दो० बचे सुभट दुइ चार जे ते भागे गौं पाय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The two or four warriors who survived fled, reaching the village;

children.text: गये पुकारत भरत जहँ व्याकुल वचनसुनाय ॥
children.translated_text: They went crying to where <s>Bharata</s> was, reporting their distress.

children.text: नाथ सुभट जे आयसु पाई । खोजन लागे हय बन जाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Lord, the warriors who received the command went to the forest to search for the horse.

children.text: मिला न चोर न घोड़ मुनीशा । फिरे सुभट व्याकुल जगदीशा ॥
children.translated_text: 'Neither the thief nor the horse of the sage-lord was found; the warriors returned distressed, O lord of the world.'

children.text: मध्य विपिन यक मुनिअमराई । बांधा तुरँग दीख तहँ जाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'In the middle of the forest, at a sage's grove, the horse was found tied there.'

children.text: बालक दुइ तहँ कृपानिधाना । खड़े सजग शरसाजि कमाना ॥
children.translated_text: 'Two children were there, O treasury of mercy, standing alert with bows and arrows strung.'

children.text: जानि चोर हयभट कह बानी । रे रे शठ तुव आयु तुलानी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Thinking them horse-thieves, the warrior spoke: "You rascals, your life-span is measured!"'

children.text: तिन न कीन कछु हृदयअँदेशा । निपट निरंकुश तनयऋषेशा ॥
children.translated_text: 'They showed no concern in their hearts; those sons of the sage-lord were utterly unbridled.'

children.text: सब प्रकार हास्यो समुझाई । तदपि न त्यागकीन्हलड़काई ॥
children.translated_text: 'They were admonished in every way, yet they did not abandon their boyish [defiance].'

children.text: भये क्रोधबश सुभट गुसाईं सन्मुख युद्धकीन वहि ठाईं ॥
children.translated_text: 'The warriors became angry, O Lord, and fought a battle right there on the spot.'

children.text: छिनमाँ सब योधा संहारे । तेजपुंज दाउ ऋषयकुमारे ॥
children.translated_text: 'In a moment, both sage-princes destroyed all the warriors — those two resplendent ones.'

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Verse:

children.text: दोउ तेजपुंज कुमार ऋषि सुखधाम शोभा को कहै ।
children.translated_text: Both resplendent sage-princes, abodes of happiness — who can tell their beauty?

children.text: मृदुगात सुन्दर बयकिशोर अनंग लखि सकुचै सभै ॥
children.translated_text: Of soft limbs, beautiful, adolescent — even <s>Anaṅga</s> (Kāmadeva) is abashed seeing them.

children.text: शिरजटा मूँज जनेव कुण्डल कान अद्भुत सोहई ।
children.translated_text: Matted locks on the head, <s>muñja</s>-grass sacred thread, ear-rings — they appear wonderfully beautiful.

children.text: अस कौन जीव सचेत जग में जो न देखत मोहई ॥
children.translated_text: What conscious being in the world would not be enchanted seeing them?

children.text: धनु बाण सुन्दर मान कुल करि तुव न अतिशोभित भले ।
children.translated_text: With beautiful bows, arrows, honor, and lineage — they shine surpassingly well.

children.text: अब नाथ देखि विचित्रशोभा सकुचिनिजलोकहि चले ॥
children.translated_text: Now, lord, seeing this wondrous beauty, the [celestials] withdrew bashfully to their own abode.

children.text: दो० सकल सुभट रणखेतमें परे मुरछि तजि प्रान ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: All the warriors on the battlefield fell unconscious, giving up their lives;

children.text: खड़े सुभट दोउ समरमाँ हृदय न कछु अभिमान ॥
children.translated_text: The two heroes stood on the battlefield, with no pride whatsoever in their hearts.

children.text: भरत सुन्यो सेना सब जूझे । कर विषाद योधनसों बूझे ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Bharata</s> heard that the entire army had perished; he inquired of the surviving warriors in distress.

children.text: चढ़ि रथ तुरित अबार न लाई । चले तहां जहँ मुनि अमराई ॥
children.translated_text: Mounting his chariot swiftly without delay, he went to where the sage's grove was.

children.text: सुमिरत प्रभुपद बारम्बारा । करतविविधविधिपंथविचारा ॥
children.translated_text: Remembering the Lord's feet again and again, pondering the path in various ways,

children.text: पहुँचे जहां भयो संग्रामा । भरत धर्मधुर बुधिबलधामा ॥
children.translated_text: He reached where the battle had occurred — <s>Bharata</s>, the pillar of <s>dharma</s>, the abode of wisdom and strength.

children.text: विपिन गंभीर महाअँधियारी । भूमि शयन सब सैन निहारी ॥
children.translated_text: The forest was deep and very dark; he beheld the entire army lying on the ground.

children.text: बड़ेबड़े मुखिया सेनापति । सुरदुरलभपावनजिनकीगति ॥
children.translated_text: Great chieftains and commanders, whose attainment is rare even for the gods.

children.text: सकै न रण सरवर करि सोऊ । अतिबलवानऋषयसुतदोऊ ॥
children.translated_text: 'Those two sage-sons are exceedingly mighty; even the battlefield-lake cannot [withstand] them.'

children.text: जानि न जाय चरित करतार । गूढ़ असूझ अबूझ अपारा ॥
children.translated_text: 'The deeds of the Creator cannot be fathomed — deep, inscrutable, unfathomable, boundless.'

children.text: बोलत रण पग परत न आगे । धीरजहू के धीरज भागे ॥
children.translated_text: Speaking of the battle, his feet would not move forward; even the courage of the courageous fled.

children.text: सो० धीरज धरहु मुनीश सहित कटक आगू गयो ।
children.translated_text: Sohā: 'Maintain courage' — with the sage-lord, the army went ahead.

children.text: देस्यो सुवन मुनीश धेरे अस्वहि ठाढ़ सब ॥
children.translated_text: He saw the sage-lord's sons standing with the horse, all of them.

children.text: त्यागि बाग रथबाजि मँगावा । सुमिर राम शिव उमा मनावा ॥
children.translated_text: Leaving the garden, he had a chariot-horse brought; remembering <s>Rāma</s>, <s>Śiva</s>, and <s>Umā</s>, he prayed.

children.text: चढ़यो अश्वधरि धीरज गाढ़े । गये जहां मुनि शिशुसबठाढ़े ॥
children.translated_text: Mounting the horse with firm courage, he went where the sage-children all stood.

children.text: आवत देखि तुरँग असवारा । भागे सकल ऋषेशकुमारा ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the mounted horseman coming, all the sage-lord's children fled.

children.text: कुश लौ पाँव न पाछे डारा । खड़े बंन्धु दोउकरें बिचारा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Kuśa</s> and <s>Lava</s> did not take a step back; the two brothers stood deliberating:

children.text: मार जो भट परथम रणमाहीं । तासुसहाय और कोउ आहीं ॥
children.translated_text: 'The warrior who was struck first in battle — does he have any other allies?'

children.text: जो नृप यहकर जोर सुरीती । मांगे अश्व देहिं सुन नीती ॥
children.translated_text: 'If this king humbly joins hands and asks for the horse politely, let us give it — hear this wisdom.'

children.text: जो कछु बलप्रभाव दिखरावें । तो सजाय अपनी यह पावें ॥
children.translated_text: 'If they show strength and might, then they will receive their due punishment.'

children.text: असकहि बीर दोऊ बलधामा । खड़े बाग छवि कोटिनकामा ॥
children.translated_text: Thus spoke the two heroes, abodes of strength; they stood in the garden, their beauty surpassing ten million <s>Kāmadevas</s>.

children.text: तबलग जाय भरत नियराने । पाणि सरोज बाण धनु ताने ॥
children.translated_text: Meanwhile <s>Bharata</s> went and drew near, with lotus-hands stretching bow and arrow.

children.text: दो० ताजन मारे अस्वके परचि उठा जिमि आग ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: When the horse was struck with the whip, it flared up like fire,

children.text: खाईं नांघत बाग को नहीं बार कछु लाग ॥
children.translated_text: leaping over the ditch into the garden — no obstacle could hold it.

children.text: मध्यबाग लखि अश्व सवारा । बढ़िआगे तब कुश ललकारा ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the horse and its rider in the middle of the garden, <s>Kuśa</s> advanced and challenged them.

children.text: अबसे जो पग आगे धरहु । यमपुरगमन सहित हयकरहू ॥
children.translated_text: "From this point, if you set one foot further, you shall journey to <s>Yamapura</s> (the city of Death) along with this horse!"

children.text: जब सरोष बोले कुश बीरा । रोक्यो बाग भरत रणधीरा ॥
children.translated_text: When the heroic <s>Kuśa</s> spoke thus in anger, the battle-steadfast <s>Bharata</s> blocked the garden.

children.text: सावधान ह्वै भरत भवानी । बोले अतिकठोर कटु बानी ॥
children.translated_text: Becoming alert, O <s>Bhavānī</s>, <s>Bharata</s> spoke exceedingly harsh and bitter words:

children.text: रे हय चोर कुपथ मनराता । जसमुखअहै कहसिकिनबाता ॥
children.translated_text: "O horse-thief, whose mind delights in wicked ways! With such a face, whose affairs do you speak of?

children.text: छोटे बदनकहसिकटुबानी । क्यहिबलविपिनफिरसिअभिमानी ॥
children.translated_text: With so small a mouth you speak bitter words — by what strength do you roam the forest so proudly?

children.text: गुण अवगुण तुव करौं न काना । जसबैरी तस बालक जाना ॥
