children.translated_text: Dohā: Seeing the battlefield in the forest, the ocean of virtues and abode of happiness, <s>Rāma</s> beheld:

children.text: बड़े बड़े मुखिया सुभट जूझे करि संग्राम ॥
children.translated_text: great and mighty chieftains and warriors had fallen, having fought in battle.

children.text: ऐसे बचन कहत रघुबीरा । जायँचले बन घनहिं गँभीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Speaking such words, <s>Raghubīra</s> went forward into the deep, dense forest.

children.text: चौंकततुरगनिरखिगजअरणी । महाबिकट पगधरत न धरणी ।
children.translated_text: The horse started with alarm, seeing the forest of battle — fearsome, its hooves would not touch the ground.

children.text: सुनि २ रोदन खेत अपारा । रहै ठिठुकि हय टेरै न टारा ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the ceaseless weeping on the battlefield again and again, the horse stood frozen, neighing, refusing to move.

children.text: पिछरत लौटहि डहर निहरि । यदपि ताड़ना देहिं खरारी ॥
children.translated_text: It recoiled, turning back upon seeing the path, even though <s>Kharārī</s> (<s>Rāma</s>, slayer of <s>Khara</s>) urged it on.

children.text: बहत रूधिर घावन ते कैसे । घनमें प्रभा भानुकी जैसे ॥
children.translated_text: Blood flowed from the wounds — like sunlight streaming through dark clouds.

children.text: गेरु पनार नील गिरि जैसे । त्यहिमेंउदय धनुष छबि तैसे ॥
children.translated_text: Like mountains of ochre, red earth, and blue — amidst them, the splendor of bows rose like sunrise.

children.text: बहे अमित शोणित के नारे । कोल करार न जाहिं निहारे ॥
children.translated_text: Countless streams of blood flowed; the banks and shores could not be beheld.

children.text: कोल बराबर लोथन केरी । ऊंच करार मतंगज हेरी ॥
children.translated_text: Banks level with piles of corpses, high embankments of fallen elephants.

children.text: बिने पग अश्व भये तहँ कैसे । मक्र ग्राह जल नदर्मे जैसे ।
children.translated_text: The horses' hooves were mired there — like crocodiles and alligators in river waters.

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Verse:

children.text: बहे चर्म्म कच्छ समान शोणित धारमें कबिको गिनै ।
children.translated_text: Shields floated like tortoise shells in the streams of blood — who could count them, says the poet.

children.text: गजशुण्ड मुण्डौ सूससम उतरान बहु देखत बनै ॥
children.translated_text: Elephant trunks and severed heads bobbed like porpoises — many such sights could be seen drifting.

children.text: करडारि साँग निषङ्ग शायक बिपिन गति उनकीभई ।
children.translated_text: Swords, spears, quivers, and arrows had become like a forest in that expanse.

children.text: बहु मुंड तोमर बिरनकर नहिं जात चेरेसों कही ॥
children.translated_text: Many severed heads and maces of warriors — their condition cannot be told even by servants.

children.text: भटसूभट मनहुं जहाज सुन्दर कहनको सब खलभले ।
children.translated_text: The warriors' bodies were like handsome ships — all were in turmoil, indescribable.

children.text: बहु जिन्सभूत पिशाच योगिनि बैठि त्यहिपारैचले ॥
children.translated_text: Many beings — ghosts, demons, <s>yoginīs</s> — sat upon them and sailed to the other shore.

children.text: बिकराल बदन पसारि आमिष खानको गरजहिं तहाँ ।
children.translated_text: With fearsome gaping mouths, they roared there, eager to devour flesh.

children.text: खर गिद्ध श्वान शृगाल गाल बजाय कह जेते जहाँ ॥
children.translated_text: Donkeys, vultures, dogs, and jackals — puffing their cheeks, everywhere they were.

children.text: नहिं बरणि जात जमात मोपै विविध गहि उर रोंकहूं ।
children.translated_text: 'I cannot describe this multitude — grasping my heart in various ways, I hold back.

children.text: प्रभुचरित सिन्धु अपार खग मैं पार कौनि बिधि लहूं ॥
children.translated_text: The ocean of the Lord's deeds is boundless, O bird — how can I, a bird, find the other shore?'

children.text: सो० सुनुखगेश कह रामचरित संशयहरण ।
children.translated_text: Sohā: 'Listen, O lord of birds,' said he, 'the tale of <s>Rāma</s> destroys all doubt.

children.text: जाहिनीक नहिंलाग त्यहि समान को अधम नर ॥
children.translated_text: One to whom this tale does not appeal — there is no wretch lower than such a person.'

children.text: दो० असकहि पुनि दोड नाय शिर प्रभुपद बारम्बार ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Saying this and bowing his head again and again at the Lord's feet,

children.text: फिर भुशुण्डि लागे कहन प्रभु इतिहास उदार ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Bhuśuṇḍi</s> resumed narrating the Lord's noble history.

children.text: जब प्रभुजाय बाग नियराने । भूप कोउ लव आवत जाने ॥
children.translated_text: When the Lord approached the garden, a king — <s>Lava</s> — perceived someone coming.

children.text: तुरित उठाय लीन धनुबाना । रोके राह बोलि बलवाना ॥
children.translated_text: Swiftly he took up his bow and arrows, blocked the path, and called out mightily.

children.text: भूप भला जो आपन चहहू । तो आगे अब पाँव न धरहू ॥
children.translated_text: 'O king, if you wish your own well-being, then do not set foot further ahead.'

children.text: अस कहि चाप चढ़ाय भवानी । चले तुरित लव शरसन्धानी ॥
children.translated_text: Saying this, O <s>Bhavānī</s>, <s>Lava</s> strung his bow and advanced swiftly, arrow fitted to the string.

children.text: सुनि लव बचन उमा रघुराई । रहे मौन कछु कहत न आई ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing <s>Lava's</s> words, O <s>Umā</s>, <s>Raghurāī</s> remained silent — no words came to him.

children.text: निरखिस्वरूप थकितभेलोचन । कृपासिन्धु प्रणतारतमोचन ॥
children.translated_text: Beholding <s>Lava's</s> form, his eyes were transfixed — the ocean of mercy, the liberator of the afflicted who seek refuge.

children.text: धनि बिरञ्चि जिन रूपसवाँरी । असशोभानहिंकतहुंनिहारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Blessed is <s>Brahmā</s> who fashioned such beauty — such splendor has not been seen anywhere.'

children.text: त्यहि अवसर कुश बनतेआये । विपिनभीर सुनि आतुरधाये ॥
children.translated_text: At that moment, <s>Kuśa</s> came from the forest, hearing the commotion in the woods, he rushed anxiously.

children.text: देखि भीर भूपति कटकाई । धरि उर धीर चले हरषाई ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the crowd of the king's army, he took courage in his heart and advanced joyfully.

children.text: दो० पहुँचेकुश वरबण्डतहँ जहां ठाढ़ लव बीर ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: <s>Kuśa</s>, that excellent warrior, arrived where the heroic <s>Lava</s> stood,

children.text: होत बतकही भूपसन लिये सजग धनुतीर ॥
children.translated_text: exchanging words with the king, holding bow and arrow at the ready.

children.text: जबलव अनुजहि आवतजाना । भेबलअधिकसुता हिमवाना ॥
children.translated_text: When <s>Lava</s> saw his younger brother approaching, his strength increased, O daughter of <s>Himavān</s>.

children.text: दोउ भ्राता मुनिवर फुलवारी । सजगभये धनुबाण सिधारी ॥
children.translated_text: Both brothers stood alert in the sage's garden, ready with bow and arrows.

children.text: शोभा देखि काम रति लाजै । कोटि मयंक बदन छबिछाजै ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing their beauty, <s>Kāma</s> and <s>Rati</s> would feel ashamed; the splendor of their faces outshone ten million moons.

children.text: दूसरौ कुवँर विलोकि कृपाला । भयेमुदितकहि बचनरसाला ॥
children.translated_text: Beholding the second prince, the gracious Lord was delighted and spoke sweet words:

children.text: जनुविधि सब आपनि चतुराई । इन्हैं सवाँरि विश्व दिखराई ॥
children.translated_text: 'It is as if <s>Brahmā</s> displayed all his craftsmanship to the world in fashioning them.

children.text: शोभासिन्धु मनोहर जोरी । अतिसुकुमार बैस सुठिथोरी ॥
children.translated_text: An ocean of beauty, a captivating pair — exceedingly tender, of very young age.

children.text: लखिनखशिखशोभा दोउबीरा । मोहे प्रेम विवश रघुबीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the beauty of both heroes from head to toe, <s>Raghubīra</s> was enchanted, overcome with love.'

children.text: त्यहिअवसर प्रभुगतिखगराई । शारद शेष सकैं नहिं गाई ॥
children.translated_text: At that moment, the Lord's state, O king of birds, could not be sung even by <s>Śāradā</s> (<s>Sarasvatī</s>) or <s>Śeṣa</s>.

children.text: महिमा कहत थके श्रुतिचारी । तहां कौन मर्याद हमारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'The four <s>Vedas</s> have grown weary singing his glory — what standing do we have there?'

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Verse:

children.text: मर्याद कौन हमारि तहँ जहँ भेद वेद न पावई ।
children.translated_text: 'What standing is ours in that realm where even the <s>Vedas</s> cannot fathom the mystery?

children.text: भे थकित निगमपुराण कहि २ अपरगतिको गावई ॥
children.translated_text: The <s>Nigamas</s> and <s>Purāṇas</s> have grown weary, singing again and again of that transcendent state.

children.text: ब्रह्माण्डप्रति विधि विष्णु हर जो रचै और सँहारई ।
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Hara</s> (<s>Śiva</s>), who create and destroy each universe —

children.text: स्वइ राम पूरण काम खग दोउ बीर चिकित निहारई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Rāma</s> himself, whose every desire is fulfilled, O bird — he gazes at the two heroes, astonished.'

children.text: सो० जानिसुवन बलवान बयकिशोर करणी कठिन ।
children.translated_text: Sohā: Knowing the boys to be mighty, young in age but formidable in deed,

children.text: विहँसि कह्यो भगवान काके तुम बालक दोऊ ॥
children.translated_text: the Lord smiled and said: 'Whose children are you two?

children.text: कहो मातु पितु नाम क्यहि कारण बनमें बसहु ।
children.translated_text: Tell me your mother's and father's names — why do you dwell in the forest?

children.text: कौन तुरग सों काम बांधि जाहि जूझत फिरो ॥
children.translated_text: What do you want with this horse — why do you go about fighting over it?

children.text: यदपि कीन लड़काय तदपि सिखावन देहुं मैं ।
children.translated_text: Though you have fought like children, still let me give you counsel:

children.text: अबहूं देहु मँगाय तुरग पाय हम जाहिं फिर ॥
children.translated_text: Return the horse now — receiving it, we shall depart.'

children.text: सुनि कुश लव दोउभाय बाणी राजनमधुरसम ।
children.translated_text: Hearing the words of the king, sweet as nectar, both brothers <s>Kuśa</s> and <s>Lava</s>

children.text: बोले तब मुसकाय कहा काम पितु मातु सन ॥
children.translated_text: then spoke with a smile: 'What need have we of a father or mother?

children.text: जाहि विरञ्चिदेय हय आजू । सो करि समर जाय लै राजू ॥
children.translated_text: Whoever <s>Brahmā</s> grants the horse to today — let him win it in battle and take it, O king.'

children.text: जब अस वचन कहा दोउबीरा । हृदय विचार कीन रघुबीरा ॥
children.translated_text: When the two heroes spoke such words, <s>Raghubīra</s> pondered in his heart:

children.text: मुनिवर तनय कहां अस होई । जो अस नीतिराख उर सोई ॥
children.translated_text: 'How could sage's sons be like this — whoever harbors such resolve in their heart?

children.text: ये कोउ भूपसुवन बलधारी । जासु तेज नहिं जाय निहारी ॥
children.translated_text: These are some prince's mighty sons, whose splendor cannot be looked upon.'

children.text: अस सुनि प्रभु बोले खगराई । हम अपनेदिशिकहिसमुझाई ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing this, the Lord spoke, O king of birds: 'We have explained from our side.

children.text: जो निज कीन्ह चहहु संग्रामा । तो रणकरह आय बलधामा ॥
children.translated_text: If you insist on battle, then come to the battlefield, O abodes of strength.'

children.text: भपवचन सुनि दोऊ बीरा । आये जहँ कृपालु रणधीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the king's words, the two heroes came to where the gracious, battle-steadfast Lord stood.

children.text: सुभट बुलाय कह्यो रघुनाथा । युद्धकरो सन्मुख दोउ साथा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Raghunātha</s> called his warriors and said: 'Fight facing both of them together.

children.text: दुइ दुइ वीर कटकते जाहू। समर करहु जनि उर कदराहू ॥
children.translated_text: Let pairs of warriors go from the army; engage in battle, and let not your hearts quail.'

children.text: दो० सुन खगेश रघुनाथ जब बचन कह्यो भटबोल ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Listen, O lord of birds — when <s>Raghunātha</s> spoke the word to summon warriors,

children.text: तमके दोउ बलवान तब कोध देखि महि डोल ॥
children.translated_text: the two mighty ones flared with rage, and seeing their fury, the earth trembled.

children.text: तबलवकुश निजहृदय बिचारी । समरकरी तजि मुनि फुलवारी ॥
children.translated_text: Then <s>Lava</s> and <s>Kuśa</s> deliberated in their hearts and resolved to fight, leaving the sage's garden.

children.text: ज्यहि मुनिबाग खीस नहिं होई । कीजै काज उचित अब सोई ॥
children.translated_text: 'So that no anger falls upon the sage's garden, let us now do what is proper.'

children.text: मुनि बालकन कह्यो समुझाई । रहहु सजग देखत अमराई ॥
children.translated_text: The sage-boys gave instructions to their companions: 'Stay alert and watch over the grove.

children.text: तुम कहँ नहिं कौनौ डर भाई । मैं देखों भूपति कटकाई ॥
children.translated_text: You have nothing to fear, brothers — I shall go and face the king's army.'

children.text: असकहि धनुषबाणकरलीन्हा । सन्मुख भूप गमनतब कीन्हा ॥
children.translated_text: Saying this, he took bow and arrows in hand and advanced to confront the king.

children.text: दुहुंदिशिते भे क्रोध अपारा । लागे लड़ै सुभट बरियारा ॥
children.translated_text: From both sides, boundless fury arose; the mighty warriors began to fight.

children.text: बहु छल बल पौरूष भटकरहीं । समर अजिरमुरछितह्वै परहीं ॥
children.translated_text: The warriors employed many stratagems, strength, and valor; on the field of battle, they fell unconscious.

children.text: यहि प्रकार मुनि होयलड़ाई शोभित देखैं रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: In this manner, the sage watched the battle unfold, and beheld the splendid <s>Raghurāī</s>.

children.text: जे भट होइँ कटकते न्यारे । ते न फिरैं लै प्राण बिचारे ॥
children.translated_text: Whatever warriors were separated from the army — they would not return, the wretched ones, with their lives.

children.text: दो० याविधि जूझे सुभतसब करि पौरूषखगनाथ ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: In this manner all the warriors fought and died, displaying their prowess, O lord of birds;

children.text: गिने सुभट बाचे कछू भरद्वाज प्रभुसाथ ॥
children.translated_text: the few warriors that remained were counted — they stayed with <s>Bharadvāja</s> and the Lord.

children.text: असकौतुक लखि राम सुजाना । लागे कहन बोलि हनुमाना ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing this spectacle, the wise <s>Rāma</s> began to speak, summoning <s>Hanumāna</s>.

children.text: कुवँर दोउ अतिशय बलधारी । छिनमें सकलसुभट रणमारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'The two princes are supremely powerful; in a moment they have slain all the warriors on the battlefield.'

children.text: मन कछुहरष विषाद न आने । खड़े सहज दोउ बीरसयाने ॥
children.translated_text: 'Neither joy nor sorrow have they shown in their minds; both wise heroes stand at ease.'

children.text: देखत लघु दोउ कालसमाना । जायनसकहिंनिकटबलवाना ॥
children.translated_text: 'Though they appear small, both are like Death personified; no mighty one can approach them.'

children.text: मैं सब विधि अनरथ कै खेतू । अस उतपात भयो ज्यहि हेतृ ॥
children.translated_text: 'I am in every way the cause of this calamity — such a disaster has occurred on my account.'

children.text: मखहय कारण तीनों भाई । सुभट सहित जूझे बनआई ॥
children.translated_text: 'For the sake of the sacrificial horse, all three brothers, along with the warriors, have fought and fallen in the forest.'

children.text: सेनापति कोशलपुर जेते । प्राणतजे यहि कानन तेते ॥
children.translated_text: 'All the commanders that came from <s>Kośalapura</s> — they have lost their lives in this very forest.'

children.text: जाऊँ अवध फिरि तो बड़लाजू । आय बना सब मरण समाजू ॥
children.translated_text: 'If I return to Ayodhyā, it is a great shame; coming here, the whole assembly of death has been arranged.'

children.text: कहत वचन लोचन जलढरके । कुसमय देखि ताहिप्रभूहरके ॥
children.translated_text: Saying these words, tears streamed from his eyes; seeing the dire time, the Lord was shaken.

children.text: दो० ऐसी विधि बिलखायमन कीन्ह शोच रघुबीर ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: In this manner, lamenting in his mind, the Hero of the <s>Raghus</s> grieved;

children.text: सुन समीर सुत रीछपति भरे नयन जलनीर ॥
children.translated_text: hearing this, the son of the Wind (<s>Hanumāna</s>) and the lord of bears (<s>Jāmbavān</s>) — their eyes filled with tears.

children.text: लवकुश देखि भूप भयमानी । जाय निकट बोले असबानी ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the king fearful, <s>Lava</s> and <s>Kusha</s> went near and spoke these words:

children.text: सुनहु नरेश बिलम कसकरहू । की फिरिजाहुकिसन्मुखलरहू ॥
children.translated_text: 'Listen, O king — why do you delay? Either turn back or come fight face-to-face!'

children.text: सुनहु दूध मुख माहुर बानी । फिरे सुभटसब माखिभवानी ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing their 'milk-mouthed yet poison-tongued' words — all the warriors turned [to fight], enraged, O <s>Bhavānī</s>.

children.text: लागे समर करै यकबारा । मारहिं विविध शस्त्रहथियारा ॥
children.translated_text: They began to fight all at once; they struck with various weapons and arms.

children.text: कुशविलोकि सेना रिपु माषे । अनुजहिबोलिवचनअसभाषे ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Kusha</s>, seeing the enemy army enraged, called his younger brother and spoke thus:

children.text: तुम मारहु भूपति कटकाई । मैं देखों नरेश प्रभुताई ॥
children.translated_text: 'You slay the king's army; I shall test the king's prowess.'

children.text: अससमुझाय अनुजकुशबीरा । आपुचले जहँ रथ रघुबीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Thus instructing his younger brother, the valiant <s>Kusha</s> himself went to where the chariot of the Hero of the <s>Raghus</s> was.

children.text: आये जब प्रभुयान समीपा । कहि दुर्बचन सुनाय महीपा ॥
children.translated_text: When he arrived near the Lord's vehicle, he hurled harsh words at the king:

children.text: राजन समर करहु किन आई । की रण ते अब जाहु पराई ॥
children.translated_text: 'O king, come and fight! Or do you now flee from the battlefield?'

children.text: दो० असकहि पर चास्यो प्रभुहि विशिख बाणधरिचाप ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: So saying, he aimed a sharp arrow at the Lord, fitting it to his bow;

children.text: लखि खींचत शारङ्ग कुश उठे देव सब कांप ।
children.translated_text: seeing <s>Kusha</s> draw the <s>Śārṅga</s> [-like bow], all the gods rose up trembling.

children.text: त्रासमान सुरऋषय मुनीशा । विधि हरि हर पदनायोशीशा ॥
children.translated_text: The gods, sages, and lords of sages were terrified; <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Hari</s>, and <s>Hara</s> bowed their heads at His feet.

children.text: नाथ कौन कारण यह देखी । कहो बुझाय कृपालु विशेखी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Lord, for what reason is this happening? Tell us, O gracious One, and explain it clearly.'

children.text: काके प्रभु बालक ये दोऊ । प्रबलप्रेचण्डनजगअसकोऊ ॥
children.translated_text: 'Whose children, O Lord, are these two boys? No one in the world is so powerful and fierce.'

children.text: जाके समर सेन रघुनाथा । विकल पुकारत यथा अनाथा ॥
children.translated_text: 'Against whom in battle the army of the Lord of the <s>Raghus</s> cries out in distress, as if without protector.'

children.text: वय किशोर मृदु गात सुहाई । रूप देखि बहु काम लजाई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Of adolescent age, with soft and lovely limbs; seeing their beauty, even <s>Kāma</s> (the god of love) is put to shame.'

children.text: ते पुनि कीन्ह समर अतिभारी । दल दश चारि क्षोहिणी मारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Yet they have fought a tremendous battle; they have slain fourteen <s>akṣauhiṇī</s> divisions.'

children.text: उर सन्देह नाथ लखि होई । बेगि बुझाय कहो प्रभु सोई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Doubt has arisen in our hearts, O Lord — quickly explain and tell us!'

children.text: तब विरञ्चि प्रभु कथा रसाला । कहिसमुझाय सुरन त्यहिकाला ॥
children.translated_text: Then <s>Brahmā</s>, the Lord, narrated the delightful story, explaining it to the gods at that time.

children.text: परम कौतुकी कोशल भूपा । अलखअखण्डअनामअरूपा ॥
children.translated_text: 'The king of <s>Kośala</s> is supremely wondrous — unseen, undivided, nameless, formless.'

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Chanda (verse):

children.text: निष्काम नाम निरूप सो प्रभु प्रकट है अवधेशके ।
children.translated_text: 'That desireless, nameless, formless Lord has manifested as the King of Ayodhyā.'

children.text: मखराखि विश्वामित्र मुनिप्रणसिद्ध किय मिथिलेशके ॥
children.translated_text: 'He protected the sacrifice of <s>Viśvāmitra</s> and accomplished the vow of the Lord of <s>Mithilā</s>.'

children.text: स्वइ ब्रह्म अजय अरूप अविगत देह धरि लीला करी ।
children.translated_text: 'The Supreme <s>Brahman</s> Himself, unconquerable, formless, invisible — taking a body, He performed His play (<s>līlā</s>).'

children.text: नहिं जान कोउ अजान सब लखि चरित भवसागर तरी ॥
children.translated_text: 'No one knows — all are unknowing; seeing His deeds, they have crossed the ocean of existence.'

children.text: सुखधाम रामनमामि असकहि चारमुख अस्तुतिकियो ।
children.translated_text: 'The abode of bliss, <s>Rāma</s>, I bow to Him!' — thus four-faced [<s>Brahmā</s>] offered praise.

children.text: बैराट रूप लखाय देवन आप परिपूरण भयो ॥
children.translated_text: Showing His cosmic form to the gods, He Himself became the All-pervading.

children.text: दो० जबहिं जीति लंकेश रण आये पुर श्रीराम ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'When, having conquered the lord of <s>Laṅkā</s> in battle, Lord <s>Rāma</s> returned to the city,'

children.text: गर्वबढ़यो सब अनुजके कहि विधिगे निजधाम ॥
children.translated_text: 'the pride of all the younger brothers increased' — so saying, <s>Brahmā</s> went to his own abode.

children.text: त्यहि कारण कौतुक कियो कृपासिन्धु रघुराज ।
children.translated_text: 'For that reason, the ocean of mercy, the <s>Raghu</s>-king, performed this divine sport;'

children.text: गर्व निवास्यो अनुज सब सुन अस भारद्वाज ॥
children.translated_text: 'he humbled the pride of all the younger brothers — hear thus, O <s>Bharadvāja</s>.'

children.text: तब प्रभ देख बलि रिपु आछे । कटि में रुचिर काछनी काछे ॥
children.translated_text: Then the Lord beheld the two noble enemies; with a beautiful loincloth tied at the waist,

children.text: कर सरोज धनुबाण बिराजै । कोटिनभानुज्योतिछबि छाजै ॥
children.translated_text: bow and arrow resplendent in lotus-hands; their brilliance surpassing ten million suns.

children.text: निपट निरंकुश युगल कुमारा । बिन संख्या योधारण मारा ॥
children.translated_text: Utterly unruly, the twin princes — they had slain warriors without number.

children.text: मोहिं यहँ आय समरके काजा । जो न लड़ों तो होय अकाजा ॥
children.translated_text: 'I have come here for the purpose of battle; if I do not fight, then the purpose will fail.'

children.text: अस विचारि प्रभु शोचे भाई । निज उर मन्त्र समर ठहराई ॥
children.translated_text: Thus reflecting, the Lord grieved for his brothers; settling a battle-strategy in his heart,

children.text: भयो क्रोध गिरिराजकुमारी । सजग भये रथ राम खरारी ॥
children.translated_text: anger arose, O Daughter of the Mountain-King; the Lord became alert on the chariot, <s>Rāma</s> the destroyer of <s>Khara</s>.

children.text: धनुष चढ़ाय विषम शरजोरे । बोले बचन सुधारस बोरे ॥
children.translated_text: Stringing his bow, fitting fierce arrows, he spoke words steeped in nectar:

children.text: मैं अब लग त्वहिं बालबिचारी । कीन क्षमा सब चूक तुम्हारी ॥
children.translated_text: 'Until now I have considered you children; I have forgiven all your offenses.'

children.text: यदपि अनीतिमहा तुम कीन्ही । तदपि न मैं एको चित दीनही ॥
children.translated_text: 'Though you have committed great injustice, even so I have not paid it any mind.'

children.text: दो० सजग होहु रण खेतमें कहों वचन परमान ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'Be alert on the battlefield; I say these words as a final warning.'

children.text: रिसबश शर जोरत भये खींच चापलग कान ॥
children.translated_text: In anger he fitted arrows, drawing the bow-string to his ear.

children.text: कुश विलोकि कोप्यो युवराजा । लिय धनुबाण समरके काजा ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the crown-prince (<s>Rāma</s>) enraged, <s>Kusha</s> took up bow and arrow for battle.

children.text: सुमिरि मातुपद बारम्बारा । भयो क्रोध खगराज अपारा ॥
children.translated_text: Remembering his mother's feet again and again, the lord of birds (<s>Kusha</s>) became boundlessly angry.

children.text: विशिख बाण छोड़े त्यहिकाला । चलेतुरितजहँ अवधभुवाला ॥
children.translated_text: He released sharp arrows at that time; they sped swiftly toward the King of Ayodhyā.

children.text: आवत देख विषमशर भारी । प्रभुकौतुकी काटि महि डारी ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the great fierce arrows approach, the playful Lord cut them down and cast them to the earth.

children.text: ज्वइ ज्वइ बाणगये कुशप्रेरे । स्वइ स्वइ शरनमारि प्रभुफेरे ॥
children.translated_text: Every arrow that <s>Kusha</s> sent — every one the Lord cut down and sent back with His own arrows.

children.text: देखि प्रताप नरेश अपारा । सुवनसियानिजहृदयविचारा ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the king's boundless prowess, <s>Sītā</s>'s son reflected in his heart:

children.text: यह कोउ भूप महाबलवाना । जासु समीप जाय नहिं बाना ॥
children.translated_text: 'This is some supremely powerful king — no arrow can reach his vicinity.'

children.text: हृदय कोप बरषा शर कीन्हे । तुरितबिमानतोपि प्रभुलीन्हे ॥
children.translated_text: With anger in his heart, he released a shower of arrows; the Lord swiftly deflected them from his chariot.

children.text: दण्ड एक प्रभु यान भवानी । पस्यो न देखि सुरन भयमानी ॥
children.translated_text: For one <s>daṇḍa</s> (period of time), O <s>Bhavānī</s>, the Lord's chariot was not visible; seeing this, the gods were terrified.

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Chanda (verse):

children.text: नहिं पस्यो देखि विमान प्रभु यक दण्ड अस कौतुकभयो ।
children.translated_text: The Lord's chariot was not visible for one daṇḍa — such was the spectacle that occurred.

children.text: ह्वै परम विकल पुकारि देवन धीर नहिं काहुइ रह्यो ॥
children.translated_text: Becoming exceedingly distressed, the gods cried out; no one retained their composure.

children.text: अवलोकि चरित अपार प्रभु नर नाग मुनि शोचहिं खड़े ।
children.translated_text: Observing these extraordinary deeds of the Lord — men, <s>Nāgas</s>, and sages stood grieving.

children.text: ब्रह्मादि विष्णु गणेश सुरपति देव सब बाहन चढ़े ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Gaṇeśa</s>, <s>Indra</s> — all the gods mounted their vehicles.

children.text: प्रभु देखि रिपु परताप बल हँसि चाप शायक कर लई ।
children.translated_text: The Lord, seeing the enemy's prowess and strength, smiled and took bow and arrow in hand.

children.text: सब बाण बाणन काटि अपने निमिष महँ रजसम कई ॥
children.translated_text: He cut all [the enemy's] arrows with His own, reducing them to dust in an instant.

children.text: असच रितक रि प्रभुश ायकन पुनि आय तरकस में भरे ।
children.translated_text: Having performed such deeds, the Lord's arrows returned and filled His quiver again.

children.text: रथ निरखि शोभित अवधपति सुर सुमनकी वरषा करे ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the King of Ayodhyā resplendent on his chariot, the gods showered flowers from heaven.

children.text: सो० देखि प्रताप महीप अस्तुति नभते करत सुर ।
children.translated_text: Soraṭhā: Seeing the king's prowess, the gods praised him from the sky;

children.text: बोले जाय समीप परम क्रोध करि बीर कुश ॥
children.translated_text: the valiant <s>Kusha</s> approached, speaking with supreme anger.

children.text: कहि बहु बचन बहुरि शर मारा । स्वउ शर राम काटिमहिडारा ॥
children.translated_text: Saying many words, he struck again with arrows; the Lord again cut his arrows and cast them to the earth.

children.text: अमित निषङ्ग शरन बिनकीन्हे । बाणखण्डि डारिमहिदीन्हे ॥
children.translated_text: He emptied countless quivers of arrows; [<s>Rāma</s>] broke the arrows and cast them to the ground.

children.text: ज्वइ ज्वइ लव शर मार खगेशा । स्वइस्वइकाटिदीन्हअवधेशा ॥
children.translated_text: Every arrow that <s>Lava</s> struck, O lord of birds — every one the King of Ayodhyā cut down.

children.text: यहि प्रकार तहँ होय लड़ाई । देखों ठाढ़ सुनहु गिरिजाई ॥
children.translated_text: In this manner the battle continued there — 'I stood watching,' hear, O Daughter of the Mountain.

children.text: तबलव एक बाण अतिभारी । अतिसकोपि प्रभु ऊपरमारी ॥
children.translated_text: Then <s>Lava</s>, in supreme anger, struck a mighty arrow at the Lord.

children.text: बाचे अब कोशल रघुराई । ध्वजा पताका काटि गिराई ॥
children.translated_text: 'Now look, O <s>Raghu</s>-king of <s>Kośala</s>!' — he cut down and felled the flag and banner.

children.text: परम निडर लखि प्रभुमुसकाने । चापचढ़ाय श्रवणलग ताने ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing him utterly fearless, the Lord smiled; stringing His bow, He drew it to His ear.

children.text: छोड़े बाण अमित तेहि काला । कहिकहिसुन्दरबचनरसाला ॥
children.translated_text: He released countless arrows at that time, saying beautiful and delightful words:

children.text: मारन योग सुवन दोउ नाहीं । भय देखायआवहुमोहिंपाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: 'These two sons are not fit to be slain; I shall show them fear — come to me!'

children.text: सो० प्रभु आयसुधरिशीश चलेचापतजि बाणसब ।
children.translated_text: Soraṭhā: Receiving the Lord's command upon their heads, [the arrows] went forth, abandoning bow and quiver;

children.text: कीन कहानिजईश लीनघेरि चहुँदिशिरिपुहि ॥
children.translated_text: they performed the Lord's will — surrounding the enemy on all four sides.

children.text: लवहि घेरि बहु त्रास दिखावें । प्रभुरुखपाय पास नहिं आवे ॥
children.translated_text: They surrounded <s>Lava</s> and showed him great terror; but seeing the Lord's displeasure, [the arrows] would not approach.

children.text: ऐसी भांति सुनो मुनिराई । घेरेहु लवहि बाण रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: In this manner, hear O lord of sages, the Lord of the <s>Raghus</s> surrounded <s>Lava</s> with arrows.

children.text: लीन छाय बाणन रणखेतू । सूझि न परै कतहुं खगकेतू ॥
children.translated_text: The battlefield was covered with the shadow of arrows; nowhere could the eagle-bannered [<s>Rāma</s>] be seen.

children.text: भयोबिकलत्यहिक्षण लव बीरा । बोले रिपु सन्मुख मतिधीरा ॥
children.translated_text: The valiant <s>Lava</s> became distressed at that moment; the steadfast-minded hero spoke to the enemy face-to-face:

children.text: होहु सजग भूपति यहिकाला । मारिबिषमशर करों बिहाला ॥
children.translated_text: 'Be alert at this moment, O king! I shall strike you with fierce arrows and make you helpless!'

children.text: छांड़यो अतिकराल बहुबाना । चल्योसोसन्मुखश्रीभगवाना ॥
children.translated_text: He released many terrible arrows; they sped toward the Blessed Lord.

children.text: तेजवन्त शर बिषम बिलोका । प्रभुनिजवाण प्रेरितेहिरोका ॥
children.translated_text: The Lord, seeing the splendid, fierce arrows, blocked them with His own arrows.

children.text: भै बाणनते विविध लड़ाई । रधुबर शर तेहि मारिगिराई ॥
children.translated_text: The battle raged back and forth with arrows; the best of the <s>Raghus</s> struck down [<s>Lava</s>'s arrows] and felled them.

children.text: लखिप्रभुता लव अवधभुआरा । बनै न कछु उरकरत बिचारा ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the prowess of the King of Ayodhyā, <s>Lava</s> could do nothing; he reflected in his heart.

children.text: सो० बनैनकरत बिचार समुझि भूप बलवान अति ।
children.translated_text: Soraṭhā: Unable to succeed despite deliberation, realizing the king's supreme strength,

children.text: क्षणक्षण होतखभार बरणिनजाय खगेशगति ॥
children.translated_text: moment by moment the burden increased — the course of events, O lord of birds, cannot be described.

children.text: दो० उमा सुभटसब मारि कुश मुदित पूजिरणखेत ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: O <s>Umā</s>, <s>Kusha</s>, having slain all the warriors, joyfully worshipped the battlefield;

children.text: अनुज पास गवने तुरत परम अनन्द समेत ॥
children.translated_text: he went at once to his younger brother's side, with supreme delight.

children.text: देखि लवहि कुश संकट भारी । चलेसजग धनुबाण सँवारी ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing <s>Lava</s> in great peril, <s>Kusha</s> set out, alert, arranging his bow and arrows.

children.text: जाय देखिगति अनुजदुखारी । घेरे चहुंदिशि बाणनिहारी ॥
children.translated_text: Going and seeing his younger brother's plight, he observed that arrows surrounded him on all four sides.

children.text: तमकि सकोप तूणिशर खींचे । फूंकि सुधारि चापगहिखींचे ॥
children.translated_text: Starting up in anger, he drew arrows from his quiver; blowing on them and preparing, he grasped and drew his bow.

children.text: छाँड़यो बाण कोपि कुश बीरा । फिरे उमा प्रभुके सब तीरा ॥
children.translated_text: The valiant <s>Kusha</s> released arrows in anger; O <s>Umā</s>, all the Lord's arrows turned back.

children.text: प्रविशे शर निषङ्ग सब आई । देखि प्रताप हँसे रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: The arrows returned and entered the quiver again; seeing this prowess, the Lord of the <s>Raghus</s> smiled.

children.text: पूंछा कुश अनुजहि मृदुबानी । सकलकथा लवतुरतबखानी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Kusha</s> asked his younger brother in gentle words; <s>Lava</s> quickly narrated the entire story.

children.text: सुनिरिसभे कुश सुनहुभवानी । चले सकोप बाण धनुतानी ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing it, <s>Kusha</s> became enraged — hear, O <s>Bhavānī</s> — he set out in anger, bow and arrow drawn.

children.text: मारों भूपहि अस प्रण ठाना । सन्मुखआय कह्यो बलवाना ॥
children.translated_text: 'I shall slay the king!' — making this vow, the powerful one came face-to-face and declared:

children.text: सजग होहु महिपाल सकेहि । तजों न आज शप्तमुनि मोही ॥
children.translated_text: 'Be alert, O king, at this moment! Do not let go today — the sage has given me his oath!'

children.text: दो० कहिकहि कोटिक बचन कटु उमाकरै को कान ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Saying hundreds of thousands of harsh words — O <s>Umā</s>, who would heed them? —

children.text: छाँड़े बाण प्रचण्ड अति सन्मुख श्रीभगवान ॥
children.translated_text: he released supremely fierce arrows, face-to-face with the Blessed Lord.

children.text: प्रभु जाना कोपे दोउ भाई । सुमिरिशिवाशिवचापचढ़ाई ॥
children.translated_text: The Lord knew both brothers were enraged; remembering <s>Śiva</s> and <s>Śivā</s>, He strung His bow.

children.text: चले दुहूंदिशि बाण कराला । महातेज बड़वानल ज्वाला ॥
children.translated_text: Terrible arrows flew from both sides — with great brilliance, like the flames of the submarine fire.

children.text: उत दोउबन्धु इतै रघुराई । समर भूमि खगहोय लड़ाई ॥
children.translated_text: On one side the two brothers, on the other the Lord of the <s>Raghus</s> — the battle raged on the battlefield, O bird.

children.text: कोउ काहूसे मरै न मारा । युद्धकरैं करि क्रोध अपारा ॥
children.translated_text: Neither could slay the other; they fought with boundless anger.

children.text: बीते बहुत दिवस यहि भाँती । चलैं बाण तीक्षणदिन राती ॥
children.translated_text: Many days passed in this manner; sharp arrows flew day and night.

children.text: टूटेचाप अमित मुनि ज्ञानी । झरे तीर तरकसन भवानी ॥
children.translated_text: Countless bows were broken, O wise sage; arrows rained from quivers, O <s>Bhavānī</s>.

children.text: दोउदिशिते नभ बाणन छाई । शशिअरुभानु न परैलखाई ॥
children.translated_text: From both sides, the sky was covered with arrows; neither moon nor sun could be seen.

children.text: अस संग्राम विलोकि खगेशा । डगीधरणिब्याकुलभयेशेशा ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing such a battle, O lord of birds, the earth shook; <s>Śeṣa</s> (the world-serpent) became agitated.

children.text: सुर नर असुर सिद्ध मुनि झारी । भे सब जीव सचेत दुखारी ॥
children.translated_text: Gods, men, demons, <s>Siddhas</s>, sages — all entire — all living beings became conscious and sorrowful.

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Chanda (verse):

children.text: सबभे सचेत अचेत तब नहिं धीर मन काहू धरा ।
children.translated_text: All became conscious then — no one retained steadfastness of mind.

children.text: दशचार पुरके मध्यमें नभ घोर डरसब सुनिपरा ॥
children.translated_text: In the midst of the fourteen worlds, a terrible sound was heard from the sky, and all were frightened.

children.text: रघुनाथ अरु दोउतनय सिय संग्रामबहुदिनसे मची ।
children.translated_text: The Lord of the <s>Raghus</s> and his two sons, [born of] <s>Sītā</s> — the battle had raged for many days.

children.text: कहि दास चेरे कहैं सब असहोय जो बिधनारची ॥
children.translated_text: Servants and slaves all said: 'Such is what fate has wrought!'

children.text: सो० जानि न जाय खगेश गूढ़ चरित रघुबंशमणि ।
children.translated_text: Soraṭhā: The hidden play of the jewel of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty, O lord of birds, cannot be known;

children.text: कहि न सकैं श्रुतिशेश गिरा शारदा मूक भइ ॥
children.translated_text: even the <s>Śrutis</s> (scriptures) and <s>Śeṣa</s> cannot speak of it; the voice of <s>Śāradā</s> (<s>Sarasvatī</s>) has fallen mute.

children.text: दो० सो मैं कौनी भांति खग कहि समुझावों तोहिं ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: 'How, O bird, can I in any way explain it to you?'

children.text: प्रभु लीला अवगाह नद पर न सूझै मोहिं ॥
children.translated_text: 'The Lord's play is a river whose depths are unfathomable — even I cannot fathom the far shore.'

children.text: असकहि कागभुशुण्डिमुनीशा । बारबार प्रभुपद धरिशीशा ॥
children.translated_text: So saying, <s>Kāgabhuśuṇḍi</s> the sage, again and again placing his head at the Lord's feet,

children.text: लाग्यो कहन खगेश सुनाई । पिता पुत्र जस करहिंलड़ाई ॥
children.translated_text: began to narrate to the lord of birds how father and sons fought.

children.text: ऋक्षनाथ अङ्गद हनुमाना । प्रभुसमीप ठाढ़े बलवाना ॥
children.translated_text: The lord of bears (<s>Jāmbavān</s>), <s>Aṅgada</s>, and <s>Hanumāna</s> stood nearby the Lord, those mighty ones.

children.text: देखिमहारण करहिं बिचारा । परमस भीत न जाहिनिहारा ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the great battle, they reflected; they were supremely afraid and could not bear to watch.

children.text: तहिं चितै बोले सुरत्रात्रा । ठाढ़ रहो धरि धरिज ताता ॥
children.translated_text: The Lord of the gods (<s>Rāma</s>) looked at them and said: 'Stand firm, hold patience, dear ones!'

children.text: कुसमय देखि बिषाद न कीजै । ईश रजाय शीश पर लीजै ॥
children.translated_text: 'Seeing the dire time, do not despair; accept the Lord's will upon your heads.'

children.text: करम प्रधान समुझि मनमाहीं । धीर धरहु कछु संशय नाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: 'Understanding that fate is supreme, hold courage in your hearts — there is no room for doubt.'

children.text: इतना कहि प्रभु यान चलावा । देखिबीर दोउ बिस्मय पावा ॥
children.translated_text: Saying this much, the Lord drove his chariot forward; seeing the two heroes, he was struck with wonder.

children.text: रिपु बलवान देखि दोउ भाई । अतिशयकोपिबाणझरिलाई ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the powerful enemy, both brothers, in supreme rage, unleashed a shower of arrows.

children.text: दो० प्रभु कौतुकी विलोकि तब क्रोध तंश दोउ बीर ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The playful Lord, seeing the anger of both heroes then,

children.text: कीन्ह चरित अनुहार नर कृपासिन्धु रघुबीर ॥
children.translated_text: performed deeds in the likeness of a mortal — the ocean of mercy, the Hero of the <s>Raghus</s>.

children.text: सुनहु खगेश बखानहिं योगू । पावइँ मोह सुनत सबलोगू ॥
children.translated_text: Listen, O lord of birds — they describe it as <s>yoga</s> (divine mystery); hearing it, all the world falls into delusion.

children.text: मनुज देहधरि कीरति काजा । कीन चहहिं प्रभुसो खगराजा ॥
children.translated_text: Taking a human body for the sake of glory — the Lord wished to perform such deeds, O king of birds.

children.text: देखि कुँवर दोउ सिय अनुहारी । उमाराम असहृदय बिचारी ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing both princes resembling <s>Sītā</s> — O <s>Umā</s>, <s>Rāma</s> reflected thus in His heart:

children.text: थहां बास कहुँ जनककुमारी । तासु तनय दोऊ बलधारी ॥
children.translated_text: '<s>Janaka</s>'s daughter must be living somewhere nearby; these two mighty ones are her sons.'

children.text: इनसों युद्धकिये भलनाहीं । हैहित हानि अयशजगमाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: 'It is not right to fight with them — there will be loss, harm, and disgrace in the world.'

children.text: असविचारि प्रभुसुनुउरगारी । धनुष बाण करसों महिडारी ॥
children.translated_text: Thus reflecting, the Lord — hear, O enemy of serpents — cast His bow and arrows to the ground from His hands.

children.text: बन्धुशोक ब्याप्यो उरभारी । परे विकल रथपर दनुजारी ॥
children.translated_text: Overwhelmed by grief for His brothers, the enemy of demons fell distressed upon His chariot.

children.text: जामवन्त अङ्गद हनुबीरा । देखिचरित प्रभुभये अधीरा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Jāmbavān</s>, <s>Aṅgada</s>, and the valiant <s>Hanumāna</s> — seeing the Lord's condition, they lost their composure.

children.text: निरखिबन्धुदोउमुनित्यहिकाला । मुरछित रथदेखे महिपाला ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing their two brothers [fallen] and the sage at that time, they saw the king fainted on the chariot.

children.text: दो० धाये हरष समेत दोउ देख्यो आय समीप ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Both [brothers] rushed forward with delight; they came and saw [the king] up close.

children.text: गिस्यो बाण धनुहाथसों ब्याकुल पस्यो महीप ॥
children.translated_text: His bow and arrows had fallen from his hands; they saw the king lying helpless in a faint.

children.text: जाय निकट बहुभांति जगावा । अङ्ग सचेत नेक नहिं पावा ॥
children.translated_text: Going near, they tried to revive him in many ways; but they found not a trace of consciousness in his limbs.

children.text: ह्वै निरभय तबदोड रणधीरा । लीनछीन पट भूषण बीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Becoming fearless, those battle-steadfast ones rushed forward; the heroes stripped him of his garments and ornaments.

children.text: करमुन्दर शर मुकुट अनूपा । लीन छड़ाय तुरँग रथ भूपा ॥
children.translated_text: They took his finger-rings, arrows, and incomparable crown; they seized the king's horses and chariot.

children.text: अस कौतुकलखि बालिकुमारा । सन्मुख आय तुरतललकारा ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing this spectacle, the son of <s>Vālī</s> (<s>Aṅgada</s>) came face-to-face and immediately challenged them.

children.text: लवकुश देखि महाभट भारी । भे रिसवश गिरिराजकुमारी ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the mighty warrior, <s>Lava</s> and <s>Kusha</s> became enraged, O Daughter of the Mountain-King.

children.text: बाणन बेधिलई कपि देही । बांदरसों जनु ह्वैगयो सेही ॥
children.translated_text: They pierced the monkey's body with arrows; the monkey became like a porcupine, as it were.

children.text: मारिकपिहि रणभूमि सुवाई । गवने भवन मुदित दोउ भाई ॥
children.translated_text: Having struck the monkey on the fine battlefield, both brothers departed joyfully.

children.text: बांधि ऋक्षपति सुवन समीरा । चले अश्वचढ़ि दोउरणधीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Binding the lord of bears and the son of the Wind, the two battle-steadfast ones rode forth on the horse.

children.text: पहुंचेसदन अनुजदोउ साथा। जाय मातुपद नायो माथा ॥
children.translated_text: They reached home, both brothers together; going, they bowed their heads at their mother's feet.

children.text: दो० बिनयकीन दोउचरणगहि मातादीन अशीश ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: They made entreaties, grasping both feet; the mother gave her blessings:

children.text: रहहुचिरञ्चिविबन्धुदोउ जबलगमहि अज ईश ॥
children.translated_text: 'Live long with your brothers, as long as earth, <s>Brahmā</s>, and the Lord endure!'

children.text: आशिषपाय मुदित दोड भाई । भूपलूट सब मातु दिखाई ॥
children.translated_text: Having received blessings, both brothers were delighted; they showed their mother all the king's plunder.

children.text: मुकुट अनूप अमोल निहारी । मुन्दरिनिरखहिशोचभइभारी ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the incomparable, priceless crown, gazing at the finger-ring — heavy grief arose [in <s>Sītā</s>].

children.text: यहमुन्दरि कौशलपुर भूपा । मुकुटशीशप्रभूअधिकअनूपा ॥
children.translated_text: 'This finger-ring belongs to the king of <s>Kośalapura</s>; the crown on the head — the Lord's, surpassingly beautiful!'

children.text: सो कौनीविधि विधि इनपाई । इतनाकहि पुनि बाहर आई ॥
children.translated_text: 'How, by what fate, have these come to them?' — saying this much, she went outside.

children.text: देखि ऋक्षपति पवनकुमारा । लागी रोदनकरै अपारा ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the lord of bears and the son of the Wind, she began to weep profusely.

children.text: परी बिकलमहि सुधिनहिं तेही । करत बिलाप विविधबैदेही ॥
children.translated_text: She fell to the ground, senseless; <s>Vaidehī</s> (<s>Sītā</s>) lamented in many ways:

children.text: सुवननहीं ये जनम्यो काला । अवधनरेशबंश सब घाला ॥
children.translated_text: 'These sons have not been born — Death has been born! They have destroyed the entire dynasty of the King of Ayodhyā!'

children.text: देखि दशा माता दोउ भाई । परेचरण मुखबचन न आई ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing their mother's state, both brothers fell at her feet; no words came from their mouths.

children.text: रोदन करत विदेह कुमारी । छूटे केश न देह सँभारी ॥
children.translated_text: The daughter of <s>Videha</s> wept; her hair came loose, she could not hold her body.

children.text: छन्द ।
children.translated_text: Chanda (verse):

children.text: नहिं देहकी सुधिरही कछु ब्याकुल महाकरुणाकरै ।
children.translated_text: She lost all awareness of her body; exceedingly distressed, she made great lamentation.

children.text: दोउहाथ छातीमारि पुनिपुनि मुरछिभूतलमें परै ॥
children.translated_text: Striking her chest with both hands, she fainted again and again and fell to the ground.

children.text: तेहिसमयसियगतिदेखिखगपतिजातनहिंकबिसोंकही ।
children.translated_text: At that moment, seeing <s>Sītā</s>'s condition, the lord of birds (<s>Jaṭāyu</s>'s kin) was deeply grieved.

children.text: बिनबैनके लोचन बिलोकत मीनबिन पानीरही ॥
children.translated_text: Without words, her eyes gazing — like a fish without water.

children.text: दो० छत टूटत करुणकरत नेक न देह सँभार ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Her composure was shattering, she was making piteous cries, her body was beyond care;

children.text: लखनिजपति भूषणबसन बाढ़त शोचअपार ॥
children.translated_text: seeing her husband's ornaments and garments, her boundless grief increased.

children.text: तेहि क्षणजाय निकट हनुमाना । पद शिरनाय कह्यो बलवाना ॥
children.translated_text: At that moment, mighty <s>Hanumāna</s> came near; bowing his head at her feet, the powerful one spoke:

children.text: मातु धीरधरू कुसमय जानी । मिटै न विधिकर लिखाभवानी ॥
children.translated_text: "Mother, be steadfast, knowing this to be an ill-fated time; what is written by Destiny cannot be erased, O <s>Bhavānī</s>."

children.text: मैं सब चरित सुनावों माता । ज्यहिकारणअससबउतपाता ॥
children.translated_text: "I shall narrate the entire episode to you, Mother — the reason for all this calamity."

children.text: दशरथकुल बन्दन रघुराई । यज्ञ अरम्भकीन हरषाई ॥
children.translated_text: "<s>Rāma</s>, the glory of <s>Daśaratha</s>'s lineage, joyfully commenced the <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice)."

children.text: त्यहिलगिअश्व सुरेश मँगावा । पूजि तुरँग चहुंचक्नफिरावा ॥
children.translated_text: "For that purpose, he had a horse brought from <s>Indra</s> (lord of gods); worshipping the horse, he sent it roaming in all four directions."

children.text: रहे साथ रिपुसूदन बीरा । फिरेजीतिचहुंदिशिरणधीरा ॥
children.translated_text: "The valiant <s>Ripusūdana</s> (<s>Śatrughna</s>) accompanied it; he conquered all four directions in battle, steadfast in war."

children.text: तबलगि हय यहिकानन आवा । मुनिवरबाग चरत इनपावा ॥
children.translated_text: "Then the horse came to this very forest; the great sage found it grazing in [his] garden."

children.text: सो हय बांध्यो तनय तुम्हारे । करि रण रिपुसूदनको मारे ॥
children.translated_text: "That horse was tied up by your sons; they fought and defeated <s>Ripusūdana</s> in battle."

children.text: तासुखोज भारत पुनि आये । कटक समेत सोउ मुरझाये ॥
children.translated_text: "Then <s>Bharata</s> came searching for it; he too, along with his army, was defeated."

children.text: दो० आये फिर सानुजलषण लैसँगसुभट अपार ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: "Then <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> came with his younger brother, bringing with him innumerable warriors;"

children.text: मुरछितकीन्ह्यो समरकरि ताहू तनय तुम्हार ॥
children.translated_text: "your sons made him unconscious too in battle."

children.text: प्रभुकहि लषणगये नहिं आये । यज्ञसभा मुनिवरहि सुनाये ॥
children.translated_text: "The Lord sent <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, [who] went but did not return; the sages reported this to the sacrificial assembly."

children.text: गगनगिरा त्यहिक्षण यहमाता । जूझे रण लक्ष्मण सुरत्राता ।
children.translated_text: "At that very moment, a celestial voice rang out, O Mother: '<s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, the protector of the gods, has fallen in battle.'"

children.text: सुनि नभगिरा कृपाल भवानी । भये शोचबश शारँगपानी ॥
children.translated_text: "Hearing the celestial voice, O merciful <s>Bhavānī</s>, <s>Śārṅgapāṇi</s> (<s>Rāma</s>, bearer of the Śārṅga bow) was overcome with grief."

children.text: चले तुरित गुरु आयसु पाई । देखाआय दशा निजभाई ॥
children.translated_text: "Having received the Guru's permission, He departed at once; coming, He beheld the condition of His own brother."

children.text: कुसमय देखि धस्यो उर धीरा । लागे युद्धकरन रघुबीरा ॥
children.translated_text: "Seeing the calamity, the courage in His heart sank; <s>Raghuvīra</s> (<s>Rāma</s>) engaged in battle."

children.text: सो चरित्र सुनु जनककुमारी । भे मुरछित रथ रामखरारी ॥
children.translated_text: "Hear that episode, O daughter of <s>Janaka</s>: <s>Rāma</s>, the enemy-slayer, fell unconscious upon His chariot."

children.text: तनय तुम्हार निकट तब जाई । पटभूषण सब लीन छडाई ॥
children.translated_text: "Your sons then went near and took away all His garments and ornaments."

children.text: सेवकसहित भालुकुल । लायेबांधि भवन दोउ भ्राता ॥
children.translated_text: "Along with the servants and the bear-clan, they brought and bound both brothers to the house."

children.text: बिनजाने असअनरथ भयऊ । कथासमस्तपवनसुतकह्यऊ ॥
children.translated_text: "Without knowing, such a catastrophe occurred" — the son of the wind (<s>Hanumāna</s>) narrated the entire story.

children.text: सो० धीरजधरहुसँभारि परिहरिरिस दोउसुवनसन ।
children.translated_text: Sorṭhā: "Be steadfast, compose yourself, let go of anger toward both your sons;"

children.text: मातु सकै को टारि होनहार सबसे कठिन ॥
children.translated_text: "Mother, who can avert what is destined to happen — the most difficult of all?"

children.text: कीशबचन सुनि नयन उधारी । चितैचहूँदिशिसुवननिहारी ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the monkey's words, she raised her eyes; looking in all four directions, she beheld her sons.

children.text: देखिमातु तेहिक्षण दोउ भाई । महाबिकल ह्वै पदशिरनाई ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing their mother at that moment, both brothers, greatly distressed, bowed their heads at her feet.

children.text: बोले बचन बिगत अभिमाना । करनलगेदोउबहुबिधिआना ॥
children.translated_text: They spoke words free of pride; both began entreating her in many ways.

children.text: मातु वृथा जो बचन सुनावैं । पाप दहैं बालक बध पावैं ॥
children.translated_text: "Mother, if you tell us futile words — sin burns; children receive punishment [for no fault]."

children.text: तुमहूँ कबहुँ न कहि समुझावा । बिनजाने कस दोष लगावा ॥
children.translated_text: "You too never instructed or explained to us; how can blame be assigned without knowledge?"

children.text: गिरैं सुपंथ सुबुधि जलजाता । जो हम जानिकीनरणमाता ॥
children.translated_text: "Let the good sense of those born on the right path wither, if we had knowingly fought, Mother."

children.text: सो बध द्विज मारेकर दोषा । देहिंहमहिं बिधिकरिबहुरोषा ॥
children.translated_text: "That sin is of killing a Brahmin's [protégé]; may Destiny punish us with great wrath."

children.text: बिधि हरिहर पदपङ्कज आनी । कीनकुचाल जोजानिभवानी ॥
children.translated_text: "<s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Hari</s>, and <s>Hara</s> — bringing their lotus feet, played this wicked trick, O <s>Bhavānī</s>, as you know."

children.text: जोकछु कही सो शिरपर लीना । बड़अपराध मातु हमकीना ॥
children.translated_text: "Whatever [punishment] is said, we accept it upon our heads; we have committed a great offense, Mother."

children.text: दो० ऐसीबिधिकहिवचनदोउ करहिं बिबिधबिधिआन ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: In this manner, speaking such words, both entreated her in various ways;

children.text: तदपि न होय प्रतोषसिय लगहिं बचन जनुबान ॥
children.translated_text: yet <s>Sītā</s> was not appeased — the words struck her like arrows.

children.text: पति देवर गुणशील बखानी । शीशधुनहिंसियसुनहुभवानी ॥
children.translated_text: Praising the virtues and noble character of her husband and brother-in-law, <s>Sītā</s> shook her head, listen O <s>Bhavānī</s>.

children.text: तेहि औसरकर दुसह बिषादू । कहिनजायअतिआरतनादू ॥
children.translated_text: The unbearable grief at that moment cannot be described — the cries of extreme distress.

children.text: बाल्मीकि मुनिवर बिज्ञानी । निजआश्रमचरित्रसबजानी ॥
children.translated_text: The sage <s>Vālmīki</s>, the wise one, learned all the events at his hermitage.

children.text: बलिसों मांगि बिदा मुनिराई । सुधाकमपडलु लीन भराई ॥
children.translated_text: Taking leave from <s>Bali</s>, the king of sages filled a vessel with <s>sudhā</s> (nectar).

children.text: शोचबिबश मुनिराज सिधाई । कछुकदिवसमहँआश्रमपाई ॥
children.translated_text: Overwhelmed with grief, the king of sages set out; within a few days, he reached the hermitage.

children.text: देखासियहिदुखितअतिदीना । जिमिअहिपतिमणिखोयमलीना ॥
children.translated_text: He saw <s>Sītā</s> extremely distressed and wretched — like the serpent-lord (<s>Śeṣa</s>) who has lost his jewel, soiled and dejected.

children.text: पूँछा मुनि सब शिषन बुलाई । काके चलत सिया दुखपाई ॥
children.translated_text: Calling all the disciples, the sage inquired: "By whose actions has <s>Sītā</s> suffered such grief?"

children.text: ते सब कारण मुनिहि सुनाई । आदिहुसेसब कहि समुझाई ॥
children.translated_text: They narrated all the reasons to the sage, explaining everything from the beginning.

children.text: सुनत माहामुनि भयो दुखारी । लीनसुवन दोउसियाहँकारी ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing it, the great sage was grieved; he called the two sons and brought them to <s>Sītā</s>.

children.text: दो० अतिमलीनमन बन्धुदोउ बालमीकि रूखपाय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The two brothers, extremely dejected in mind, finding <s>Vālmīki</s>'s shelter,

children.text: कीन दण्डवत आय तब बैठे पद शिरनाय ॥
children.translated_text: came and performed prostration, then sat bowing their heads at his feet.

children.text: मुनिदोउ अनुजलायउरलीन्हे । आशिरबादबिबिधबिधिदीन्हे ॥
children.translated_text: The sage took both younger brothers to his bosom and blessed them in various ways.

children.text: तजहुशोच उर धीरज आनहु । काल कर्मबश ईश्वर जानहु ॥
children.translated_text: "Abandon grief, bring courage to your hearts; know it as the work of Fate, Karma, and God."

children.text: जाय बहुरि सियको समुझाई । बहु इतिहास पुराण सुनाई ॥
children.translated_text: Going again, he consoled <s>Sītā</s>, recounting many ancient stories and <s>Purāṇas</s>.

children.text: महिते सिय उठाय बैठाई । जलमँगाय बिधु बदन धुवाई ॥
children.translated_text: He lifted <s>Sītā</s> from the ground and seated her; bringing water, he washed her moon-like face.

children.text: कछुधीरज आन्यहु बैदेही । सुमिर रामपद परम सनेही ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Vaidehī</s> (<s>Sītā</s>) found some composure; remembering the feet of <s>Rāma</s>, the supremely loving one.

children.text: तब बोले मुनिराज सुबानी । सुनहुसियानिश्चयउरआनी ॥
children.translated_text: Then the king of sages spoke fair words: "Listen, <s>Sītā</s>, and bring certainty to your heart."

children.text: तो पति अजरअमर निष्कामी । पारब्रह्म ईश्वर उरयामी ॥
children.translated_text: "Your husband is ageless, immortal, and desireless — He is <s>Parabrahman</s>, the Supreme Lord, the indweller of hearts."

children.text: ताहि को सकै समररणजीती । कहें पुराण वेद अस नीती ॥
children.translated_text: "Who can defeat Him in battle? The <s>Purāṇas</s> and <s>Vedas</s> declare this principle."

children.text: संशय अस न करिय उर काऊ । तुम जानहु रघुबीर सुभाऊ ॥
children.translated_text: "Harbor no such doubt in your heart; you know the nature of <s>Raghuvīra</s>."

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Chanda:

children.text: जानहु प्रभाव स्वभावप्रभु केहिहेतु असकरुणाकरहु ।
children.translated_text: "You know the Lord's glory and nature — why does He show such compassion (in allowing this)?"

children.text: करिछोह सुवन बोलाय कण्ठलगाय उरधीरज धरहु ॥
children.translated_text: "Be gracious — call your sons, embrace them to your bosom, and hold courage in your heart."

children.text: यहिभांति बारम्बार मुनि सियज्ञान उपदेशत भये ।
children.translated_text: In this manner, again and again, the sage imparted knowledge and counsel to <s>Sītā</s>.

children.text: पुनि बोललीन्ह कुमारदोउ शिष संगलै प्रभुपहँ गये ॥
children.translated_text: Then, taking both princes along with his disciples, he went to the Lord.

children.text: दो० पहुँचे मुनिवर भूमिरण सिया सुवन दोउ संग ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The great sage reached the battlefield, with <s>Sītā</s>'s two sons in company;

children.text: सोवत रथपर दीख तहँ रघुकुल कमल पतंग ॥
children.translated_text: there, sleeping upon the chariot, he beheld the sun of <s>Raghu</s>'s lineage.

children.text: सो० बिनय कीन कर जोर बार बार पदकञ्ज प्रभु ।
children.translated_text: Sorṭhā: With folded hands, again and again at the Lord's lotus feet, he made supplication;

children.text: मुनिवर प्रीति न थोर लागे तब अस्तुति करन ॥
children.translated_text: the great sage's love was no small measure — he then began to offer praise.

children.text: अस्तीतकीन महामुनि ज्ञानी । मथि सब वेद पुराणनछानी ॥
children.translated_text: The wise great sage offered praise, churning all the <s>Vedas</s> and <s>Purāṇas</s>.

children.text: मुनि जो अस्तुति कीन भवानी । सगमनिगमनहिंजायबखानी ॥
children.translated_text: The praise that the sage offered, O <s>Bhavānī</s>, cannot be described even by the <s>Āgamas</s> and <s>Nigamas</s> (scriptures).

children.text: सुनत बिनय रघुनायक जागे । उठेहरषि मुनिवर पदलागे ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the supplication, <s>Raghunāyaka</s> (<s>Rāma</s>) awoke; rising joyfully, He touched the sage's feet.

children.text: मुनिहु लीन प्रभुको उरलाई । लखिनखशिखछबिनयनजुड़ाई ॥
children.translated_text: The sage too embraced the Lord to his bosom; beholding His splendor from head to toe, his eyes were refreshed.

children.text: पूँछिकुशल मुनिवर मृदुबानी । तुम्हरीकृपाकुशलमुनिज्ञानी ॥
children.translated_text: "How are you?" the sage asked in gentle words. "By your grace, all is well, O wise sage."

children.text: भ्रातासहित सुभट यहि देशू । जूझे करि संग्राम मुनेशू ॥
children.translated_text: "In this region, along with my brothers and the warriors, they fought and battled, O lord of sages."

children.text: को मुनिराज कुबँर वै दोऊ । जेहिसमान जगबीर न कोऊ ॥
children.translated_text: "Who are these two princes, O king of sages, whose equal in valor exists nowhere in the world?"

children.text: इन्द्रजीत लोनासुर मारे । ताहि समर दोउ कुवँरसँहारे ॥
children.translated_text: "Those who slew <s>Indrajit</s> and the demon <s>Lavaṇāsura</s> — those two princes vanquished them in battle."

children.text: कहो मुनीश सुवन दोउकाके । पस्यों मुरछिलागे शरजाके ॥
children.translated_text: "Tell me, lord of sages, whose sons are these two? I saw them unconscious, struck by their arrows."

children.text: सो० कहोनाथ समुझाय केहि नरेशके कुवँर दोउ ।
children.translated_text: Sorṭhā: "Tell me, Lord, and explain — whose are these two princes?"

children.text: सुन्रि मुनिवर मुसकाय जोरिपाणिलागे कहन ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing this, the great sage smiled; joining his palms, he began to speak.

children.text: जब आज्ञा लक्ष्मण प्रभुपाई । त्यागिसियहिबनअवधसिधाई ॥
children.translated_text: "When <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> received the Lord's command, he abandoned <s>Sītā</s> in the forest and returned to <s>Ayodhyā</s>."

children.text: टेढ़ बिपिन अवलोकिकुमारी । कीन्हकलाप बिलाप पुकारी ॥
children.translated_text: "Seeing the crooked (treacherous) forest, the princess wailed and lamented with great clamor."

children.text: तेहि औसर मैं शिषन समेत । फिरत रह्यों बन कृपानिकेता ॥
children.translated_text: "At that moment, I, along with my disciples, O abode of mercy, was wandering in the forest."

children.text: देक्यों जाय बैठि तरुछाहीं । ब्याकुलअधिकदेहसुधिनाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: "I went and saw [her] sitting in the shade of a tree — extremely distraught, with no awareness of her body."

children.text: धीरज दीन ताहि समुझाई । सकलचरिततिनमोहिंसुनाई ॥
children.translated_text: "I gave her courage and consolation; she narrated the entire story to me."

children.text: जाना मैं तब जनककिशोरी । लै आयों आश्रमहिं बहोरी ॥
children.translated_text: "Then I recognized her as the daughter of <s>Janaka</s>; I brought her back to the hermitage."

children.text: कछुदिन गये कुवँर दोउ जाई । भईमुदितसुधिअवधभुलाई ॥
children.translated_text: "Some days later, two princes were born; she became happy, forgetting the sorrows of <s>Ayodhyā</s>."

children.text: पूँछिलगन शुभ घड़ी सुहाई । चूड़ाकरण उछाह कराई ॥
children.translated_text: "I asked for an auspicious moment and a fine hour; the <s>cūḍākaraṇa</s> (tonsure ceremony) was performed with celebration."

children.text: यज्ञोपवीत भली बिधि कीना । बिबिधदान महिदेवन दीना ॥
children.translated_text: "The <s>yajñopavīta</s> (sacred thread ceremony) was duly performed; various gifts were given to the Brahmins."

children.text: द० बैठे पुनि बिद्या पढ़न मम निकेत दोउसाथ ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: "Then both sat together to study at my abode;"

children.text: अल्प दिवसमहँ लीनपढ़ि सब विद्यारघुनाथ ॥
children.translated_text: "in a short time, they mastered all learning, O <s>Raghunātha</s>."

children.text: बहुरि धनुष विद्या सब सीखी । मैं पुनि दीन प्रेम दृढ़ देखी ॥
children.translated_text: "Then they learned all the arts of archery; I then observed their firm devotion."

children.text: भये कुवँर बल बुद्धि निधाना । फिरहिंविपिनलीन्हे धनुबाना ॥
children.translated_text: "The princes became treasuries of strength and wisdom; they would roam the forest, having taken up bows and arrows."

children.text: तेहि औसर बलि मोहिं बुलायो । मख्यकरनहित न्योतपठायो ॥
children.translated_text: "At that time, <s>Bali</s> summoned me; he sent an invitation to assist with a sacrifice."

children.text: निज बाटिका सौंपि दोउभाई । गयों पताल सुनहु रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: "Entrusting my garden to both brothers, I went to the netherworld, listen O <s>Raghurāī</s> (<s>Rāma</s>)."

children.text: समय पाय विधिव बात बिगारा । होनी होय को रोकनहारा ॥
children.translated_text: "When the time came, Fate itself spoiled things — who can prevent what is destined?"

children.text: तजो सो कोह आजु रघुराई । मिलहुकुवँरदोउकण्ठलगाई ॥
children.translated_text: "Abandon that anger today, O <s>Raghurāī</s>; embrace both princes to your bosom."

children.text: सुनि मृदु पञ्ज वचन मुनि धीरा । मिल्योतनयदोउहँसिरघुबीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the gentle five-fold words of the steadfast sage, <s>Raghuvīra</s> smiled and embraced both sons.

children.text: अति आदर समीप बैठारे । बारबार दोउ सुवन निहारे ॥
children.translated_text: He seated them beside Him with great respect; again and again He gazed at both sons.

children.text: प्रभुके निकट तनय दोउ सोहैं । देखत नभबासी सब मोहैं ॥
children.translated_text: The two sons looked resplendent near the Lord; seeing them, all the celestial beings were enchanted.

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Chanda:

children.text: मोहे नभबासी शिवकैलासी विधि हरसुरपति देवसबे ।
children.translated_text: The celestial dwellers were enchanted — <s>Śiva</s> on <s>Kailāsa</s>, <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Hari</s>, <s>Indra</s> (lord of gods), and all the gods.

children.text: कहि मङ्गल मूला बरषहिं फूला शङ्ख निशान बजायचले ॥
children.translated_text: Uttering auspicious words, they showered flowers; conches and drums were sounded as they departed.

children.text: निरखत सुखपावैं लवैं नभमहिलों ध्वनि छायरही ।
children.translated_text: Gazing upon <s>Lava</s>, they felt joy; the women of heaven raised cries of delight.

children.text: कहिगवननिकेताशक्तिसमेता अतिआनँदनहिं जायकही ॥
children.translated_text: Going to their respective abodes with their consorts, their extreme bliss cannot be described.

children.text: दो० याविधि देवन राम कहँ सुवन समेत निहार ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: In this manner, the gods beheld <s>Rāma</s> together with His sons;

children.text: मांगि बिदा गवने भवन अश्वविमान प्रचार ॥
children.translated_text: taking leave, they departed to their abodes; the horse-sacrifice proceeded grandly.

children.text: तब मुनिसों बोले भगवाना । तुम मुनीश सर्वज्ञ सुजाना ॥
children.translated_text: Then the Lord spoke to the sage: "You are the lord of sages, omniscient and wise."

children.text: अबसो यतन करिय मुनिराई । जेहिप्रकार कौशलपुर जाई ॥
children.translated_text: "Now make such effort, O king of sages, that we may return to <s>Kośalapura</s> (<s>Ayodhyā</s>)."

children.text: मरछा अनुज सुभट समुदाई । जाते जाय सो करिय उपाई ॥
children.translated_text: "The younger brother, the warriors, and the entire army are unconscious — devise a remedy so that they may travel."

children.text: सुनिप्रभुबचनकह्यो मुनिनाथा । दीजै रथ आपन रघुनाथा ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the Lord's words, the lord of sages said: "Give your own chariot, O <s>Raghunātha</s>."

children.text: बलिके सभा चरित सब जाना । जानि सुकाज सुधामैं आना ॥
children.translated_text: "At <s>Bali</s>'s court, I learned of all the events; understanding the good purpose, I brought the nectar."

children.text: चढ़िरथ नभ ऊपर प्रभु जाई । बरषि सुधा भट देउँ जियाई ॥
children.translated_text: "Mounting the chariot and ascending to the sky, let me sprinkle the nectar and revive the warriors."

children.text: दीन तुरत रथ राम खरारी । तेहिचढ़िमुनिनभपन्थ सिधारी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Rāma</s>, the enemy-slayer, gave the chariot at once; mounting it, the sage set off on the sky-path.

children.text: सुधाबारि मुनि वरषन लागे । बुन्द परत योधा सब जागे ॥
children.translated_text: The sage began showering nectar-water; as the drops fell, all the warriors awoke.

children.text: जागे रिपुसूदन भै चेतू । भारत लक्ष्मण सैन समेतू ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Ripusūdana</s> (<s>Śatrughna</s>) awoke and regained consciousness — <s>Bharata</s>, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, along with their army.

children.text: दो० गै मुरछा जगे सुभट जिमि मदगत मतवार ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The swoon departed and the warriors awoke, like drunkards sobering from intoxication;

children.text: साजि बसन हथियार सब भये अश्व असवार ॥
children.translated_text: donning garments and weapons, all became horsemen.

children.text: भरत लषण रिपुसूदन बीरा । भूषण बसन सजे रणधीरा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Bharata</s>, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, and the valiant <s>Ripusūdana</s>, adorned with ornaments and garments, ready for battle,

children.text: कसितरकस धनुबाण उठाई । चढ़ि चढ़िरथ निजदेवमनाई ॥
children.translated_text: tightening their belts, taking up bows and arrows, mounting their chariots, they invoked their tutelary deities.

children.text: लियोताकि मुनिनायक बागू । चतुरङ्गिनी सुभटकर आगू ॥
children.translated_text: They targeted the leader of the sages' garden; the fourfold army with warriors at the front.

children.text: देख्यो जाय बाग मुनिराई । नहिंतहँ तुरंग न रिपुदोउ भाई ॥
children.translated_text: Going to see the sage-king's garden, there was neither the horse nor the two enemy brothers.

children.text: तौने समय दूत रघुराई । पहुंचे जाय जहां दोउभाई ॥
children.translated_text: At that time, the messengers of <s>Raghurāī</s> reached where the two brothers were.

children.text: शीशनाय बोले करजोरी । मधुर बचन गिरिराजकिशोरी ॥
children.translated_text: Bowing their heads, they spoke with joined palms, in sweet words, O daughter of the mountain king (<s>Pārvatī</s>).

children.text: चलियनाथ रघुनाथ बुलाई । बानी सुनत परमसुख पाई ॥
children.translated_text: "Come, Lord — <s>Raghunātha</s> (<s>Rāma</s>) has called"; hearing those words, [the brothers] were supremely delighted.

children.text: बालमीकि मुनि आश्रम तीरा । कछु दिनते आये रघुबीरा ॥
children.translated_text: "<s>Vālmīki</s>, the sage, near his hermitage — <s>Raghuvīra</s> has arrived some days ago."

children.text: दूतबचन सुनि तीनौ भाई । हांक्योरथकछुबिलम न लाई ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the messenger's words, all three brothers drove their chariots without a moment's delay.

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Chanda:

children.text: हांके विमान प्रचारि घोड़े पवनते आतुरचले ।
children.translated_text: They drove the chariots, spurring horses swifter than the wind, proceeding with eagerness.

children.text: ज़रवत्फकी तम्बू कनातैं तनी हैं झलकैं भले ॥
children.translated_text: Like merchants' tent-canopies, the curtains stretched taut, gleaming beautifully.

children.text: बहु शामियाने बादला मुक्कैशकी झालर सजी ।
children.translated_text: Many grand pavilions, clouds of pearl-fringed canopies decorated with tassels,

children.text: खींची तनावी रेशमी दिन रात तहँ नौबत बजी ॥
children.translated_text: silk guy-ropes drawn taut — day and night the kettledrums sounded there.

children.text: अगणित मतङ्ग गयन्दपर बहुतासकी झूलैंपरी ।
children.translated_text: Countless elephants in musth, with rich trappings hanging upon them,

children.text: बहुबाजि पवनसमान ऊपर जीन रतनन सों जरी ॥
children.translated_text: many horses swift as the wind, with saddles studded with jewels upon them.

children.text: असकहत फिरत नकीब खग बीरो तयारी कीजिये ।
children.translated_text: Thus the heralds went about calling: 'O bird-warriors, make ready!'

children.text: महराजके सब अनुज आवत जाय आगे लीजिये ॥
children.translated_text: 'All the younger brothers of the great king are coming — go ahead to receive them!'

children.text: डेवढ़ी कसामस चोबदारा मणिजड़ित आशालिये ।
children.translated_text: The threshold guards, the mace-bearers with jewel-studded staffs —

children.text: कोउ भूपमिलै न जानपावै बिना कछु रिशबत दिये ॥
children.translated_text: no king could meet or find access without offering some tribute.

children.text: बहुबरि भटसुर आज ये जहँ आप प्रभु कोशलधनी ।
children.translated_text: Many warriors and gods were present where the Lord of <s>Kośala</s> himself was.

children.text: मसनन्द तकियालागतहँ सुन्दर मुशज्जरकीतनी ॥
children.translated_text: Cushioned seats and bolsters — beautiful decorations were spread there.

children.text: बहु चौघड़े औ पानदान गुलाबपास धरे जहां ।
children.translated_text: Many timepieces, betel-boxes, rose-water sprinklers were placed there;

children.text: सुंदरगढ़न के अतरदान अनेक मुनि देखे तहां ॥
children.translated_text: perfume-holders of beautiful craftsmanship — the sage saw many such there.

children.text: दो० काहूते नहिं जातकहि जस कछु बनी समाज ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The assembly that had been arranged was beyond anyone's description;

children.text: देश देश के भूप सब बैठे तहँ खगराज ॥
children.translated_text: kings from every land were seated there, O king of birds.

children.text: बहु आशेबरदार मुनीशा । खड़ेजहाँ जहँ प्रभुजगदीशा ॥
children.translated_text: Many horsemen and flag-bearers, O lord of sages, stood wherever the Lord of the universe was.

children.text: बालमीकि दोउ कुवँर समेता । शोभित तहँ जहँ कृपानिकेता ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Vālmīki</s>, along with the two princes, was splendid there where the abode of mercy (<s>Rāma</s>) was.

children.text: तेहि औसर प्रभुके सब भाई । कीनप्रवेश उमा तहँ आई ॥
children.translated_text: At that moment, all the Lord's brothers arrived and entered, O <s>Umā</s>.

children.text: दूतन प्रभु पहँ जाय सुनाई । कह प्रभु आनहु वेगि बुलाई ॥
children.translated_text: The messengers went to the Lord and reported; the Lord said: "Bring them quickly, call them."

children.text: जब प्रभु अनुजन आवतदेखी । सहित सभा सब उठे विशेखी ॥
children.translated_text: When the Lord saw His younger brothers arriving, together with the entire assembly, all stood up.

children.text: प्रथमहिं भरत दण्डवतकीन्हा । करगहिलायहृदयप्रभुलीन्हा ॥
children.translated_text: First <s>Bharata</s> performed full prostration; the Lord took his hand and drew him to His heart.

children.text: पुनिलक्ष्मण प्रभुपदधरिशीशा । भुज पसारि भेंटे अवधेशा ॥
children.translated_text: Then <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> placed his head at the Lord's feet; extending His arms, the Lord of <s>Ayodhyā</s> embraced him.

children.text: पाछे रिपुसूदन शिर नावा । प्रेमसमेत राम उर लावा ॥
children.translated_text: After that, <s>Ripusūdana</s> (<s>Śatrughna</s>) bowed his head; with love, <s>Rāma</s> drew him to His bosom.

children.text: पूंछत कुशल निकट बैठारी । गई सकल श्रम भये सुखारी ॥
children.translated_text: Inquiring about their welfare, He seated them nearby; all their fatigue vanished and they became happy.

children.text: दो० प्रभु आज्ञाते अनुज सब बैठि दण्डवत कीन ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: By the Lord's command, all the younger brothers sat down after performing prostration;

children.text: बहुरिमिलेप्रभुतनय दोउ हरषित आशिषदीन ॥
children.translated_text: then they met the Lord's two sons — joyfully, they bestowed blessings.

children.text: तब प्रभु मुनि आगे भये ठाढ़े । पुलकिशरीरनयन जलबाढ़े ॥
children.translated_text: Then the Lord stood before the sage; His body was thrilled with goosebumps, His eyes filled with tears.

children.text: मोपर नाथ कीन तुम दाया । जनमउऋकणनहिंमैंमुनिराया ॥
children.translated_text: "You, Lord, have shown me grace; I can never repay this debt even in a lifetime, O king of sages."

children.text: रौरे नाथ अनुग्रह कीजै । अवधचलियसियसोंशिषदीजै ॥
children.translated_text: "Please bestow your grace, Lord; come to <s>Ayodhyā</s> and grant [us] your disciple."

children.text: पूरण यज्ञ नहीं बिन तीया । इतना नाथ हमैं करनीया ॥
children.translated_text: "The <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice) cannot be completed without a wife; this much, Lord, I must do."

children.text: असकहि प्रभु सुखपाल मँगाई । बालमीकि मुनिसंग पठाई ॥
children.translated_text: Thus speaking, the Lord sent for a palanquin and dispatched it with sage <s>Vālmīki</s>.

children.text: लै सुखपाल मुनीश सिधाई । तेहि पाछे रिपुदवन बुलाई ॥
children.translated_text: Taking the palanquin, the lord of sages departed; after him, <s>Ripusūdana</s> was called.

children.text: जाहु बेगि मुनिवर पहँ भाई । आनहुजनकसुरता समुझाई ॥
children.translated_text: "Go quickly to the sage, brother; bring <s>Janaka</s>'s daughter, consoling her."

children.text: आयसु पाय भरत लघु भ्राता । चले सियापहँ हरषितगाता ॥
children.translated_text: Receiving the command, <s>Bharata</s>'s younger brother set out for <s>Sītā</s> with a joyful body.

children.text: जाय शत्रुहन पद शिरनाई । आशिषदीन्ह लीन्हउरलाई ॥
children.translated_text: Going, <s>Śatrughna</s> bowed his head at her feet; she blessed him and drew him to her bosom.

children.text: दो० कुशल पूँछि बैठाय ढिग अति आदर सियमात ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Inquiring about his welfare and seating him beside her, <s>Sītā</s>, the mother, with great respect,

children.text: पूँछन लागीं कुशल प्रभु लषण भरत दोउ भ्रात ॥
children.translated_text: began asking about the welfare of the Lord, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, <s>Bharata</s>, and both brothers.

children.text: मातु आज सब कुशल हमारी । चरणसरोज विलोकितुम्हारी ॥
children.translated_text: "Mother, all is well with us today, having beheld your lotus feet."

children.text: तब मुनिवर मृदु बचन सुनाई । सुनों सिया असकहेरघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: Then the sage conveyed gentle words: "Listen, <s>Sītā</s> — thus has <s>Raghurāī</s> said."

children.text: जेहि विधि अवधचलै चहेजाई । सोइ उपदेश देब मुनिराई ॥
children.translated_text: "Whatever manner in which He wishes [you] to go to <s>Ayodhyā</s> — that very instruction the sage-king will give."

children.text: सुनि प्रभुवचन सुता सुखपायों । तोहित बचन हारि मैं आयों ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the Lord's words, the daughter was pleased: "I have come, defeated by your words, for your sake."

children.text: कर प्रतिपाल वचन अब मोरा । होयसुयशतिहुँपुर अतितोरा ॥
children.translated_text: "Now heed my words — your great fame shall spread through all three worlds."

children.text: रिपुसूदनहुँ लिवावन आये । चरणपरे अबलों शिरनाये ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Ripusūdana</s> (<s>Śatrughna</s>) also came to escort her; he fell at her feet and the women bowed their heads.

children.text: जिंमि २ मुनिवरकहिगिरिजाई । तिमितिमिअवनिसुतासकुचाई ॥
children.translated_text: However much the sage spoke, O <s>Girijā</s> (<s>Pārvatī</s>), that much the daughter of the earth (<s>Sītā</s>) hesitated.

children.text: शोचत हृदय विदेह कुमारी । पतिगुरु आयसुसकैको टारी ॥
children.translated_text: The daughter of <s>Videha</s> (<s>Sītā</s>) grieved in her heart: "Who can defy the command of husband and Guru?"

children.text: जाउँ अवध तो सब बिधिहानी । जो न जाउँ कोपैं मुनि ज्ञानी ॥
children.translated_text: "If I go to <s>Ayodhyā</s>, it is loss in every way; if I don't go, the wise sage will be displeased."

children.text: दो० दुहूँ भांति संकट सिया बनै रहत नाहिं जात ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: <s>Sītā</s> was caught in a dilemma — staying was not feasible, going was not feasible;

children.text: बन्दि चरण मुनिनाथके बोलीं अति मृदुगात ॥
children.translated_text: bowing at the feet of the lord of sages, she spoke in an extremely gentle manner.

children.text: तुमतो नाथ नीकि शिष दीन्ही । सबहिप्रकारमोरहितचीन्ही ॥
children.translated_text: "You, Lord, have given me good instruction; you have looked after my welfare in every way."

children.text: मैं तजिलाज कहों मुनि आजू । अबनहिंअवधमोरकछुकाजू ॥
children.translated_text: Abandoning shame, I speak to you today, O sage. Now I have no purpose left in <s>Ayodhyā</s>.

children.text: बिन अपराध तजा मोहिं स्वामी । तुमहिंविदितसबअन्तरयामी ॥
children.translated_text: Without any fault, my lord abandoned me. You know all, O <s>Antarayāmī</s> (inner knower).

children.text: तापर मोहिं कहत प्रभुजाना । यह सब मोर अभागानआना ॥
children.translated_text: Moreover, my lord says he knows the truth. All this is brought about by my misfortune.

children.text: आयसु नाथ शीश परलीन्हा । जोकुकहियसोचाहियकीस्हा ॥
children.translated_text: The command of my lord I have placed upon my head. Whatever you say, that is what should be done.

children.text: मुनिवर सुनि सीताप्रिय बानी । रहेसकुचि तेहिसमयभवानी ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing <s>Sītā's</s> beloved words, the great sage remained hesitant at that moment, O <s>Bhavānī</s>.

children.text: तजि सँकोच पुनि कह्योमुनेशू । सुनपुत्री तुव पितुमिथिलेशू ॥
children.translated_text: Then, setting aside his reluctance, the lord of sages spoke: "Listen, daughter, your father is the king of <s>Mithilā</s>.

children.text: अस इर्षा सपनेहु नहिंआनी । पतिव्रत धर्म्म पुराणबखानी ॥
children.translated_text: Such jealousy should not be harbored even in a dream. The <s>Purāṇas</s> have extolled the dharma of <s>pativrata</s> (devotion to one's husband).

children.text: यद्यपि पति सब औगुणखानी । तेहिको उचित देवकरिजानी ॥
children.translated_text: Even if a husband is a mine of all faults, one should regard him as a deity and serve him accordingly.

children.text: सो० अस विचारि उर आनि करहु आज जो मैं कहहुँ ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Reflecting thus in your heart, do today what I tell you.

children.text: कीजै शिष सुखमानि सब प्रकार तुम कहँ सुखद ॥
children.translated_text: Follow this counsel with a joyful mind; it will bring you happiness in every way."

children.text: धर्म्म नीति इतिहास सुनाई । सियागमन सुखपालमँगाई ॥
children.translated_text: Having narrated <s>dharma</s>, policy, and history, he summoned <s>Sukhapāla</s> for <s>Sītā's</s> departure.

children.text: तुरित कहारन लीन उठाई । चले जहां राजित रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: The palanquin-bearers swiftly lifted her up and proceeded to where <s>Rāma</s>, the lord of the <s>Raghus</s>, was stationed.

children.text: मुनि रिपुसूदन पाछे जाहीं । परिहरिशोचहरष मनमाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: The sage <s>Ripusūdana</s> followed behind, casting off sorrow and feeling joy in his heart.

children.text: जहँ राजित प्रभु अवध नरेशू । गे रिपुसूदन सहित मुनेशू ॥
children.translated_text: Where the lord, the king of <s>Ayodhyā</s>, was seated, there went <s>Ripusūdana</s> along with the chief of sages.

children.text: भरतअनुज प्रभुपद शिरनाई । मुनिवरआशिषबचनसुनाई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Bharata</s> and his younger brother bowed their heads at the lord's feet. The great sage bestowed words of blessing.

children.text: मुनिहिं दण्डवत करि रघुराई । रिपुसूदनहिं लीन उरलाई ॥
