children.translated_text: <s>Rāma</s>, the lord of the <s>Raghus</s>, prostrated before the sage, and embraced <s>Ripusūdana</s> to his chest.

children.text: सिय आगमन कह्यो मुनिराजू । सुनि हरषे तिहुँपुर शिरताजू ॥
children.translated_text: The king of sages announced <s>Sītā's</s> arrival. Hearing this, the crown of the three worlds rejoiced.

children.text: करिअस्तुति मुनिकहिसियरौनू । आयसु होय करों पुर गौनू ॥
children.translated_text: Praising the sage, he said: "Tell me of <s>Sītā's</s> dwelling. Grant permission and I shall proceed to the city."

children.text: भली नाथकहि मुनिमत धीरा । तुरित पयान कीन रघुबीरा ॥
children.translated_text: "Very well, my lord," said the sage of steady wisdom. <s>Rāma</s>, the hero of the <s>Raghus</s>, immediately set forth.

children.text: दो० बहुरि निशान बजाय बहु चलन साज सब साज ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Sounding many drums, preparing all arrangements for departure,

children.text: बाहन चढ़ि भट भीरमुनि चले जहां रघुराज ॥
children.translated_text: warriors, multitudes, and sages mounted their vehicles and proceeded to where <s>Rāma</s> was.

children.text: गजराजनपर कसी अमारी । बाजिनपर रचिजीन सवाँरी ॥
children.translated_text: Howdahs were fastened upon the lordly elephants; saddles were arranged and adorned upon the horses.

children.text: कोतल तुरंग अमितको । लाजैं हय रथ सूरज देखे ॥
children.translated_text: Countless saddled steeds — horses and chariots that would put the sun to shame.

children.text: वृषभ ऊँट बाहन संग जेते । वस्तु अनेक भरे सब तेते ॥
children.translated_text: Bulls, camels, and as many vehicles as accompanied them — all were loaded with various goods.

children.text: नित्यक्रिया करि पूजि पुरारी । प्रभुनिज भूषणबसन सवाँरी ॥
children.translated_text: Having performed his daily rites and worshipped Lord <s>Śiva</s>, the lord adorned himself with his own ornaments and garments.

children.text: पुनि पट भूषण विविध मँगाई । अनुजन सुवनबोलिपहिराई ॥
children.translated_text: Then, having various garments and ornaments brought, he summoned his brothers and sons and dressed them.

children.text: बांधि तुणीर सुनहुँ मुनिराया । लीन हाथ धनुशर रघुराया ॥
children.translated_text: Listen, O king of sages: binding his quiver, <s>Rāma</s>, lord of the <s>Raghus</s>, took bow and arrow in hand.

children.text: अस्तुति बालमीकि मुनिकीन्हे । निजरथमुनिनायककहँदीन्हे ॥
children.translated_text: The sage <s>Vālmīki</s> offered praise, and gave his own chariot to the lord of sages.

children.text: तीनों अनुज कुवँर दोउ साथा । चढ़े बाजि पर मुनिरघुनाथा ॥
children.translated_text: The three younger brothers and both princes accompanied him. The sage and <s>Rāma</s> mounted horses.

children.text: गणपति गौरि मनाय खरारी । करि आगे सब सैन हँकारी ॥
children.translated_text: Propitiating <s>Gaṇapati</s> and <s>Gaurī</s>, the slayer of <s>Khara</s> marshaled his entire army forward.

children.text: दो० तेहि औसर करुणायतन देखि सजग कटकाय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: At that moment, the abode of compassion, seeing the army arrayed,

children.text: चले अवधपुर बिहँगपति शम्भु चरण शिरनाय ॥
children.translated_text: set forth for <s>Ayodhyā</s> upon <s>Garuḍa</s>, bowing his head at the feet of <s>Śambhu</s>.

children.text: आगे कीन तुरँग मख आछे । सियसुखपाल जायतेहिपाछे ॥
children.translated_text: In front went the fine sacrificial horse; <s>Sītā</s> with <s>Sukhapāla</s> followed behind it.

children.text: तेहि पाछे मुनिवर रथ जाई । चले साथ सेवक रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: Behind them, the great sage traveled in a chariot, with <s>Rāma's</s> servants accompanying him.

children.text: तेहि पाछे कुश लौ दोउ भाई । छविनिधानकछुवरणिनजाई ॥
children.translated_text: Behind them went the two brothers <s>Kuśa</s> and <s>Lava</s>, treasures of beauty beyond description.

children.text: हय सवार पर चढ़बहु साथे । धनुषबाणशोभित दोउहाथे ॥
children.translated_text: Mounted on horses with many companions, bows and arrows gracing both their hands.

children.text: तेहि पाछे गज तीनों अनुजा । भरतलषणरिपुसूदनगिरिजा ॥
children.translated_text: Behind them, on elephants, rode the three younger brothers — <s>Bharata</s>, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, and <s>Ripusūdana</s>, O <s>Girijā</s>.

children.text: तुरंग सवार बाग मुरकाये । जाहिं चले करिवरहिंमिलाये ॥
children.translated_text: Horsemen reined in their steeds and rode alongside the great elephants.

children.text: सुभट अमित आगे कछु पाछे । सजि हथियार काछनीकाछे ॥
children.translated_text: Countless warriors before and behind, armed and with garments girded for battle.

children.text: तेहि पाछे गिरिवर रघुबीरा । बैठि खवासी सुवन समीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Behind them, <s>Rāma</s>, the hero of the <s>Raghus</s>, rode upon a great elephant, with <s>Hanumān</s>, the son of the wind, seated in attendance.

children.text: शोभित हाथ छत्रवत भाना । चांवरविबिध न जायबखाना ॥
children.translated_text: A parasol shone in his hand like the sun; the various fly-whisks cannot be described.

children.text: दो० यहिविधि राजा राम मुनि भ्राता सुवनसमेत ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: In this manner, King <s>Rāma</s>, the sage, his brothers, and sons together,

children.text: भये पार तमसा उतर शोभा सीव निकेत ॥
children.translated_text: crossed to the northern bank of the <s>Tamasā</s> river — an abode of beauty without limit.

children.text: बोलि दूत दुइ अवध पठाई । आयसु पाय चले शिरनाई ॥
children.translated_text: Summoning two messengers, he dispatched them to <s>Ayodhyā</s>. Receiving his command, they departed with bowed heads.

children.text: प्रथमहिं गुरु वशिष्ठ पहँआई । गहिपदमुनिप्रभुकुशलसुनाई ॥
children.translated_text: First they came to Guru <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>, grasped his feet, and conveyed the lord's well-being.

children.text: आवत कुशल अवधपति नाथा । सीताअनुजसुवनदोउसाथा ॥
children.translated_text: "The lord of <s>Ayodhyā</s> approaches safely, O master, together with <s>Sītā</s>, his brothers, and both sons."

children.text: सुनि मुनिउर दूतन प्रियबानी । हरषे ऋषिन समेत भवानी ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the messengers' sweet words, the sage rejoiced in his heart, along with the other sages, O <s>Bhavānī</s>.

children.text: बहुरि दूत गये राज दुवारे । जाय तहांनृप सचिवनिहारे ॥
children.translated_text: Then the messengers went to the royal gate, where they beheld the king's ministers.

children.text: शीश नाय मृदु बैन सुनाई । नाथ कुशल आये रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: Bowing their heads, they spoke gentle words: "My lord, <s>Rāma</s>, lord of the <s>Raghus</s>, has arrived safely."

children.text: सुनत सुमन्त उठ्यो हरषाई । मृतक शरीर प्राण जनु आई ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing this, <s>Sumantra</s> rose up with joy, as if life had returned to a dead body.

children.text: गयो तुरित जहँ प्रभु महतारी । समाचार सब कह्यो सुखारी ॥
children.translated_text: He went swiftly to where the lord's mothers were and related all the happy news.

children.text: सियासहितदोउशिशुसबभ्राता । लैमखबाजि फिरे सुरत्राता ॥
children.translated_text: "With <s>Sītā</s>, both children, and all brothers, the protector of the gods has returned, bringing the sacrificial horse."

children.text: दो० बचन सुनत उच्छाह मय सुन हरषीं सबमात ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Hearing these joyous words, all the mothers rejoiced.

children.text: बोल विप्र याचक नगर दान दीन बहु भांत ॥
children.translated_text: Brāhmaṇas and supplicants throughout the city were given gifts of many kinds.

children.text: समाचार पुरबासिन पावा । घरघर मंगल बाज बधावा ॥
children.translated_text: The citizens received the news; in every home auspicious music and celebrations resounded.

children.text: सुधर प्रचारिक बेगि बोलाई । बहु रचना गृहद्वार बनाई ॥
children.translated_text: Skilled decorators were quickly summoned, and elaborate ornaments were fashioned at every doorway.

children.text: राजद्वार की शोभा जैसी । कहँमति मोर कहूं अवतैसी ॥
children.translated_text: The splendor of the royal gate — how can my poor wit describe it?

children.text: गज मुक्ता की चौक पुराई । कञ्चन कलश अनूपसोहाई ॥
children.translated_text: The courtyards were filled with elephant-pearls; golden vessels shone incomparably.

children.text: दधि अक्षत रोचन मिष्टाना । पान फूल पूगीफल नाना ॥
children.translated_text: Yogurt, unbroken rice, saffron, sweets, betel leaves, flowers, and various areca nuts were prepared.

children.text: कौशल्यादि राम महतारी । मुदित आरती थारसवाँरी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Kausalyā</s> and the other mothers of <s>Rāma</s> joyfully prepared the <s>āratī</s> tray.

children.text: मणिगण हेम निछावरि हेतू । लिये सखी सब प्रेम समेतू ॥
children.translated_text: Jewels and gold were gathered for the welcoming offering; all the attendant women took them up with love.

children.text: जब प्रभुआय नगर नियराने । आगे जाय सचिव सनमाने ॥
children.translated_text: When the lord drew near the city, the ministers went ahead to honor him.

children.text: चरण बन्दि सादर सुरत्राता । बैठ्योअनुजसहितदोउभ्राता ॥
children.translated_text: The protector of the gods reverently touched their feet; he was seated with his brothers.

children.text: दो० कीन सचिव पुनिदण्डवत बालमीकि मुनिदेख ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The ministers then prostrated before sage <s>Vālmīki</s>,

children.text: सियपदबन्दि सुखेनअति धन्यभाग्य निजलेख ॥
children.translated_text: and bowing at <s>Sītā's</s> feet, they felt supremely blessed, rejoicing in their great fortune.

children.text: तब प्रभुहरषि अवधपुर आई । आगे बाण निशान सुहाई ॥
children.translated_text: Then the lord joyfully entered the city of <s>Ayodhyā</s>; ahead, auspicious banners and ensigns fluttered.

children.text: हय गजके डंका मुनि बाजे । सुनि रौ मधुर मेघघनलाजे ॥
children.translated_text: Drums of horses and elephants thundered, O sage; their deep sweet rumble put the thunderclouds to shame.

children.text: गलिन भीर हयमत्त गयन्दा । मग पावें नहिं पदचरवृन्दा ॥
children.translated_text: In the streets thronged intoxicated horses and elephants; the crowds on foot could find no space on the roads.

children.text: नरनारी चढ़धाय अटारी । निरखैं छबि प्रभु होइँ सुखारी ॥
children.translated_text: Men and women rushed up to the terraces to behold the lord's beauty and become filled with joy.

children.text: लखि सुखपाल विदेहकुमारी । युवतिन हृदयभयो सुखभारी ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing <s>Sukhapāla</s> and the princess of <s>Videha</s>, the young women's hearts overflowed with happiness.

children.text: देखि तनय सुन्दर सियदोऊ । जेहिशोभा उपमा नहिं कोऊ ॥
children.translated_text: Beholding <s>Sītā's</s> two beautiful sons, whose splendor has no comparison,

children.text: भरत लषण रिपुसूदन देखी । पुरबासी सुख लह्योविशेखी ॥
children.translated_text: and seeing <s>Bharata</s>, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, and <s>Ripusūdana</s>, the citizens experienced extraordinary delight.

children.text: उत सब परम देखि अनुरागे । मणिगण हेम लुटावनलागे ॥
children.translated_text: All were deeply enraptured at the sight and began showering jewels and gold.

children.text: दिव्य सुखद सब पुरनर नारी । भूप दुवार आय दनुजारी ॥
children.translated_text: All the men and women of the city felt divine happiness. The slayer of demons arrived at the royal gate.

children.text: दो० पुरबासिन कहँ देत सुख रविकुल कमल पतङ्ह ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Bestowing happiness upon the citizens, the sun of the <s>Raghu</s> solar dynasty,

children.text: सैनसहित आये उमा शोभा कोटि अनङ्ग ॥
children.translated_text: arrived with his army, O <s>Umā</s>, his splendor rivaling ten million <s>Kāmadevas</s>.

children.text: सिय सुखपाल सुनो उरगारी । जाय कहारन द्वार उतारी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Sītā</s> and <s>Sukhapāla</s>, listen O <s>Garuḍa</s>, were set down from the palanquin at the gate.

children.text: सखिनसङ्ग मन्दिर सियआंई । पति देवर मातहि शिरनांई ॥
children.translated_text: With her companions, <s>Sītā</s> entered the palace and bowed her head to her husband, brothers-in-law, and mothers-in-law.

children.text: सासुसबी सियको उरलाई । वदन अनूप निरखि सुखपाई ॥
children.translated_text: All the mothers-in-law embraced <s>Sītā</s> to their hearts and found joy beholding her incomparable face.

children.text: तबमुनि प्रभुसब अनुजसमेता । तजिबाहनकिय गौन निकेता ॥
children.translated_text: Then the sage, the lord, and all the younger brothers dismounted from their vehicles and proceeded to the residence.

children.text: कौशल्यादि मातु हरषाई । करहिं आरती मंगल गाई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Kausalyā</s> and the other mothers rejoiced, performing <s>āratī</s> and singing auspicious songs.

children.text: वारहिं मणिगण विविधप्रकारा । जोजेहिभाव सो दीन्हअपारा ॥
children.translated_text: They waved various kinds of jewels in blessing; each gave lavishly according to their disposition.

children.text: तेहि औसर पुरग्राम उछाहू । बरणिनजायसुनहु खगनाहू ॥
children.translated_text: At that moment, the jubilation in city and village cannot be described — listen, O king of birds.

children.text: दोड सिय सुवनराम महतारी । हृदय लगाय गोद बैठारी ॥
children.translated_text: Dohā: <s>Sītā</s>, the sons, and <s>Rāma's</s> mothers embraced them and seated them in their laps.

children.text: विविधदान महिदेवन दीन्हे । याचकसकलअयाचककीन्हे ॥
children.translated_text: Various gifts were given to the Brāhmaṇas; all supplicants were made free from want.

children.text: सो० ताहि समय रघुनाथ चरणसरोरुह मातुसब ।
children.translated_text: Soraṭhā: At that time, <s>Rāma</s>, lord of the <s>Raghus</s>, bowed his head at the lotus feet of all the mothers.

children.text: सादर नायोमाथ मातहिं आशिष दीन तब ॥
children.translated_text: He reverently bowed his forehead; then the mothers bestowed their blessings.

children.text: गुरुकर पदुम गहे रघुराई । बारबार मुनिवर उर लाई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Rāma</s>, lord of the <s>Raghus</s>, grasped the guru's lotus feet; the great sage embraced him again and again.

children.text: जहँलग ऋषयमुनीश समाजू । दण्डप्रणाम कीन रघुराजू ॥
children.translated_text: To every sage and ascetic in the assembly, <s>Rāma</s> offered full prostration.

children.text: भरत लषण रिपुसूदन जाई । कुशलौ सहित चरण शिरनाई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Bharata</s>, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, and <s>Ripusūdana</s> went and bowed their heads at the feet, inquiring after well-being.

children.text: आशिरबाद यथारुचि जेही । दीनहरषि मुनि नायक तेही ॥
children.translated_text: The lord of sages joyfully bestowed blessings upon each according to their wish.

children.text: पूंछेहुमुनि प्रभु कुशल बहोरी । कह प्रभुनाथ अनुग्रह तोरी ॥
children.translated_text: The sages then asked the lord about his welfare. The lord replied: "By your grace, my master."

children.text: देखि प्रीति बहुशील सनेहू । ऋषिनसहित मुनिभयोबिदेहू ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing such great affection, courtesy, and love, the sage along with the sages became overcome with emotion.

children.text: अति सुकुमारगात दोउबारे । पितुभ्रातहिकेहिबिधिरणमारे ॥
children.translated_text: "These two tender-limbed young boys — how did they defeat their father and brothers in battle?"

children.text: बहुरि बिचारि रामप्रभुताई । सुतन बिलोकि रहे मुनिराई ॥
children.translated_text: Then, contemplating the majesty of <s>Rāma</s>, the sages gazed upon the sons in wonder.

children.text: बारबार प्रभु सुयश बखानी । सकुचि राम बोले मृदुबानी ॥
children.translated_text: Again and again the lord's glory was praised; <s>Rāma</s>, with modesty, spoke gentle words.

children.text: दो० यज्ञकाज हितनाथ अब जस मोहिं आयसु होय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: "For the work of the sacrifice, O master, whatever command you give me now,

children.text: उठि प्रभात करुणायतन करों शीशधरि सोय ॥
children.translated_text: rising at dawn, this abode of compassion will carry it out upon his head."

children.text: सुनिप्रभुवचनहरषिमुनिनायक । लागे कहन सुनो रघुनायक ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the lord's words, the chief of sages rejoiced and began to speak: "Listen, O lord of the <s>Raghus</s>.

children.text: भूप अमित कुलहते तम्हारे । तुमसम और न नयन निहारे ॥
children.translated_text: Countless kings have been in your lineage, but none like you have my eyes ever seen.

children.text: हम प्रोहित रविकुल भगवाना । मिलेनकोउतुमसमयजमाना ॥
children.translated_text: We have been the priests of the solar dynasty, O lord, but we have never met a patron of sacrifice like you.

children.text: यह न बड़ाई तहां तुम्हारी । दीनदयालु भक्त हितकारी ॥
children.translated_text: This is no flattery on my part — you are compassionate to the lowly and beneficent to your devotees."

children.text: मुनि वशिष्ठ रघुबीर बड़ाई । करत वदन परसबहिंसुनाई ॥
children.translated_text: Sage <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> thus praised <s>Rāma's</s> greatness to his face for all to hear.

children.text: प्रभुकहसकुचकृपामुनि कीन्ही । सकल बड़ाई आपुहि दीन्ही ॥
children.translated_text: The lord humbly said: "The sage has shown his grace; he has bestowed all glory upon me himself.

children.text: मैं सेवक सब भांति तुम्हारा । परमधर्म यह नाथ हमारा ॥
children.translated_text: I am your servant in every way. This, my lord, is our highest <s>dharma</s>."

children.text: मुनि रघुबीर गूढ़ ब्योहारा । को समरथ जगकेरै बिचारा ॥
children.translated_text: The conduct between the sage and <s>Rāma</s> was profound — who in the world has the capacity to fathom it?

children.text: सुनहुं राम अस कह मुनिराजा । भोरहि कीजै मखका काजा ॥
children.translated_text: "Listen, <s>Rāma</s>," said the king of sages, "at dawn the work of the sacrifice should begin."

children.text: दो० भलेनाथ कहि नायशिर प्रभुमुनि आयसुपाया ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: "Very well, my lord," said <s>Rāma</s>, bowing his head, having received the sage's command.

children.text: राज द्वार गमने तुरत निशा दण्डयुग आय ॥
children.translated_text: He immediately proceeded to the royal gate; two watches of the night had passed.

children.text: गई निशा युग दण्ड मुनीशा । राज द्वार आये अवधेशा ॥
children.translated_text: Two watches of the night had passed, O lord of sages, when the lord of <s>Ayodhyā</s> arrived at the royal gate.

children.text: सचिव आय सादर शिरनाई । प्रेम पुलक बोले रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: The minister came and bowed his head respectfully. <s>Rāma</s>, lord of the <s>Raghus</s>, spoke with loving emotion.

children.text: गुरु पितु मातु अनुग्रह ताता । आयोंकुशलसहितसमभ्राता ॥
children.translated_text: "By the grace of the guru, father, and mothers, dear one, I have returned safely with all my brothers."

children.text: सुनि प्रभु बचन सचिव हरषाई । कहि जैजीव चरण शिरनाई ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the lord's words, the minister rejoiced, cried "Long live!" and bowed his head at <s>Rāma's</s> feet.

children.text: कहहु बचन अति नीति सुहाई । तुम समान तुमहीं रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: "Your words are most proper and pleasing. There is none equal to you, O lord of the <s>Raghus</s>.

children.text: सेवक विनय नाथ सुनि लीजै । महल जाय मोजनकछुकीजै ॥
children.translated_text: Pray hear this humble servant's request, my lord: please go to the palace and take some refreshment."

children.text: सुनि यह वचन भवन प्रभुआये । दासी दास तुरत जल लाये ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing these words, the lord came to his abode; maidservants and attendants quickly brought water.

children.text: भ्राता सुतन बोलि रघुनाथा । उठेकरन भोजन यकसाथा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Rāma</s> summoned his brothers and sons; they all rose together to take their meal.

children.text: षटरस व्यञ्जन भरिभरिथारी । सादर परसि दीन महतारी ॥
children.translated_text: Trays heaped with dishes of six flavors were served reverently by the mothers themselves.

children.text: दो० लागे जेवन रामतब अनुजन सुवन समेत ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Then <s>Rāma</s> began to dine, together with his brothers and sons.

children.text: जोइभोजन प्रभु चाहते सोइ कौशल्या देत ॥
children.translated_text: Whatever food the lord desired, that <s>Kausalyā</s> served him.

children.text: करिभोजन गिरिजा रघुराई । कीन्ह्योशयनमहलनिजजाई ॥
children.translated_text: Having dined, O <s>Girijā</s>, <s>Rāma</s>, lord of the <s>Raghus</s>, went to his own chamber to rest.

children.text: अनुजहिसुवनहि बोलिसप्रीती । सोवहु तात निशा बहुबीती ॥
children.translated_text: Calling his brothers and sons with affection, he said: "Sleep now, dear ones — much of the night has passed."

children.text: आयसु पाय चरण शिरनाई । निजनिजभवनगये सब भाई ॥
children.translated_text: Receiving his command and bowing at his feet, all the brothers went to their respective homes.

children.text: राममातु पहँ गये दोड भाई । सुन्दर पलँग बिछायसोवाई ॥
children.translated_text: The two brothers went to <s>Rāma's</s> mother, who laid out beautiful beds and put them to sleep.

children.text: सिया सासु अनुशासन पाई । गई जहां राजित रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Sītā</s>, receiving her mother-in-law's leave, went to where <s>Rāma</s>, lord of the <s>Raghus</s>, was resting.

children.text: करि बहुभांति चरण सेवकाई । सोई सिय प्रभु आयसु पाई ॥
children.translated_text: Having served his feet in many ways, <s>Sītā</s> slept, having received the lord's permission.

children.text: सोवत सिय सुखसेज बिलोकी । देखिकलाबिधुनिजरथरोकी ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing <s>Sītā</s> sleeping upon the beautiful bed, the crescent moon stopped his chariot to gaze.

children.text: आपते अधिकदेखि सियशोभा । बहुमयङ्कहिरदयअतिक्षोभा ॥
children.translated_text: Finding her beauty greater than his own, the moon felt great agitation in his heart.

children.text: शोभा कोटिकाम रति थोरी । नहिं उपमाछबिजनककिशोरी ॥
children.translated_text: The beauty of ten million <s>Kāmadevas</s> and <s>Rati</s> was trifling; there was no comparison to the beauty of <s>Janaka's</s> daughter.

children.text: दो० रति समेत लाज्यो मदन रजनीपति सकुचाय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: <s>Kāmadeva</s> together with <s>Rati</s> was put to shame, and the lord of the night (the moon) grew bashful.

children.text: सियमुखशोभासुरसलखि जहँ तहँ रहे लजाय ॥
children.translated_text: Beholding the beauty of <s>Sītā's</s> face, the gods remained abashed everywhere.

children.text: प्रात समय रघुनायक जागे । बन्दीजन गुण गावनलागे ॥
children.translated_text: At dawn, the lord of the <s>Raghus</s> awoke; the bards began singing his praises.

children.text: भोरहिं सियउठ प्रीतम पासू । गई महल जहँ सोवतसासू ॥
children.translated_text: Early in the morning, <s>Sītā</s> rose from beside her beloved and went to the chamber where her mother-in-law slept.

children.text: कौशल्या पद चापन लागी । परसत हाथ सासुतबजागी ॥
children.translated_text: She began pressing <s>Kausalyā's</s> feet; at the touch of her hands, the mother-in-law awoke.

children.text: पद शिरनाय विदेहकुमारी । आशिषदीन्ह राम महतारी ॥
children.translated_text: The princess of <s>Videha</s> bowed her head at her feet; <s>Rāma's</s> mother bestowed her blessing.

children.text: निशा बिगत जागे दोउभाई । पितुमातहि सादर शिरनाई ॥
children.translated_text: The night having passed, both brothers awoke and respectfully bowed to their father and mother.

children.text: निज मातहि प्रणामपुनिकीन्हा । देखिसुवनसियशाशिषदीन्हा ॥
children.translated_text: They then prostrated before their own mother. Seeing the sons, <s>Sītā</s> gave her blessing.

children.text: तब रघुनाथ मात पहँ जाई । चरण बन्दि बैठे मुनिराई ॥
children.translated_text: Then <s>Rāma</s>, lord of the <s>Raghus</s>, went to his mother, bowed at her feet, and the sage sat down nearby.

children.text: माता दीन अशीश सुखारी । सुन हरषे रघुबंश खरारी ॥
children.translated_text: The mother bestowed joyful blessings; hearing them, the destroyer of <s>Khara</s> of the <s>Raghu</s> lineage was pleased.

children.text: तात चरण बन्द्यो दोउ भ्राता । प्रभुसकुचेबिलोकिढिगमाता ॥
children.translated_text: Dear son, the two brothers bowed at his feet; the lord felt bashful, seeing his mother beside him.

children.text: दो० तेहि औसर भारत लषण रिपुसूदन मुनि आय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: At that moment <s>Bharata</s>, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, <s>Ripusūdana</s>, and the sages arrived.

children.text: बन्दि रामपद मात पद सिय पद शीश नवाय ॥
children.translated_text: They bowed at <s>Rāma's</s> feet, at the mothers' feet, and at <s>Sītā's</s> feet, touching their heads to the ground.

children.text: तब अनुजन बिलोकिदोउभाई । दण्डप्रणाम कीन शिरनाई ॥
children.translated_text: Then, beholding the two brothers, the younger brothers made prostrations with heads bowed.

children.text: अनुजन सुवन समेत सुनीशा । मज्जन करन चले अवधेशा ॥
children.translated_text: With his brothers and sons, listen O lord of sages, the king of <s>Ayodhyā</s> went to bathe.

children.text: नित्यक्रिया करि सरयू तीरा । गुरु समीप आये रघुबीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Having performed his daily rites on the bank of the <s>Sarayū</s>, <s>Rāma</s> came into the guru's presence.

children.text: गुरुहि प्रणाम कीन शिरनाई । दई अशीष हरषि मुनिराई ॥
children.translated_text: He prostrated before the guru with bowed head; the sage joyfully bestowed his blessing.

children.text: अवनिसुता कहँ बेगि बुलाई । कीजै काज समय रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: "Summon the daughter of the earth (<s>Sītā</s>) quickly; begin the ceremony, O lord of the <s>Raghus</s> — the time has come."

children.text: गिरिजा प्रभुगुरू आयसु पाई । रिपुसूदनहिंकह्यो समुझाई ॥
children.translated_text: O <s>Girijā</s>, receiving the guru's command, the lord explained it to <s>Ripusūdana</s>.

children.text: जाहु बेगि माता पहँ भाई । सादर जनकसुतहि लै आई ॥
children.translated_text: "Go quickly to our mother, brother, and bring <s>Sītā</s>, daughter of <s>Janaka</s>, here with due respect."

children.text: गे रिपुघन कौशल्या पाहीं । गहिपदकह्यो हरषमनमाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Ripusūdana</s> went to <s>Kausalyā</s>, grasped her feet, and spoke with joy in his heart.

children.text: मातु सियहि मुनिनाथ बुलाई । सुनि रघुनाथ जननिहरषाई ॥
children.translated_text: "Mother, the lord of sages has summoned <s>Sītā</s>." Hearing this, <s>Rāma's</s> mother was delighted.

children.text: सो० सादर सिय अन्हवाय भूषण बसन अनूपसजि ।
children.translated_text: Soraṭhā: Having reverently bathed <s>Sītā</s> and adorned her with incomparable ornaments and garments,

children.text: युवतिनसङ्ग पठाय चली सियापद सासुगहि ॥
children.translated_text: she sent her with her companions. <s>Sītā</s> departed, grasping her mother-in-law's feet.

children.text: मखसमाज सियजब पगधारी । रूपराशि नहिं जाय निहारी ॥
children.translated_text: When <s>Sītā</s> set foot in the sacrificial assembly, that treasure of beauty was beyond beholding.

children.text: नखशिख भूषण बसन बिराजैं । नूपुर शब्द मधुरध्वनिबाजैं ॥
children.translated_text: From head to toe, ornaments and garments shone resplendent; the sweet sound of anklets rang melodiously.

children.text: ऋषिन देखि सियकीनप्रणामा । जानिशिरोमणितेहिसुखधामा ॥
children.translated_text: The sages, beholding <s>Sītā</s>, offered their salutations, recognizing her as the crest-jewel and abode of bliss.

children.text: जाय सिया गुरु पद शिरनाई । दीन अशीष हरषिमुनिराई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Sītā</s> went and bowed her head at the guru's feet; the sage joyfully bestowed his blessing.

children.text: कुशर साथरी मुनिन मँगाई । कलश समीप मुनीशबिछाई ॥
children.translated_text: The sages had <s>kuśa</s> grass mats brought and spread them near the sacrificial vessel.

children.text: गांठि जोरि मुनिवर बैठारी । राम सियहिसनग्रीशदुलारी ॥
children.translated_text: The great sage tied the ceremonial knot and seated <s>Rāma</s> and <s>Sītā</s> together with loving care.

children.text: प्रथमहिं गुरु अभिषेक मुनेशू । पुनिसबऋषिमुनिकीनखगेशू ॥
children.translated_text: First the guru, the chief of sages, performed the consecration; then all the sages and ascetics did so, O king of birds.

children.text: वेदनध्वनि त्यहि समय सुहाई । नभते सुरन सुमनरिलाई ॥
children.translated_text: At that moment the melodious sound of the <s>Vedas</s> resounded; from the sky the gods showered flowers.

children.text: बरणत छबि सियराम भवानी । शारद शेषहुमति सकुचानी ॥
children.translated_text: Describing the beauty of <s>Sītā</s> and <s>Rāma</s>, O <s>Bhavānī</s>, even <s>Śāradā</s> and <s>Śeṣa</s> would feel their intellect falter.

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Chanda:

children.text: सकुचात मति श्रुतिशेष शारद अपरकी गिनती कई ।
children.translated_text: The intellect of <s>Śruti</s>, <s>Śeṣa</s>, and <s>Śāradā</s> grows abashed — who else could even reckon it?

children.text: ब्रह्मादिशिवसनकादि असछबि देखि मति चकृतभई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Śiva</s>, <s>Sanaka</s> and others, beholding such beauty, were struck with wonder.

children.text: अविगत अभेद अपार अगम न पार लखिकाहूपरै ।
children.translated_text: Unfathomable, without distinction, infinite, inaccessible — none can reach its limit.

children.text: सो नीच निपट अयान चेरे कौन विधि वरणन करै ॥
children.translated_text: How then can a lowly, utterly ignorant servant describe it in any way?

children.text: दो० जक्त मातु पितु रामसिय शोभा शील निधान ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The conjugal glory of mother, father, <s>Rāma</s>, and <s>Sītā</s> — that treasury of beauty and virtue,

children.text: सोकेहिविधि वरणनकरों सुनहुं सुता हिमवान ॥
children.translated_text: how can I describe it? Listen, O daughter of <s>Himavān</s>.

children.text: श्यामलगौर मनोहर जोरी । भुवनचतुर्दश की अबि थोरी ॥
children.translated_text: The dark and fair enchanting couple — the beauty of all fourteen worlds is but trifling before them.

children.text: पूजा सकल मुनीश कराई । तुरँग यज्ञ तेहि समयमँगाई ॥
children.translated_text: The chief of sages performed the complete worship; at that time the horse sacrifice was commenced.

children.text: करमंत्रबत अश्व अन्हवाई । पूजा कीन वेद जस गाई ॥
children.translated_text: With ritual mantras the horse was bathed; worship was performed as the <s>Vedas</s> have sung.

children.text: ऋषिन तहां मुनि आयसुपाई । मख हय हत्यो अवारनलाई ॥
children.translated_text: The <s>ṛṣis</s> and <s>munis</s> there, having received the command, slaughtered the sacrificial horse and brought it to the fire.

children.text: घृत कपूर पयकेर मिलाई । अति पुनीत शाकल्य बनाई ॥
children.translated_text: Mixing ghee, camphor, and milk together, they prepared the most sacred <s>śākalya</s> (ritual portions).

children.text: ऋषि मुनिवर कोबिदमखजेते । करहिं वेदध्वनि सादर तेते ॥
children.translated_text: The <s>ṛṣis</s>, great <s>munis</s>, and learned masters of the sacrifice reverently chanted Vedic hymns.

children.text: देवन सहित समाज सुरेशा । ऋषि अट्ठासी सहसखगेशा ॥
children.translated_text: Along with the gods was the assembly of <s>Indra</s>, and eighty-eight thousand <s>ṛṣis</s>, O lord of birds.

children.text: विधिहरिहरसुनिअवध उछाहू । यज्ञसभा आये खग नाहू ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Hari</s>, and <s>Hara</s> heard of the festivities in <s>Ayodhyā</s>; to the sacrificial assembly came the lord of birds.

children.text: जस बिधान मख वेदन गाई । तस प्रभु कीन सुनो खगराई ॥
children.translated_text: As the <s>Vedas</s> have prescribed the rites of the sacrifice, so the Lord performed them — hear, O king of birds.

children.text: दो० घृतकपूरहय मांस यव रुचिशाकल्यखगेश ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Ghee, camphor, horse flesh, barley, and fine <s>śākalya</s> portions, O lord of birds —

children.text: करतहोम रघुकुलतिलकशोभितसभाऋषेश ॥
children.translated_text: With these the <s>homa</s> (fire oblation) was performed by the ornament of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty, in the assembly graced by the chief of sages.

children.text: भयो होम बहु दिवस भवानी । बसुधा अनल तेज अकुलानी ॥
children.translated_text: The <s>homa</s> continued for many days, O <s>Bhavānī</s>; the earth was agitated by the brilliance of the fire.

children.text: जहँलग महि अकाश औकासू । धूम होम सब कीन निवासू ॥
children.translated_text: As far as the space between earth and sky extended, the smoke of the <s>homa</s> pervaded everything.

children.text: भानुतेज शशि शीतल ताई । पेस्यो न लखि काहू गिरिजाई ॥
children.translated_text: The sun's radiance and the moon's cool light — neither could be seen by anyone, O <s>Girijā</s> (Pārvatī).

children.text: ज्वालाहोम प्रचण्ड बखानी । नभ पाई आहुति हरषानी ॥
children.translated_text: The fierce flames of the <s>homa</s> are described; the oblations, reaching the sky, rejoiced.

children.text: जयजयकार रह्यो मखछाई । निभते सुर दुन्दुभी बजाई ॥
children.translated_text: Cries of 'Victory! Victory!' filled the sacrificial ground; the gods sounded their celestial drums.

children.text: पूरण आहुति कीन कृपाला । बोले मुनि तब बचन रसाला ॥
children.translated_text: The Merciful One made the final oblation; then the sage spoke sweet words:

children.text: यज्ञदान यहि औसर कीजै । शुभआाशिषऋषिमुनिद्विजलीजै ॥
children.translated_text: "At this occasion, make gifts for the sacrifice; receive the auspicious blessings of <s>ṛṣis</s>, <s>munis</s>, and Brahmins."

children.text: प्रभुआयसुलखिसचिवसुजाना । अमितगयन्दतुरँगसजियाना ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the Lord's command, the wise minister prepared countless elephants and horses, adorned and ready.

children.text: भूषण बसन हेम मणि हीरा । प्रभुपहँराखिसचिवमतिधीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Ornaments, garments, gold, jewels, and diamonds — the steady-minded minister placed them before the Lord.

children.text: दो० आयसुपार्यवशिष्ठमुनि सुनो उमा चितलाय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: By the command of <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> <s>Muni</s>, hear, O <s>Umā</s>, with attentive mind —

children.text: दीन दान रघुवंशमणि याचक विप्र बुलाय ॥
children.translated_text: The jewel of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty gave gifts, summoning the supplicants and Brahmins.

children.text: काहू हय काहू गजराजा । काहू रथ भूषण खगराजा ॥
children.translated_text: To some he gave horses, to some lordly elephants, to some chariots and ornaments, O king of birds.

children.text: जो जेहि भाव दीन स्वइ दाना । रङ्कहि कीन्ह्यो राव समाना ॥
children.translated_text: Whatever each one desired, he gave that very gift; he made the pauper equal to a king.

children.text: याचक बहुविधि कीरति गावैं । भूसुर आशिष बचन सुनावैं ॥
children.translated_text: The supplicants sang his glory in many ways; the Brahmins pronounced words of blessing.

children.text: अवनिकुमारि दीन जो दाना । सोखगपतिनहिंजायबखाना ॥
children.translated_text: The gifts that the princess of the earth (<s>Sītā</s>) gave — those cannot be described, O lord of birds.

children.text: सुनहुंराम कह मुनि तेहि काला । कीजै पैकरमा मखशाला ॥
children.translated_text: "Hear, O <s>Rāma</s>," said the sage at that time, "perform the circumambulation of the sacrificial hall."

children.text: सुनि प्रभुगुरू मृदुगिरा सुहाई । सियसमेत पर दक्षिण लाई ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the guru's gentle and pleasing words, the Lord, accompanied by <s>Sītā</s>, performed the <s>pradakṣiṇā</s> (circumambulation).

children.text: बहुरिकीनऋषिमुनिहिंप्रणामा । सीता सहित राम सुखधामा ॥
children.translated_text: Then <s>Rāma</s>, the abode of bliss, along with <s>Sītā</s>, bowed in obeisance to the <s>ṛṣis</s> and <s>munis</s>.

children.text: पुनिप्रभु गुरु वशिष्ठ पहँ जाई । सीता सहित चरण शिरनाई ॥
children.translated_text: Then the Lord went to Guru <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> and, with <s>Sītā</s>, bowed his head at the sage's feet.

children.text: दै आशिष अस कह मुनिराई । अग्नि बिनय कीजै रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: Giving his blessing, the great sage said, "Offer a prayer to <s>Agni</s> (the fire god), O <s>Rāma</s>."

children.text: दो० भलीनाथ कहि अवधपति सिय समेत खगपाल ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: "Very well, my Lord," said the king of <s>Ayodhyā</s>, and together with <s>Sītā</s>, O protector of birds,

children.text: जाय कीन अस्तुति अमित जहां होमकी ज्वाल ॥
children.translated_text: He went and offered boundless hymns of praise where the flames of the <s>homa</s> blazed.

children.text: प्रभुहि निहोरत नेह निहारी । ज्वाल राह मखबाजिनिकारी ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the Lord's affectionate supplication, the flames released the sacrificial horse.

children.text: दीन तुरँग प्रभु लीन सुखारी । जयध्वनिछायो तिहुं उरगारी ॥
children.translated_text: The Lord joyfully received the horse; cries of victory resounded through the three worlds, O enemy of serpents (<s>Garuḍa</s>).

children.text: तब प्रभु तुरँग सुरेशहि दीना । पदशिरनायबिनय तिनकीना ॥
children.translated_text: Then the Lord gave the horse to <s>Indra</s>; <s>Indra</s> bowed his head at the Lord's feet and made his supplication.

children.text: करि बहुभांति विनय सुरराजू । गयो लोकतजिसहितसमाजू ॥
children.translated_text: Making entreaties in many ways, the king of gods departed to his realm along with his retinue.

children.text: बिदाकीन प्रभु ऋषिन बुलाई । करि सन्मान सुनहुं खगराई ॥
children.translated_text: The Lord bade farewell to the <s>ṛṣis</s>, calling them and honoring them — hear, O king of birds.

children.text: निजनिज भवनगवनसबकीन्हे । तबप्रभुमुनिकहँआयसुदीन्हे ॥
children.translated_text: All departed to their respective abodes; then the Lord gave his command to the sage:

children.text: अबप्रभुभवनगवन निज कीजै । मन्दिर जाय दान बहु दीजै ॥
children.translated_text: "Now, Lord, proceed to your own palace; go to the mansion and give abundant gifts."

children.text: आगे मुनि सियरघुबर पाछे । गानकरहिं याचक सब आछे ॥
children.translated_text: The sage walked ahead, with <s>Sītā</s> and <s>Rāma</s> following behind; the grateful supplicants sang as they went.

children.text: भेरि निशान द्वार बहुबाजे । ऋतुपावसके घन जनुगाजे ॥
children.translated_text: Kettledrums, banners, and many instruments sounded at the gate, as if the clouds of the monsoon season were thundering.

children.text: दो० सियसमेत रघुबंश मणि गुरुवशिष्ठ मुनिसाथ ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The jewel of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty, together with <s>Sītā</s> and accompanied by Guru <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>,

children.text: शुभनक्षत्र प्रवेश किय निज मन्दिर रघुनाथ ॥
children.translated_text: Entered his own palace at an auspicious constellation, the Lord <s>Rāma</s>.

children.text: मन्दिर भीर याचकन देखी । प्रभुसे तब मुनि कह्योबिशेखी ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing the crowd of supplicants in the palace, the sage then spoke to the Lord with distinction:

children.text: प्रथमहिं धेनु द्विजन कहँ दीजै । महिदेवन शुभआशिषलीजै ॥
children.translated_text: "First give cows to the Brahmins; receive the auspicious blessings of the earthly gods (Brahmins)."

children.text: तेहि पाछे याचकहि बुलाई । दीजै दान देव सुखदाई ॥
children.translated_text: "After that, summon the supplicants and give them gifts, O Lord, giver of happiness."

children.text: सुनिप्रभुगुरु मृदुबयनरसाला । कोटि धेनु मांगीं तेहि काला ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the guru's gentle and sweet words, the Lord requested a crore of cows at that time.

children.text: कामधेनु हैं सुरस मुनीशा । कीन कुशस्थ कौशला धीशा ॥
children.translated_text: "There are wish-fulfilling cows (<s>Kāmadhenu</s>), O delightful lord of sages" — <s>Kuśa</s> arranged this, the wise lord of <s>Kośala</s>.

children.text: सुरभि दान महि देवन दीन्हे । पदगहिविनयभांतिबहुकीन्हे ॥
children.translated_text: The divine cows (<s>Surabhi</s>) were given as gifts to the Brahmins; they clasped his feet and paid homage in many ways.

children.text: दै आशिष महिदेव सिधाये । तब प्रभुयाचक नगरबुलाये ॥
children.translated_text: Giving their blessings, the Brahmins departed; then the Lord summoned the supplicants of the city.

children.text: याचक बोलि दीन बहु दाना । चलेभेवन यश करत बखाना ॥
children.translated_text: Calling the supplicants, he gave abundant gifts; they departed to their homes, proclaiming his glory.

children.text: गुरु सतकार कीन रघुराई । विविध प्रकार सुनहु मुनिराई ॥
children.translated_text: The Lord <s>Rāma</s> honored the Guru in various ways — hear, O great sage.

children.text: दो० हाथजोरिप्रभु बिनयकरि चरण कमल शिरनाय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: With folded hands the Lord made his entreaty, bowing his head at the lotus feet;

children.text: हय गयन्द भूषण बसन दीन लीन मुनिराय ॥
children.translated_text: Horses, elephants, ornaments, and garments he gave, and the great sage accepted them.

children.text: कहमुनि प्रभु आशिष ममलेहू । आयसू होय जाउँ मैं गेहू ॥
children.translated_text: The sage said, "Lord, accept my blessing; if you grant permission, I shall go to my home."

children.text: सियसमेत प्रभु गहिमुनि पाऊ । भवनगये मुनिवर खगराऊ ॥
children.translated_text: Together with <s>Sītā</s>, the Lord clasped the sage's feet; the great sage departed to his abode, O king of birds.

children.text: छोख्यो गांठ सुमित्रा आई । तबसियसासुचरणशिरनाई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Sumitrā</s> came and untied the auspicious thread; then <s>Sītā</s> bowed her head at her mother-in-law's feet.

children.text: केकै कौशल्या पद लागी । दीन अशीश प्रेम अनुरागी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Kaikeyī</s> and <s>Kausalyā</s> — she touched their feet; they gave blessings filled with love and devotion.

children.text: तीनिउ मातु चरण जल जाता । गह्योकृपानिधिजनसुखदाता ॥
children.translated_text: The water from washing all three mothers' feet — the ocean of mercy, the giver of joy to his people, received it.

children.text: रानी सब न्योछावर वारैं । सिय रधुनन्दन बदननिहारैं ॥
children.translated_text: All the queens waved offerings of auspicious protection over <s>Sītā</s> and <s>Rāma</s>, gazing upon their faces.

children.text: उतसव विविधकौशल्याकीन्ही । पटभूषण युवतिनकहँ दीन्ही ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Kausalyā</s> celebrated with various festivities; she gave garments and ornaments to the young women.

children.text: देत अशीश गंई निज धामा । हिये राखि मूरति सियरामा ॥
children.translated_text: Giving blessings, she went to her own quarters, holding the image of <s>Sītā</s> and <s>Rāma</s> in her heart.

children.text: कृपासिन्धु प्रभु दीनदयाला । बोलिसचिबअसकहखगपाला ॥
children.translated_text: The ocean of mercy, the compassionate Lord, called the minister and spoke thus, O protector of birds:

children.text: दो० ब्रह्मभोज विधि वेगिसब तातकरहु तुम जाय ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: "Quickly make all arrangements for the Brahmin feast, O dear one, go and do this;

children.text: न्योतो द्विज सुरदीपभर हैं आयसु मुनिराय ॥
children.translated_text: Invite the Brahmins and light the lamps everywhere — such is the command of the great sage."

children.text: जस कछु ब्रह्मभोज विधि होई । कीजै तात जाय अब सोई ॥
children.translated_text: "Whatever the proper arrangements for the Brahmin feast may be, go now and carry them out, dear one."

children.text: मैं जो राउर आयसु पावों । प्रागआदि तीरथकरि आवों ॥
children.translated_text: "As for me, if I receive your command, I shall make a pilgrimage to <s>Prayāga</s> and other sacred sites."

children.text: सुनिप्रभुवचनसचिवमहिपाला । बन्दिचरण बोले तेहिकाला ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the Lord's words, the minister-king bowed at his feet and spoke at that time:

children.text: प्रभु सर्ब्बज्ञ चराचर ईशा । जगपालकघालक रजनीशा ॥
children.translated_text: "O Lord, you are omniscient, master of all animate and inanimate creation, the sustainer and destroyer of the world, O moon-lord."

children.text: मैं सेवक सब विधि रघुराई । प्रभुता निजमोहिंदीनबड़ाई ॥
children.translated_text: "I am your servant in every way, O <s>Rāma</s>; through your own majesty you have bestowed upon me great honor."

children.text: अवशिनाथ तीरथ सब कीजै । तीरथबासिन कहँ सुख दीजै ॥
children.translated_text: "It is imperative, my Lord, that you visit all the sacred places; grant happiness to the dwellers of the pilgrimage sites."

children.text: मोहिं जो आयसु देहिं गुसांई । सो मैं करब दास की नाई ॥
children.translated_text: "Whatever command you give me, my master, I shall carry it out as a servant."

children.text: सचिवबचनसुनिप्रभु रणधीरा । नित्यक्रिया करि सरयू तीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the minister's words, the Lord, steadfast in battle, performed his daily rites on the banks of the <s>Sarayū</s>.

children.text: सियसमेत चढ़िसुभग बिमाना । गुरुपद बन्दि चले भगवाना ॥
children.translated_text: Together with <s>Sītā</s>, he mounted the splendid aerial chariot, bowed at the guru's feet, and the Lord departed.

children.text: दो० प्रथम धपाप नहायप्रभु काशी कीन प्रवेश ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: First the Lord bathed at <s>Dhapāpa</s> (a sacred ford) and entered <s>Kāśī</s> (Varanasi).

children.text: भोरहि उठि अस्नायकिय सीता राम खगेश ॥
children.translated_text: Rising at dawn, he bathed — <s>Sītā</s> and <s>Rāma</s>, O lord of birds.

children.text: शिवहिपूजि मिलि तीरथ बासी । चले प्रागकहँ प्रभुसुखरासी ॥
children.translated_text: Having worshipped <s>Śiva</s> and meeting the residents of the pilgrimage site, the Lord, the treasure of bliss, proceeded toward <s>Prayāga</s>.

children.text: पवन ते बेग चले हय रथके । आये निकट राज तीरथके ॥
children.translated_text: The horses and chariot moved swifter than the wind; they arrived near the king of pilgrimage sites (<s>Prayāga</s>).

children.text: उतर देवसरि कृपानिधाना । सीतासहित कीन आरनाना ॥
children.translated_text: The ocean of mercy crossed the celestial river (<s>Gaṅgā</s>) on the northern side and, together with <s>Sītā</s>, performed the ritual bath.

children.text: प्रोहित तीरथ राज बुलाई । बिविध दान दीन्ह्यो रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: Summoning the priest of the pilgrimage king (<s>Prayāga</s>), the Lord <s>Rāma</s> gave various gifts.

children.text: पूजिदेव तीरथ अति हेतू । भरद्वाज पहँ गे खगकेतू ॥
children.translated_text: Having worshipped the deities with great devotion at the sacred site, the bird-bannered one (<s>Rāma</s>) went to <s>Bharadvāja</s>.

children.text: करि प्रणाम मुनिवरहि खगेशा । सीतासहित चले अवधेशा ॥
children.translated_text: Paying obeisance to the great sage, O lord of birds, the lord of <s>Ayodhyā</s> departed with <s>Sītā</s>.

children.text: यमुन उतरिकरि मज्जन पाना । चित्रकूट आये गवाना ॥
children.translated_text: Crossing the <s>Yamunā</s> and performing ablutions and drinking its water, they proceeded to <s>Citrakūṭa</s>.

children.text: मन्दाकिनी पुनीत नहाई । भरतकूप आये रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: Having bathed in the sacred <s>Mandākinī</s>, the Lord <s>Rāma</s> came to <s>Bharata-kūpa</s> (Bharata's well).

children.text: भरत कूप सब तीरथ खानी । निशाजानि प्रभु रहेभवानी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Bharata-kūpa</s> is the mine of all sacred sites — knowing it was night, the Lord rested there, O <s>Bhavānī</s>.

children.text: दो० होतप्रभात नहाय प्रभु । मिलिमुनिऋषिनसमाज ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: At dawn the Lord bathed, met the assembly of <s>munis</s> and <s>ṛṣis</s>,

children.text: बालमीकि मुनि आश्रमहिं चलेहरषि रघुराज ॥
children.translated_text: And proceeded joyfully to the hermitage of <s>Vālmīki</s> <s>Muni</s>, the king of the <s>Raghu</s> dynasty.

children.text: मुनिवर निकट जाय रघुराई । दण्डप्रणाम कीन शिरनाई ॥
children.translated_text: Going near the great sage, the Lord <s>Rāma</s> bowed in prostration, touching his head to the ground.

children.text: मुनिहुँ बहुत प्रभुअस्तुतिकीन्ही । कन्दमूलफल भोजन दीन्ही ॥
children.translated_text: The sage too offered much praise to the Lord and gave him fruits, roots, and forest food to eat.

children.text: रैनि बिहाय भानुकुल केतू । चले यानचढ़ि सियासमेतू ॥
children.translated_text: When the night passed, the banner of the solar dynasty mounted the chariot with <s>Sītā</s> and departed.

children.text: नीमषार मिश्रिष प्रभु आये । मिलिसबऋषिनपरमसुखपाये ॥
children.translated_text: The Lord came to <s>Naimiṣāraṇya</s> and <s>Miśrikh</s>; meeting all the <s>ṛṣis</s>, he obtained supreme happiness.

children.text: जनक सुता समेत रघुराई । करि अरनान तहां गिरिजाई ॥
children.translated_text: The Lord <s>Rāma</s>, together with <s>Janaka's</s> daughter (<s>Sītā</s>), performed the ritual bath there, O <s>Girijā</s> (Pārvatī).

children.text: दीन दान महिदेव बुलाई । तीरथ पूजि चले रघुराई ॥
children.translated_text: Summoning the Brahmins, he gave gifts; having worshipped at the sacred site, the Lord <s>Rāma</s> departed.

children.text: सई उतरि गोमती नहावा । तमसा पार राम रथआवा ॥
children.translated_text: Crossing the <s>Saī</s> river, he bathed in the <s>Gomatī</s>; <s>Rāma's</s> chariot crossed the <s>Tamasā</s>.

children.text: कौशल पुर आये रघुनाथा । गुरु पदबन्दिजोरिदोउहाथा ॥
children.translated_text: The Lord <s>Rāma</s> arrived at <s>Kośalapura</s> (Ayodhyā); he bowed at the guru's feet with both hands joined.

children.text: जाय भवन मातहि शिरनावा । प्रेमपुलकि मातहिं उरलावा ॥
children.translated_text: Going home, he bowed his head at his mothers' feet; thrilling with love, he embraced his mothers.

children.text: सो० पूँछि कुशाल पुनि मात कह प्रभु चरणप्रतापतुव ।
children.translated_text: Soraṭhā: When asked about his welfare, his mother said, "By the glory of your feet, O Lord, all is well."

children.text: तहि औसर सब भ्रात आयराम पद पदुमगह ॥
children.translated_text: At that moment all the brothers came and clasped the lotus feet of <s>Rāma</s>.

children.text: अनुजन सुबन बोलि रघुराई । भोजन कीन जाय खगराई ॥
children.translated_text: Calling his younger brothers and noble companions, the Lord <s>Rāma</s> took his meal, O king of birds.

children.text: अर्द्ध निशा लखि दीनदयाला । कीन्ह्योशयनजायतेहिकाला ॥
children.translated_text: Seeing it was midnight, the compassionate Lord went and retired to rest at that time.

children.text: प्रात उठे गुरु पद शिरनाई । बन्दि विप्र मुनि आयसु पाई ॥
children.translated_text: Rising at dawn, he bowed at the guru's feet, saluted the Brahmins and sages, and received their blessings.

children.text: करि अस्नान पूजि त्रिपुरारी । कृपासिन्धु सेवक हितकरी ॥
children.translated_text: Performing his ablutions and worshipping <s>Tripurāri</s> (Śiva), the ocean of mercy, the benefactor of his servants —

children.text: अति आदर भूसुरुन बुलाई । चरण धोय भोजन करवाई ॥
children.translated_text: With great respect he invited the Brahmins, washed their feet, and had them fed.

children.text: उठे जेयँ भूसुर खगपाला । पान दक्षिणा दीन कृपाला ॥
children.translated_text: When the Brahmins had eaten and risen, O protector of birds, the Merciful One gave them betel and <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual gifts).

children.text: बहुरि प्रणाम कीन रघुबीरा । चलेअशीशतद्विजमतिधीरा ॥
children.translated_text: Then the Lord <s>Rāma</s> bowed to them again; the steady-minded Brahmins departed, bestowing blessings.

children.text: प्रभु आयसु मुनिनायक पाई । बठे राजसभा तब जाई ॥
children.translated_text: Having received the command from the chief of sages, the Lord went and sat in the royal court.

children.text: वर्ष सहस दश कीन्ह्यि राजू । सुखीभये सब अवधसमाजू ॥
children.translated_text: He ruled for ten thousand years; all the people of <s>Ayodhyā</s> were happy.

children.text: छन्द ॥
children.translated_text: Chanda (verse):

children.text: भये सुखी अवध समाज सब सपनेहु कलेश न पावहीं ।
children.translated_text: All the people of <s>Ayodhyā</s> became happy; not even in dreams did they experience any distress.

children.text: नर नारि हर्ष समेत विधिसों जोरि हाथ मनावहीं ॥
children.translated_text: Men and women, full of joy, would pray to <s>Vidhātā</s> (Brahmā, the Creator) with folded hands.

children.text: वरदेहु अस विधना हमैं जो कहैं यह वानी पढ़ैं ।
children.translated_text: "Grant us this boon, O Creator, that whoever recites these words —

children.text: कह दास चेरे राम सिय नित राज्य कौशलपुर करैं ॥
children.translated_text: May <s>Rāma</s> and <s>Sītā</s>, as master and mistress, ever reign in <s>Kośalapura</s>," says the poet-servant.

children.text: सो० ऐसेइ बचन खगेश कहैं परस्पर नारि नर ।
children.translated_text: Soraṭhā: Such words, O lord of birds, men and women would say to one another,

children.text: शारद शेश गणेश ग्रामदेव शिरनाय सब ॥
children.translated_text: Bowing to <s>Śāradā</s> (Sarasvatī), <s>Śeṣa</s>, <s>Gaṇeśa</s>, and the village deities, all of them.

children.text: मखइतिहास रुचिर मैं गाई । रामचरित सब तुम्हैं सुनाई ॥
children.translated_text: I have sung this delightful history of the sacrifice; I have narrated to you all the deeds of <s>Rāma</s>.

children.text: आगे सुनहु अपर इतिहासा । कहों यथामति बुधिपरकासा ॥
children.translated_text: Now hear another history ahead; I shall tell it as best as my intellect illumines.

children.text: हरन मोह तम भानु समानू । दहनबिपिनअघप्रबलकृशानू ॥
children.translated_text: Like the sun that dispels the darkness of delusion, like a mighty fire that burns the forest of sin,

children.text: मृतक शरीर सजीवनमूरी । जनमन पापकरहिं सब दूरी ॥
children.translated_text: Like the life-giving herb for a dead body, it removes all sins from people's minds.

children.text: सोमोसों क्यहिविधि कहि जाई । पोत नेक हीरा गति पाई ॥
children.translated_text: How can that be described in words? Through a small vessel one attains the state of a diamond.

children.text: पाछे यज्ञ भयो उतसाहा । सोउछाह सुनिये खगनाहा ॥
children.translated_text: After the sacrifice there was great celebration; hear of that rejoicing, O lord of birds.

children.text: प्रभुअनुजनरनिवास बिहँगधर । कीन प्रकटदुइदुइसुतसुन्दर ॥
children.translated_text: The Lord's younger brothers, dwelling in the inner chambers, O bird-bearer (<s>Garuḍa</s>), each produced two handsome sons.

children.text: राममातु मुनिवरहिं बुलाई । पूँछी जन्मलगन हरषाई ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Rāma's</s> mother, calling the great sage, joyfully asked about the birth-constellations of the children.

children.text: मुनिवर बचन बिचार बखानी । शुभ नक्षत्र भे बालक रानी ॥
children.translated_text: The great sage deliberated and declared his assessment: "The children were born under auspicious constellations, O queen."

children.text: दो० भये लगन सुन्दर तनय कहों बचन सुनुरानि ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: "The birth-constellations are auspicious, the sons are handsome — hear my words, O queen:

children.text: हौइहैं सुतयुग बिदित सब सुखशोभागुणखानि ॥
children.translated_text: These sons shall be renowned through the ages, mines of happiness, beauty, and virtue."

children.text: असकहिमुनिरघुपतिपहँ आई । कृपासिन्धु मुनिपदशिरनाई ॥
children.translated_text: Saying thus, the sage came to <s>Rāma</s>; the ocean of mercy bowed his head at the sage's feet.

children.text: परसिचरण सादर बैठारी । बोले बचन भक्तभय हारी ॥
children.translated_text: Touching his feet, he seated the sage with respect; the remover of devotees' fear spoke:

children.text: नाथकृपातव सिन्धु अपारा । मम स्वारथ जनु पूरण तारा ॥
children.translated_text: "Lord, your grace is a boundless ocean; you are like a star that fulfills my every desire."

children.text: उमँगत प्रेम बारिअधिकाई । अति मृदुचितराउरमुनिराई ॥
children.translated_text: Overflowing with the abundance of loving emotion, your heart is exceedingly tender, O great sage.

children.text: धकरिनि जाय नारतब छीना । भूषण बसन निछावरिलीना ॥
children.translated_text: The nursemaids then went and snatched away the infants; they performed the <s>nīchāvari</s> (protective waving) with ornaments and garments.

children.text: युवती सुनत तुरत उठिधाई । गावत मङ्गल मन्दिर आई ॥
children.translated_text: The young women, hearing the news, immediately rose and rushed in, singing auspicious songs as they entered the palace.

children.text: ढाढ़िनिबहुबिधि सोहिलगावैं । नाचिगाय रनिवास रिझावैं ॥
children.translated_text: The bards sang felicitous songs in many ways; dancing and singing, they delighted the inner chambers.

children.text: भेरि निशान ढोल सहनाई । बाजैं द्वार बरणि नहिं जाई ॥
children.translated_text: Kettledrums, banners, drums, and shehnais sounded at the gate — it cannot be described.

children.text: नाचहिं रम्भ अधिक उरगारी । गानकरहिं सुरपाल सँभारी ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Rambhā</s> (the celestial nymph) danced with great enthusiasm, O enemy of serpents; the guardians of the directions sang with care.

children.text: दो० हय गज धरणी धाम धन राजद्वार रघुनाथ ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Horses, elephants, lands, mansions, wealth — at the royal gate, the Lord <s>Rāma</s>,

children.text: देत याचकन बोलिप्रभु विविधिभांति खगनाथ ॥
children.translated_text: Gave these to the supplicants he had summoned, in various ways, O lord of birds.

children.text: राघवकुल जसरीति भवानी । कीनहीं तस कौशल्या रानी ॥
children.translated_text: As is the tradition and custom of the <s>Rāghava</s> dynasty, O <s>Bhavānī</s>, so did Queen <s>Kausalyā</s> observe it.

children.text: नामकरण जब औसर आई । राममातु मुनिवरहि बुलाई ॥
children.translated_text: When the time for the naming ceremony (<s>nāmakaraṇa</s>) arrived, <s>Rāma's</s> mother called the great sage.

children.text: सुनत महामुनि मन्दिर आये । कौशल्यहि शिशुनाम सुनाये ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing the summons, the great sage came to the palace and told <s>Kausalyā</s> the names of the children.

children.text: जबमुनिवर शिशुनाम सुनावा । जो कछुनेग उचित सो पाव ॥
children.translated_text: When the great sage announced the children's names, whatever appropriate honorarium was due, he received it.

children.text: दै आशिष मुनिराज सिधाये । याचक विविधदान तब पाये ॥
children.translated_text: Giving his blessing, the sage-king departed; the supplicants then received various gifts.

children.text: कछू दिवस बीते मुनिराई । लागे फिरन सुवन अँगनाई ॥
children.translated_text: Some days passed, O great sage, and the young sons began crawling about in the courtyards.

children.text: बाल बिनोद निरखि सब रानी । होहिं मुदितनहिंजायबखानी ॥
children.translated_text: Watching the children's playful antics, all the queens became delighted beyond description.

children.text: भूप अजिर खेलहिं सब भाई । मतहिगोद बसहिं पुनिजाई ॥
children.translated_text: The young princes played in the royal courtyard, all the brothers, and then went and sat in their mothers' laps.

children.text: माता हरषि गोद तब लीन्हीं । क्षुधितबिलोकिक्षीरमुखदीन्हीं ॥
children.translated_text: The mothers joyfully took them in their laps; seeing them hungry, they gave them milk at their mouths.

children.text: दो० कीन मुदित चूड़ाकरण दीन भूसुरन दान ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The <s>cūḍākaraṇa</s> (tonsure ceremony) was joyfully performed; gifts were given to the Brahmins.

children.text: यज्ञोपवीत कियो फिर कृपासिन्धु भगवान ॥
children.translated_text: Then the <s>yajñopavīta</s> (sacred thread ceremony) was performed by the ocean of mercy, the Lord.

children.text: विद्याकहँ गुरुपास पठाई । लागे पढ़न कुवँर सब जाई ॥
children.translated_text: They were sent to the guru for education; all the princes went and began their studies.

children.text: अल्पकाल विद्यासब लीन्हीं । गुरुसतकार भांतिबहु कीन्हीं ॥
children.translated_text: In a short time they mastered all the branches of learning; they honored the guru in many ways.

children.text: लै शर धनु करकमलन माहीं । कुशलवसँगबनखेलन जाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: Taking bow and arrow in their lotus hands, they would go with <s>Kuśa</s> and <s>Lava</s> to play in the forest.

children.text: मारैंमृग खग विवहू बराहू । फिरहिं अशंकन भय उरकाहू ॥
children.translated_text: They would hunt deer, birds, and boars; they roamed fearlessly, with no dread in their hearts.

children.text: यज्ञ स्वयम्बर सुन जेहि देशा । जायँतहां सब अनुजखगेशा ॥
children.translated_text: Wherever there was a sacrifice or a <s>svayaṃvara</s> (bride-choosing ceremony) in any land, all the younger brothers would go there, O lord of birds.

children.text: करिछलबल बहुविधि संग्रामा । कुवँरि बिवाहि फिरैंलै धामा ॥
children.translated_text: Through cunning and valor, fighting battles in many ways, they would wed the princesses and bring them home.

children.text: छवो अनुज यहिविधि मुनिराई । कियेब्याहभूजबलबरिआई ॥
children.translated_text: The six younger brothers, in this manner, O great sage, were married through the might of their arms.

children.text: कुवँर कुवँरि मृदु बदन निहारी । कौशल्यादि मुदित महतारी ॥
children.translated_text: Gazing upon the tender faces of the princes and princesses, <s>Kausalyā</s> and the other mothers were delighted.

children.text: उत्सव अभितभवन अतिथोरा । उमँगिचल्योपुरते चहुँओरा ॥
children.translated_text: Festivities filled the palace beyond measure; joy overflowed from the city in all four directions.

children.text: सो० देखितनय मति धीर नीति धर्म अति साधुचित ।
children.translated_text: Soraṭhā: Seeing the sons to be steady of mind, upholders of righteousness and virtue, of saintly disposition,

children.text: चेरे प्रभु रघुबीर पाय समय मुनिसन कह्यो ॥
children.translated_text: The servant-poet says: Lord <s>Rāma</s>, finding the right moment, spoke to the sage:

children.text: प्रभु अभिलाष एक मनमाहीं । तुम तजि नाथ कहों केहिपाहीं ॥
children.translated_text: "There is one desire in my heart, Lord — to whom but you shall I confide it?

children.text: भये अनुज आठो नृप योगू । देहु राज्य सुख पावहिं लोगू ॥
children.translated_text: All eight younger brothers have become worthy of kingship; give them kingdoms, so the people may enjoy happiness."

children.text: बहुत दिवस बीते मोहिं स्वामी । तुमहिं विदितसबअन्तर्य्यमी ॥
children.translated_text: "Many days have passed for me, O master; you know everything, O knower of all hearts."

children.text: सुनि रघुनाथ मनोहर बानी । प्रेम पुलकि बोले मुनिज्ञानी ॥
children.translated_text: Hearing <s>Rāma's</s> enchanting words, the wise sage thrilled with love and spoke:

children.text: कसनकहहु असनीति कृपाला । दीजै सुतहिं राज्य महिपाला ॥
children.translated_text: "Why do you speak thus contrary to propriety, O Merciful One? Give the kingdom to your sons, O king."

children.text: आठ भाग बसुधा सब कीन्ही । आठो सुतनबांटि प्रभुदीन्ही ॥
children.translated_text: The earth was divided into eight parts; the Lord distributed and gave them to all eight sons.

children.text: गजहय रथ सुखपाल भवानी । सोसब दीन न जायबखानी ॥
children.translated_text: Elephants, horses, chariots, and prosperity, O <s>Bhavānī</s> — all that he gave cannot be described.

children.text: पुनि सबतनय समीप बुलाई । निजकुलधर्म्म उमासमुझाई ॥
children.translated_text: Then, calling all the sons near, he instructed them, O <s>Umā</s>, in the dharma of their lineage.

children.text: दो० गुरु समीप सबसुतन कहँ दीन राम उपदेश ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: In the guru's presence, to all the sons <s>Rāma</s> gave this instruction:

children.text: करहुराज्यधर्म नीति सों प्रजहि न होय कलेश ॥
children.translated_text: "Rule with dharma, righteousness, and wise policy, so that the subjects may suffer no distress."

children.text: असकहि प्रभु गिरिराजकुमारी । कीन चरित कछु अवधबिहारी ॥
children.translated_text: Thus spoke the Lord, O daughter of the mountain king; the Lord who sports in <s>Ayodhyā</s> performed certain deeds.

children.text: सो प्रसङ्ग नहिं सकों बखानी । प्रभुमहिमा मति दृष्टभवानी ॥
children.translated_text: That episode I cannot narrate further, O <s>Bhavānī</s> — the Lord's glory is beyond the reach of my intellect.

children.text: अतिशय गूढ़ चरित रघुराई । आगम निगम पुराणन गाई ॥
children.translated_text: Exceedingly profound are the deeds of the lord of the <s>Raghus</s>; the <s>Āgamas</s>, <s>Vedas</s>, and <s>Purāṇas</s> have sung them.

children.text: राम चरित अवगाह अपारा । को समरथ जग चाहै पारा ॥
children.translated_text: The deeds of <s>Rāma</s> are unfathomably vast; who in the world is capable [enough to] wish for their far shore?

children.text: वेदौ जासु अन्त नहिं पावै । सो केहिभांति उमाकोउगावै ॥
children.translated_text: Even the <s>Vedas</s> cannot find his end; so how, O <s>Umā</s>, could anyone sing of him?

children.text: गुणगावत शारद श्रुति शेषा । सकुचि रहे करिशोच विशेषा ॥
children.translated_text: <s>Śāradā</s> (Sarasvatī), the <s>Śruti</s> (Vedas), and <s>Śeṣa</s>, singing his virtues, have remained abashed, feeling great regret.

children.text: रामचरित पावन खगकेतू । भवसागर तरिहैं हित सेतू ॥
children.translated_text: The sacred deeds of <s>Rāma</s>, O <s>Khagaketu</s> (bird-lord), are a beneficent bridge for crossing the ocean of existence.

children.text: रामचरित सुंदर सुखदाई । कलिमलदहनसुनों मुनिराई ॥
children.translated_text: The deeds of <s>Rāma</s> are beautiful and bliss-giving, burning the impurities of <s>Kali</s> [age] — hear them, O sage-king.

children.text: छन्द
children.translated_text: Verse:

children.text: प्रभुसकल कलिमल हरनसंशय शोकमोह नशावनी ।
children.translated_text: The Lord destroys all the impurities of <s>Kali</s> [age], removes doubt, grief, and delusion.

children.text: कहिदास चेरे भजन बिन पावे न गति अनपावनी ॥
children.translated_text: [<s>Dās</s>] says: servants without devotion do not attain the impure goal.

children.text: असजानि जिय कोऊ चतुर जगमोह माया त्यागहीं ।
children.translated_text: Knowing this in their hearts, let the wise ones in the world abandon the delusion of <s>Māyā</s>;

children.text: भवसिन्धु तरि क्षणमाहिं ते रघुबीर पुद अनुरागहीं ॥
children.translated_text: they who are devoted to the feet of <s>Raghuvīra</s> cross the ocean of existence in an instant.

children.text: सो० राम बिनय इतिहास कहैं सुनैं जे प्रेमसों ।
children.translated_text: Sohā: Those who recite and hear with love the humble history of <s>Rāma</s>,

children.text: ते काटहिं भवफांस रहैं सुखी तिहुंकालमा ॥
children.translated_text: they cut the snare of worldly existence and remain happy in all three times.

children.text: माधहि मास अनूप शुक्लपक्ष तिथिदुइजशुभा ।
children.translated_text: In the peerless month of <s>Māgha</s>, on the auspicious second <s>tithi</s> (day) of the bright fortnight,

children.text: कहीहैमति अनुरूपलवकुशकथाविचित्रअति ॥
children.translated_text: this wondrous tale of <s>Lava</s> and <s>Kuśa</s> has been told as befits [the author's] understanding.

children.text: इतिश्रीरामाश्वमेधसम्पूर्णम्
children.translated_text: Thus ends the complete <s>Śrī Rāmāśvamedha</s>.
